Company Overview
Founded in 2014, and listed on the ASX since 2015, Superloop’s purpose is to enable better internet for Australian homes and businesses. We enable challenger retail brands (including Superloop and Exetel brands) to take a larger share of the market, leveraging Superloop’s Infrastructure-on-Demand platform. Superloop provides connectivity and services to customers in three segments of the market: Consumer, Business and Wholesale. Our offerings leverage Superloop’s investments in physical infrastructure assets that include fibre, subsea cables and fixed wireless, as well as Superloop’s software platforms. Hundreds of thousands of homes and businesses rely on Superloop and Exetel every day for their connectivity needs.
Visit www.superloop.com to learn more.
Role Purpose
We are seeking a highly capable and technically minded Technical Business Analyst to join our Sydney-based Project Delivery team. This is a pivotal role supporting one of Superloop’s largest wholesale customers. You will work closely with the customer and internal technical teams to ensure requirements are clearly defined, prioritised, and scoped for delivery. You will play a critical role in reducing ambiguity, improving requirement quality, and enabling efficient execution across engineering and operations teams. In addition to customer-facing responsibilities, you will support Go-To-Market (GTM) initiatives for large-scale projects and contribute to building scalable requirement-gathering frameworks to increase throughput across the business. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on complex challenges, enjoys working outside traditional role boundaries, and is comfortable stepping into different responsibilities to achieve outcomes.
Key Responsibilities
• Act as the primary requirements liaison for a major wholesale customer, developing and promoting a positive and collaborative way of working.• Engage with GTM business stakeholders to understand objectives, problems, constraints, and success measures.• Facilitate workshops, interviews, and working sessions to elicit requirements and clarify scope.• Translate customer needs into structured, prioritised deliverables ready for estimation and delivery.• Collaborate with architects, developers, testers, and delivery teams to ensure solutions meet documented requirements.• Support project intake and prioritisation by ensuring sufficient upfront scoping and information quality.• Contribute to Statements of Work (SoW), business cases, and delivery artefacts as required.• Contribute to the development and adoption of standard BA templates, tools, and practices.• Support delivery frameworks (Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid) as appropriate to the initiative.• Ensure requirements are traceable from definition through to implementation and acceptance.• Manage requirement backlogs and support prioritisation aligned to customer and business objectives.• Provide value in high-severity incident reviews and support demand activities by delivering root cause analysis and preventative actions.• Communicate frequently, honestly, and positively with all stakeholders.• Contribute to the development of structured requirement-gathering frameworks to support scale and consistency.• Develop templates, documentation standards, and governance practices.• Improve intake, scoping, and prioritisation processes to increase delivery throughput.
Qualifications and Experience
• 5+ years’ experience as a Technical Business Analyst within telecommunications or technology environments.• Strong experience working with wholesale or enterprise telecommunications customers.• Demonstrated ability to gather, document, and manage complex business and technical requirements.• Solid understanding of telecommunications systems, including provisioning, OSS/BSS, CRM, network operations, or service assurance platforms.• Experience supporting large-scale delivery or transformation programs.• Project management experience is advantageous.• Strong understanding of Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery methodologies.• Exceptional stakeholder engagement and workshop facilitation skills.• Strong analytical thinking and structured documentation capability.
On Offer

Free Home Broadband
Free Mobile SIM plan
Flexibility – 3 days/week in the office
Lunch on Wednesdays, snacks, donuts and more!
Diverse and inclusive culture
Gain skills and build relationships to succeed in the telco and tech industries, at Superloop and beyond.

At Superloop, we’re dedicated to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace where everyone feels safe, valued, and empowered to be who they are. We actively embrace diversity and celebrate the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of our team members. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applicants from all backgrounds to apply, regardless of gender, age, faith, ethnicity, nationality, sexuality, neurodiversity, or physical ability. We’re committed to ensuring that our hiring processes are accessible and inclusive for everyone interested in joining Superloop.

operations, and branch stakeholders to gather insights and drive improvements.• Contributing to knowledge base documentation and the continuous improvement of our support capability.What We're Looking Middy's, Rexel, Voltex, or similar.• You know how a profit centre operates end-to-end: POS, purchasing, inventory, branch accounting, customer accounts.• You can write a proper requirements document Location: North Rocks, NSW (must be within reasonable commute)• Australian work rights are required for this position.If you've spent years working with electrical trade systems and you're ready to bring that knowledge into a head office IT role with real scope, we'd love to hear from you.Apply now with your CV and a Cover Letter outlining your experience within the electrical trade industry and the business sytems you've worked with.Applicants who fail to submit a cover letter will not be considered for this role.

last_kept_snapshot.teaser: We currently have the opportunity for a Business Analyst to join the IT and Digital Services team on a 12-month fixed term contract
last_kept_snapshot.fit_source_text:
UTS College provides a pathway for students into the University of Technology, Sydney (UTS), one of Australia's leading universities, and it is our vision to actualise potential and enhance lives through the power of learning, our actions and our people. Our purpose is to provide the best available opportunity for students to develop the knowledge, skills & attributes they need to attain their goals through market-leading courses, teaching excellence and an emphasis on the student experience.
We currently have the opportunity for a Business Analyst to join the IT and Digital Services team on a 12-month fixed term contract, reporting to the Systems and Business Analysis Team Leader.
About the RoleThis position is responsible for:

Gathering and documenting business requirements and develop user stories or requirements within agreed timeframes
Using business requirements or user stories to create technical specifications with technical specialists
Contributing to and maintaining standard and guidelines for business process improvement and business analysis techniques for UTS College
Using various business analysis tools and methodologies to map and understand business processes
Liaising between business stakeholders, Solution Architects, IT teams, and vendors to ensure alignment on project goals and deliverables.
Facilitating meetings and workshops to gather input, validate requirements, and maintain engagement throughout the project lifecycle.
Coordinating test strategies and perform testing and validation activities, including user acceptance testing (UAT), to ensure solutions meet specified requirements.
Providing support throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring timely issue resolution, testing and change management and requirements traceability
Creating process maps with business stakeholders through effective relationships
Preparing and maintaining comprehensive documentation, including business requirements, system specifications, and user guides.

About YouTo succeed in this role you will need:

 Bachelor degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent work experience)
4 -6 years of experience in Business Analysis
Experience with data and reporting projects, finance system implementation projects and system integration tools.
High capability to document business requirements and develop business process maps
Problem-solving skills and experience with using structured problem-solving techniques
Highly developed stakeholder engagement skills, with demonstrated ability to communicate effectively, influence decision-making, and manage expectations at multiple organisational levels.
Experience with project management delivery tools like Jira, confluence. Creating requirements, user stories, test cases and dependencies and experience in agile ways of working
Demonstrated understanding of, or certification in business analysis frameworks like CBAP is preferable 
Knowledge of Change Management approaches such as ADKAR
Higher education and /or student lifecycle experience preferred

 
What UTS College has to Offer!

A flexible work environment, including working from home and from our convenient inner-city campus within walking distance to Central Station.
A diverse workplace with a passion for encouraging and supporting inclusiveness.
Wellbeing programs including discounted gym memberships, free and confidential access to an Employee Assistance Program, wellbeing initiatives and resources.
Continuous learning and professional development (including ongoing learning & development opportunities, free LinkedIn Learning access and the UTS Library)
An easy-to-use Staff Recognition Program
Additional paid leave over the December end of year holidays
A collaborative culture built on our Ethics of Respect, Integrity, Courage, Imagination, Compassion and Honesty

 
If this sounds like you, we’d like to hear from you!For more information about UTS College visit utscollege.edu.au
 
Please note that we are unable to provide visa sponsorship, and candidates are required to have full working rights for this position.

last_kept_snapshot.fit_source_text:
Opportunity to elevate your career with an industry leading, award winning business offering purpose driven work, meaningful organisational values, an inclusive culture & curiosity for new ideas, innovation & growth.
 

So many reasons to CHUse CHU! 

We're Australia’s first and leading Strata Underwriting agency, with a commitment to leading the way in our industry, through focusing on Artificial Intelligence & Technology, Diversity & Inclusion and Environmental Sustainability.  

A career at CHU is a career of opporCHUnity. The opportunity to create, innovate and grow. When you join our team, you’re joining an industry leader with a track record for putting our people and our customers first. Despite being in 5 different locations across Australia, our leading hybrid working model and technology enables our people to be close-knit and connected.  

All about CHU 

CHU is part of the Steadfast Group; a top 200 ASX-listed company with $9.8 billion in total billings. As the market leader we protect over 100,000 residential strata properties across Australia, with almost half a trillion value insured. We are multi-award winners: back-to-back winners of the Underwriting Agency of the Year Award 2021-2023 & Claims Team of the Year 2024, plus Excellent in Environment, Social and Governance Change winners for 2024. We are proud to be an award-winning underwriting agency and our goal is to continue to put people, planet, partnership and prosperity at the heart of what we do. 

Working with CHU

When you join CHU, you will join a friendly and supportive team who are committed to your wellbeing and engagement. We want you to enjoy your work each day and derive satisfaction from being part of a collaborative organisation and culture. To support and reward you, we offer:


	Work where suits you best - we are proud of our leading, inclusive and flexible hybrid work model
	Real connection and interaction - we offer regular Company wide team & ConnecCHUn Days 
	Hard work deserves recognition - competitive salary packaging and annual bonus scheme 
	Grow your future savings - employer matched superannuation contributions
	Take the stress out of the unexpected – access up to 4 extra flexible paid leave days for life’s ups and downs
	Celebrate the joy of parenthood - 18 weeks paid parental leave
	We support your charitable work - access to a paid volunteer day each year
	Cut your monthly costs - paid SCI, Life Insurance and Travel Insurance
	Grow with us - professional development and study assistance and study leave
	Support when you need it most - extensive health and wellbeing initiatives
	Diversify your experience - Work and Travel Adventure Program, Career Breaks
	Family first - CHU are accredited as a Family Inclusive Workplace 2022/28
	You can be you - CHU are recognised as an Inclusive Employer 2025/28 by the Diversity Council Australia


For further information, head to the benefits section of our careers page.
What your new job looks like: 

You will be part of a dynamic team, with a culture that is less structured and more start-up, that is continuously providing industry-leading innovative solutions in the Strata Insurance space. As a business analyst in a vibrant and energetic IT Solutions team, you will be responsible for exciting new initiatives, managing the full lifecycle; from stakeholder engagement, requirements gathering, solution design, functional needs, to implementation, providing support for roll out and training and providing production support.  You’ll be exposed to and expected to help drive significant gains in operational efficiency, in an already highly system augmented operation, with a focus on identifying and understanding how the latest technology enablers like embedded LLM, Agentic, and other AI driven processes in an openly experimental environment.
 

On a day-to-day basis you will be: 


	Collaborating with stakeholders to gather and document detailed business requirements, translating business needs into actionable insights 
	Excelling at capturing user stories, defining requirements, managing ambiguity, all while demonstrating strong interpersonal and influencing skills  
	Producing detailed current and future state process maps, identifying gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities to streamline and automate processes
	Working closely with developers to design value-driven solutions and provide support to the team to ensure successful implementation 
	Maintaining and updating relevant documentation and specifications for proposed system changes 
	Using Agile project management techniques to prioritise project features 
	Demonstrating an ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment; with a passion for embracing new technologies  


We'd love to meet you, especially if you can talk to us about your:  


	Proven experience as a Business Analyst within the general insurance industry with expertise in business process re-engineering, process modelling, and IT systems implementation
	Real world experience with embedding and productionising genAI solutions within work flows with an understanding of the challenges and proven strategies to overcome issues with highly automated consistency, accuracy and explainability
	Demonstrated proficiency in working independently, taking initiative, and making decisions 
	Strong problem-solving abilities to navigate complex challenges and adapt to evolving situations  
	University Degree or TAFE level equivalent in a computing or programming field (desirable) Exposure to software and system design 
	Ability to drive issues to resolution 
	Motivated and pragmatic approach to problem solving 
	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills 
	Ability to adapt to changing requirements 
	Natural proactive and positive attitude 
	Willingness to learn and explore different solutions – thinking outside the box  






Our commitment to you

At the heart of CHU’s company culture is recognition of the value our team members bring to the workplace through their individual backgrounds, culture, strengths, creativity, ideas, shared experiences and access to a flexible work environment. Every applicant is assessed on what they can contribute to CHU and how they as individuals can enrich our workplace both now and in the future. We are a neuro-inclusive and disability aware employer and encourage applicants to openly request any adjustments they need. We are committed to creating a psychologically safe recruitment experience.

Develop clear and structured business specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria to support effective solution design and delivery.
Partner with technical business analysts, developers, and solution architects to support the design, configuration, and implementation of solutions that align with business objectives.
Contribute to solution validation by supporting testing activities, including defining test scenarios and ensuring outcomes align with documented business requirements.
Provide ongoing support to end users on platform functionality and best practices.
Continuously monitor and assess platform performance, identifying areas for optimisation and enhancement.

 

 Qualifications & Skills

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Admin, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.
7+ years relevant experience
Experience with one or more project manager methodologies and tools such as Microsoft Azure DevOps (ADO).
Business or Corporate banking/finance experience.
Knowledge or experience of business lending processes, including loan origination or credit approval workflows.
Experience working with IT delivery teams and Agile frameworks.
Familiarity with the Salesforce platform, configuration, Administration and ecosystem. 
Strong stakeholder engagement and workshop facilitation skills.
Solid understanding of CRM principles and practices.
Strong analytical skills to evaluate project requirements, scope, and constraints, and identify potential areas of improvement or optimisation.
Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including developers, analysts, testers, and stakeholders, to ensure that project requirements are met, and project outcomes are achieved.
Ability to deliver complex business analysis projects, with a focus on improving efficiency and driving business growth
nCino knowledge an advantage

Even if you haven’t ticked every box but this role resonates with you, don't rule yourself out just yet, we'd love to hear from you!
 

 Our benefits and culture
We are small enough to have an impact, BIG enough to make a world of difference and it starts with our people.
We support flexible working and pride ourselves in fostering a culture that is inclusive, diverse and collaborative. We are proud to be certified as a 2025 Great Place to Work for a fifth consecutive year, recognised on the 2023 AFR BOSS Best Places to Work list and listed as one of Australia’s Best Workplaces for Women in 2025. 
In line with our commitment to our people, we have a comprehensive array of benefits available to our employees:

Generous leave provisions (e.g. Annual Wellbeing day) and leave purchase opportunities
18 weeks of paid parental leave for primary caregivers
Thorough induction onboarding program
Fitness Passport along with other Health & Wellbeing initiatives
Gender affirmation leave
Income Protection Insurance
Community volunteering
and many more!

Our headquarters is based in Sydney CBD, and we have a national presence across Melbourne, Canberra, Brisbane, Perth and Adelaide.
 

 Eligibility
Australian Citizenship - To be eligible to apply for this position, applicants must hold Australian Citizenship at the time of application.
Security Clearance - To be eligible to apply for this position, applicants must be able to obtain and maintain a Baseline security clearance.
 

 How to apply
Applications close: 26 April 2026.  
Interviews will occur in parallel, so please apply ASAP.Enquiries: Careers@exportfinance.gov.au        To apply, please email your CV to Careers@exportfinance.gov.au      
By choosing to apply, you agree to the recruitment privacy policy.
We invite and welcome applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people, people from diverse cultural backgrounds, people with disability and members of the LGBTQIA+ community. 
If you are a candidate with a disability, let us know how we can provide you with additional support.
 

 About us
Export Finance Australia is Australia’s export credit agency.  
We provide finance to support Australian export trade and overseas infrastructure development across the Pacific and Indo-Pacific. Through our loans, bonds and guarantees, we support businesses – from small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) to large corporates – foreign governments and infrastructure projects, to take on the world. 
Working with banks, other government agencies and our partners, together we are helping drive international success for Australian businesses.
The reason our people join us, stay with us and grow with us is because they wholeheartedly believe in our purpose. They can see the impact we create for our customers.
We are a highly purpose-driven organisation. We seek to create an inclusive culture that values our customers and employees. Our people are expected to champion this and play a key role in achieving those outcomes. In working towards our strategy, our people display our IMPACT leadership behaviours of Frank & Fearless, Dexterous & Agile and Careful & Diligent
For more information about us, please refer to our website.

Our client:
   

  


 A globally recognised organisation operating across content, media and entertainment, with a large\-scale technology environment supporting teams across multiple regions.
 



 Their Applications team plays a key role in building, supporting and evolving core business systems used across the organisation.
   

  




 The role:
   

  


 This is a hybrid Business Analyst role sitting between technology and the business, combining requirements gathering, application support and systems improvement.
 



 You'll work closely with stakeholders across the organisation to understand processes, identify opportunities and deliver practical technology solutions \- while also supporting and improving existing applications.
   

  




 Key responsibilities:
   

  

* Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements and map processes
* Support and manage core business applications (access, performance, issues)
* Translate business needs into technical solutions and business cases
* Work with global IT teams on system improvements and projects
* Support data management, reporting and system integrations
* Drive continuous improvement across systems and processes


 Skills and experience:
   

  

* Experience as a
 **Business Analyst within IT / applications environments**
* Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills
* Experience supporting or administering business applications
* Understanding of
 **SQL / data / reporting environments**
* Experience working in
 **enterprise or complex environments**



**Nice to have:** 



* Salesforce or CRM system exposure
* BI / reporting tools (e.g. Looker, Domo, Business Objects)
* ETL / automation tools
* Project delivery or change management experience


 Benefits and additional information:
   

  

* 4 days onsite \+ Friday half\-day WFH
* Finish at
 **1pm every Friday**
* Work across global teams and systems
* Strong mix of business\-facing and technical work
* 2 wellbeing days \+ 5 additional leave days over Christmas
* Retail discounts, gym benefits, EAP \+ lifestyle perks


 How to apply:
   

  


 If you're looking for a role where you can work across both business and technology, take ownership of systems and drive real improvements \- this is a strong opportunity.
 



 Apply now or reach out to Sienna Coate Thompson at Talent International \- sienna.coatethompson@talentinternational.com for a confidential chat.

last_kept_snapshot.fit_source_text:
Turn complexity into clarity. Build systems that scale. Make real impact.
 



  





 This isn’t your typical BA role.
 



  





 We’re looking for a Business Analyst (Operations) who doesn’t just document processes, you challenge them, redesign them, and elevate them. Someone who can see the gaps others miss, connect the dots across teams, and turn operational chaos into seamless, scalable systems.
 



  





 If you’re driven by impact, love solving real business problems, and want a seat at the table where decisions are made, keep reading.
 



  





**What You’ll Own** 



* Reimagine how we operate. Identify inefficiencies, eliminate friction, and design smarter, scalable workflows
* Bridge business \& tech. Translate complex needs into clear, actionable requirements and system solutions
* Drive automation \& innovation. Spot opportunities to streamline, simplify, and future\-proof operations
* Partner with key players. Work closely with Operations, Product, Tech, Finance, and Leadership to deliver change
* Turn data into decisions. Uncover insights, define reporting, and influence strategic direction
* Make it real, from user stories to testing and rollout, you’ll see your ideas come to life



  





**What Makes You a Great Fit** 



* 5\+ years as a Business Analyst or Operations Analyst in fast\-paced environments
* You think in processes, systems, and outcomes, not just tasks
* You can translate tech speak into business sense (and vice versa) effortlessly
* Solid experience with CRM/ERP systems, integrations, and data flows
* Comfortable with Power BI, Tableau, Looker or similar tools
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments (JIRA, Confluence)
* Bonus points if you’ve worked in fintech, SaaS, or scaling businesses



  





**Why join us?** 



* Work on meaningful projects that directly impact how the business scales
* Collaborate with smart, driven, and supportive teams
* Be part of a fast\-growing environment where your ideas matter
* Opportunity to shape processes, not just follow them



  





**About us** 




 Finstro has been solving financial challenges within B2B Trade finance since 2012 and served global businesses with over $1 billion in Trade Payments.
 



  





 Finstro provides a complete cashflow management platform, enabling customer and supplier payments and providing innovative credit\-based solutions to help businesses grow.
 



  





 We are the solution to pay and get paid on terms that suit your business.
 



  





 If you have energy, ambition and want to work for a dynamic, rapid growth, FinTech business, there are exciting opportunities to advance your career by joining our global team.

last_kept_snapshot.fit_source_text:
UTS College provides a pathway for students into the University of Technology, Sydney (UTS), one of Australia's leading universities, and it is our vision to actualise potential and enhance lives through the power of learning, our actions and our people. Our purpose is to provide the best available opportunity for students to develop the knowledge, skills \& attributes they need to attain their goals through market\-leading courses, teaching excellence and an emphasis on the student experience.
 



  





 We currently have the opportunity for a Business Analyst to join the IT and Digital Services team on a 12\-month fixed term contract, reporting to the Systems and Business Analysis Team Leader.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 This position is responsible for:
 


* Gathering and documenting business requirements and develop user stories or requirements within agreed timeframes
* Using business requirements or user stories to create technical specifications with technical specialists
* Contributing to and maintaining standard and guidelines for business process improvement and business analysis techniques for UTS College
* Using various business analysis tools and methodologies to map and understand business processes
* Liaising between business stakeholders, Solution Architects, IT teams, and vendors to ensure alignment on project goals and deliverables.
* Facilitating meetings and workshops to gather input, validate requirements, and maintain engagement throughout the project lifecycle.
* Coordinating test strategies and perform testing and validation activities, including user acceptance testing (UAT), to ensure solutions meet specified requirements.
* Providing support throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring timely issue resolution, testing and change management and requirements traceability
* Creating process maps with business stakeholders through effective relationships
* Preparing and maintaining comprehensive documentation, including business requirements, system specifications, and user guides.



  





**About You** 




 To succeed in this role you will need:
 


* Bachelor degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent work experience)
* 4 \-6 years of experience in Business Analysis
* Experience with data and reporting projects, finance system implementation projects and system integration tools.
* High capability to document business requirements and develop business process maps
* Problem\-solving skills and experience with using structured problem\-solving techniques
* Highly developed stakeholder engagement skills, with demonstrated ability to communicate effectively, influence decision\-making, and manage expectations at multiple organisational levels.
* Experience with project management delivery tools like Jira, confluence. Creating requirements, user stories, test cases and dependencies and experience in agile ways of working
* Demonstrated understanding of, or certification in business analysis frameworks like CBAP is preferable
* Knowledge of Change Management approaches such as ADKAR
* Higher education and /or student lifecycle experience preferred



  





**What UTS College has to Offer!** 



* A flexible work environment, including working from home and from our convenient inner\-city campus within walking distance to Central Station.
* A diverse workplace with a passion for encouraging and supporting inclusiveness.
* Wellbeing programs including discounted gym memberships, free and confidential access to an Employee Assistance Program, wellbeing initiatives and resources.
* Continuous learning and professional development (including ongoing learning \& development opportunities, free LinkedIn Learning access and the UTS Library)
* An easy\-to\-use Staff Recognition Program
* Additional paid leave over the December end of year holidays
* A collaborative culture built on our Ethics of Respect, Integrity, Courage, Imagination, Compassion and Honesty



  





 If this sounds like you, we’d like to hear from you!
 



 For more information about UTS College visit utscollege.edu.au
 



  





*Please note that we are unable to provide visa sponsorship, and candidates are required to have full working rights for this position.*

The Project Business Analyst will play a key role in bridging business needs and program delivery by working closely with PVH PMOs, business stakeholders, the System Integrator (SI), and internal delivery teams.
   

  

 This role is responsible for defining, analysing, and translating business requirements into clear, actionable deliverables that support the successful design, build, and implementation of new processes, systems, and operating models, ensuring the transformation delivers measurable business value.
   

  

 Based at our Head Office in the heart of the CBD, located at 388 George Street, this is a full\-time,
 **14\-month fixed term contract** 
 , working from home and in the office weekly.

* Support the elicitation, analysis, documentation, and validation of business requirements across impacted functions and regions.
* Translate business needs into clear functional and non\-functional requirements.
* Work closely with SI functional consultants, solution architects, and developers to clarify requirements and support solution design.
* Review SI deliverables (e.g. functional designs, configuration workbooks, user stories) to ensure alignment with PVH requirements and standards.
* Analyse current\-state (“as\-is”) processes and design future\-state (“to\-be”) processes aligned to transformation objectives.
* Identify opportunities for process simplification, standardisation, and automation.
* Support testing activities including UAT planning, test scenario development, and defect triage.
* Assist with data migration, cutover planning, and deployment activities as required.
* Build strong relationships with key stakeholders across global and regional teams to drive clarity, alignment, and timely decision\-making.
* Identify and escalate business\-related risks, issues, and dependencies.
* Contribute to lessons learned and continuous improvement across the program whilst promoting best\-practice business analysis approaches within the project team.


**Skills, Experience \& Personal Attributes**
* Minimum 2 years’ proven experience as a Business Analyst on large, complex transformation programs delivered with a prime System Integrator (SI) partner.
* Degree in Business, Information Systems, or a related discipline (or equivalent experience).
* Strong understanding of SI\-led delivery models, including requirements, design, build, test, and deploy phases.
* Experience working on enterprise\-scale system implementations (e.g. ERP, supply chain, digital, finance, or merchandising systems).
* Strong process modelling and documentation skills.
* Excellent facilitation, communication, and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Experience working in global, matrixed organisations; apparel, retail, or consumer goods experience desirable.


**About The Company**
 PVH is one of the world’s largest and most admired fashion companies, connecting with consumers in over 40 countries. Our global iconic brands include Calvin Klein, TOMMY HILFIGER and our Heritage Brands. Our 140\-year history is built on the strength of our brands, our team and our commitment to drive fashion forward for good. That's the Power of Us. That’s the Power of PVH.
   

  

*PVH is an equal opportunity employer and considers all applicants for employment on the basis of their individual capabilities and qualifications ensuring a strong corporate commitment to inclusion and diversity.*
*We thank all applicants in advance as only successful applicants will be contacted for an interview.*

last_kept_snapshot.fit_source_text:
At Cotality, we are driven by a single mission—to make the property industry faster, smarter, and more people\-centric. Cotality is the trusted source for property intelligence, with unmatched precision, depth, breadth, and insights across the entire ecosystem. Our talented team of 5,000 employees globally uses our network, scale, connectivity and technology to drive the largest asset class in the world. Join us as we work toward our vision of fueling a thriving global property ecosystem and a more resilient society.
   

  

 Cotality is committed to cultivating a diverse and inclusive work culture that inspires innovation and bold thinking; it's a place where you can collaborate, feel valued, develop skills and directly impact the real estate economy. We know our people are our greatest asset. At Cotality, you can be yourself, lift people up and make an impact. By putting clients first and continuously innovating, we're working together to set the pace for unlocking new possibilities that better serve the property industry.
   

  

**Job Description**
 At Cotality, we are leaders in property data and real estate technology across Australia and New Zealand. We are seeking a Senior Technical Business Analyst to bridge the gap between complex stakeholder needs and high\-performance technical execution.
   

  

 Contribute to the design of system architectures and maintain coherent documentation for all data processes, and become the technical Subject Matter Expert of the systems your team manages.
   

  

 What You Will Be Doing
   

  

* Technical Implementation: Move beyond high\-level requirements to define the specific processes for data ingestion, transformation, and publication.
* Requirement Transformation \& Storytelling: Translate business needs into detailed technical user stories that provide developers with a clear, actionable roadmap.
* Data Interrogation: Use advanced methodologies to independently query and understand data assets, ensuring they are fit\-for\-purpose and reconciled accurately.
* Documentation \& Ownership: Design system architectures and maintain coherent documentation for all data processes, taking full ownership of the systems your team manages.
* Agile Collaboration: Work effectively within a scrum environment to deliver high\-quality solutions on time and within budget.


**Job Qualifications**
 What You Will Bring
   

  

**Essential**
* Advanced SQL Mastery: This is your primary tool; you must be able to independently interrogate complex data assets and script with precision.
* Analytic Curiosity: A proactive drive to perform root\-cause analysis and troubleshoot technical issues within data pipelines.
* Clear Technical Communication: The ability to provide concise technical messaging and engage with both internal and external stakeholders effectively.
* Experience \& Education: A minimum of 3 years of commercial experience in complex data environments, supported by tertiary qualifications in Information Science, Business, or equivalent industry experience.


**Preferred**
* Platform \& Development Literacy: Direct experience with BigQuery (or similar large\-scale environments) and a strong understanding of codebases and end\-to\-end technical development.
* Domain Knowledge: Previous exposure to property and attributes data assets is highly desirable.
* Modern Tech Exposure: Familiarity with APIs, event\-based pipelines, and cloud concepts (specifically GCP and serverless architecture).


**Why Join Cotality?**
 Cotality has a culture of collaboration\- we champion ownership, initiative and leadership! To support your whole self, our benefits are built to help you thrive at work and in life.
   

  

* In addition to modern offices across Australia and New Zealand, our hybrid working model provides you with the opportunity for flexible working conditions that work best for you and the business;
* 10 half days of Wellbeing leave each year to help you recharge and access to our Employee Assistance Program;
* $600 AUD annual wellbeing allowance for gym memberships, wellness apps, ergonomic gear and more;
* Generous Parental leave offering, $750 AUD in Baby Bucks and our peer recognition turned into rewards program \- Bravo!
* Free subscription to the Calm app as well as other mindfulness tools, online health and nutrition courses;
* Complimentary access to Australia’s most comprehensive property research platforms including RP Data and exclusive employee\-only market updates and access to the industry’s best property experts;
* Two community and volunteer leave days each year to support meaningful causes and our charity partners.


**Cotality's Diversity Commitment**
 Cotality is fully committed to employing a diverse workforce and creating an inclusive work environment that embraces everyone’s unique contributions, experiences and values. We offer an empowered work environment that encourages creativity, initiative and professional growth and provides a competitive salary and benefits package. We are better together when we support and recognize our differences.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer Statement**
 Cotality is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace across Australia and New Zealand. We recruit, hire, train, and promote individuals based on merit, qualifications, and business needs, without regard to race, ethnicity, colour, national origin, citizenship, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and maintaining a drug\-free workplace free from discrimination, harassment, and bullying.
   

  

 Please apply on our website for consideration.
   

  

 Privacy Policy
   

  

 Global Applicant Privacy Policy
   

  

 By providing your telephone number, you agree to receive automated (SMS) text messages at that number from Cotality regarding all matters related to your application and, if you are hired, your employment and company business. Message \& data rates may apply.
 **You can opt out at any time by responding STOP or UNSUBSCRIBING and will automatically be opted out company\-wide.**

-

* Proven experience delivering business analysis artefacts in Agile environments for complex ICT projects
* Strong capability in developing user stories and defining acceptance criteria for technical teams
* Demonstrated experience facilitating workshops and producing process maps, data models, and use cases
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage diverse stakeholders
* Experience in ICT service implementation and documenting requirements for enterprise technologies
* Familiarity with tools and platforms such as Azure DevOps, Dynamics 365, or Power Platform (desirable)

 As a 100% Australian owned and operated consultancy with a DISP Level 3 membership, we’ve built a reputation as a

* Business of the Year \- Australian Owned
* RCSA 'Excellence in Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging'
* RCSA ‘Excellence in Client Services’
* Prime Minister’s Veteran Employment Awards
* RCSA ‘Excellence in Social Purpose’

* Flexible work options (when available)

* Upskilling with RTO partners \+ budget for certifications
* Additional super contributions
* Fortnightly payroll
* Access to diverse, secure, and exciting programs

**Description**
* Accrue up to an extra 12 days of leave per year through our Life Days program.
* Work with world leading technology business at the forefront of innovation.
* We’re a ‘Family Friendly’ certified workplace – we understand the often many and varied roles our team members need to play within their own unique family setting and actively support them.


 Our team feel Leidos is a great place to work. Learn more about our culture and benefits by visiting us here https://www.leidos.com/company/global/australia/careers
   

  

**Do Work That Matters**
 Leidos Australia delivers IT and airborne solutions that protect and advance the Australian way of life. Our 2000 local experts, backed by our global experience and network of partners, are working to solve the world’s toughest challenges in government, intelligence, defence, aviation, border protection and health markets.
   

  

**Your New Role And Responsibilities**
 We are seeking a Business Analyst with experience in software applications to join a multi\-year Defence program to deliver an enterprise Health Knowledge Capability. This role involves working closely with stakeholders, software developers, and healthcare professionals to gather requirements, analyze workflows and business needs, produce the user stories, data availability assessments and system design criteria.
   

  

 This role will also work closely with the Service Design Lead, BRM, Clinical Advisers, the Training Coordinator and Maintenance personnel, and the Engineering Team to define controls, conversion procedures, and system implementation plans that, including user training and orientation.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities: \-
   

  

* Collaborate with stakeholders (clinicians, administrators, technical teams) to gather, analyse, and document business and system requirements.
* Analyze clinical workflows and identify process improvement opportunities through software solutions.
* Translate business needs into functional specifications and user stories; participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, and story refinement.
* Facilitate workshops and interviews to define functionality, system flows, and ensure alignment with user and business needs.
* Support system and user acceptance testing (UAT), ensure compliance with healthcare regulations, and assist in change management and training efforts.
* Create clear documentation, including process maps and user guides, and stay informed on industry trends and regulatory updates.


 What You’ll Bring to Make An Impact
   

  

* Proven experience in business analysis, ideally within clinical or healthcare software environments and on complex projects.
* Strong skills in gathering and documenting requirements in Agile or Waterfall methodologies.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to bridge technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Understanding of healthcare data privacy, security, and compliance requirements.
* Familiarity with healthcare workflows, clinical terminology, and standards such as FHIR, HL7, and SNOMED CT.
* Experience with tools and practices such as BPMN, Visio, Jira, Confluence, UX design, and relevant certifications (e.g., CBAP, health informatics).


 Don’t worry if you don’t tick all the boxes – if you meet most of them, we encourage you to submit your application. We’re most interested in your strengths, what you want to learn and how far you want to go.
   

  

*This role does require the successful applicant to be an Australian Citizen and hold NV\-1 security clearance.*
**Diverse Team Members, Shared Values and a Common Purpose**
*Providing our customers with smarter solutions takes an incredible team with diversity of thought, experience and perspectives driving innovation. Inclusion is at the heart of our culture and is one of our core values. It's about creating a workplace where everyone can do important work, feels welcome, valued, and respected, and has equal access to opportunities to thrive. Paul Chase – Chief Executive, Leidos Australia.*
 Leidos Australia is an equal opportunities organisation and is committed to creating a truly inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islanders, culturally and linguistically diverse people, people with disabilities, veterans, neurodiverse people, and people of all genders, sexualities, and age groups.
   

  

 Our five Advocacy Groups (Women and Allies Network, Young Professionals, Defence \& Emergency Services, Action for Accessibility and Abilities and Pride\+) provide an opportunity for team members to connect and collaborate on shared interests, and work to support and celebrate our diverse community.
   

  

**Next Steps**
* To apply for this role, follow the links or apply via our Careers page.
* Recruitment process \- virtual / face to face interview \& background checks.
* Applicants may also need to meet International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) requirements. In certain circumstances this can place limitations on persons who hold dual nationality, permanent residency or are former nationals of certain countries as per ITAR 126\.1\.
* We are committed to making our recruitment process accessible to all candidates. Please contact our Careers team careers.au@au.leidos.com if you’d like to discuss any additional support during your application or throughout the recruitment process.


 If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.
   

  

**Original Posting**
 For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above.
   

  

**Pay Range**
 The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline onlyand not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.
   

  

**About Leidos**
 Leidos is an industry and technology leader serving government and commercial customers with smarter, more efficient digital and mission innovations. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, with 47,000 global employees, Leidos reported annual revenues of approximately $16\.7 billion for the fiscal year ended January 3, 2025\. For more information, visit www.Leidos.com.
   

  

**Pay And Benefits**
 Pay and benefits are fundamental to any career decision. That's why we craft compensation packages that reflect the importance of the work we do for our customers. Employment benefits include competitive compensation, Health and Wellness programs, Income Protection, Paid Leave and Retirement. More details are available at www.leidos.com/careers/pay\-benefits.
   

  

**Securing Your Data**
 Beware of fake employment opportunities using Leidos’ name. Leidos will never ask you to provide payment\-related information during any part of the employment application process (i.e., ask you for money), nor will Leidos ever advance money as part of the hiring process (i.e., send you a check or money order before doing any work). Further, Leidos will only communicate with you through emails that are generated by the Leidos.com automated system – never from free commercial services (e.g., Gmail, Yahoo, Hotmail) or via WhatsApp, Telegram, etc. If you received an email purporting to be from Leidos that asks for payment\-related information or any other personal information (e.g., about you or your previous employer), and you are concerned about its legitimacy, please make us aware immediately by emailing us at LeidosCareersFraud@leidos.com.
   

  

 If you believe you are the victim of a scam, contact your local law enforcement and report the incident to the U.S. Federal Trade Commission.
   

  

**Commitment to Non\-Discrimination**
 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law. Leidos will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with relevant laws.

**Our Client**
 Our client is a large Federal Government department operating nationally, focused on strengthening Australia’s economic resilience through industry, science, and technology initiatives. With a workforce of several thousand employees, the organisation delivers complex programs that support innovation, digital capability, and sustainable growth. Its CIO division plays a key role in delivering enterprise ICT services and advancing digital transformation initiatives, including emerging technologies and AI\-driven solutions.
   

  

**Why Contract With Us**
 At Charter Diligence, we go beyond just placement — we support our contractors with practical benefits that reflect real\-life needs. All contractors engaged through us have access to early cash advances on approved timesheets, offering flexibility in cases of unforeseen expenses or cash flow challenges. Unlike traditional labour hire providers, we understand that life doesn’t always align with a pay cycle — and we're here to help when it matters most. Well, ask your mates if they’re already a Charter Diligence Contractor — chances are, they’re already benefiting from the support we provide.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst to support the delivery of complex ICT initiatives within a Federal Government environment. This role will focus on analysing business needs, defining requirements, and supporting the development of fit\-for\-purpose digital solutions across a range of enterprise projects.
   

  

 You will work closely with stakeholders, delivery teams, and technical specialists to translate business problems into structured requirements and contribute to successful project outcomes within an Agile delivery environment.
   

  

**Position** 
 : Business Analyst \- $800\-$1,200/day \+ super
   

  

**Location** 
 : ACT (Onsite)
   

  

**Working Arrangement** 
 : Onsite (flexibility considered case\-by\-case)
   

  

**Start Date** 
 : 1 July 2026
   

  

**Duration** 
 : 12 months \+ 2 x 12\-month extensions
   

  

**Application Window** 
 : Closing 24 April 2026
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Analyse current and future business processes and information flows
* Facilitate workshops and stakeholder engagement sessions to gather requirements
* Develop business scenarios, process maps, and data models
* Translate business needs into user stories and acceptance criteria
* Produce high\-quality documentation including business cases, specifications, and reports
* Collaborate with technical teams to define and deliver effective solutions
* Evaluate solution options and provide strategic recommendations
* Support delivery of digital and ICT projects within Agile environments
* Conduct research and analysis aligned with organisational policies and frameworks
* Contribute to service design artefacts, change management plans, and communication materials
* Use tools such as Azure DevOps to manage requirements and track delivery progress
* Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical solutions


**About You**
* Proven experience as a Business Analyst within complex ICT or digital environments
* Strong experience facilitating workshops and stakeholder engagement activities
* Demonstrated ability to develop user stories and acceptance criteria
* Experience working on Agile projects delivering complex IT systems
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent communication and presentation abilities
* Experience producing a wide range of business analysis artefacts
* Familiarity with tools such as Azure DevOps for backlog and requirements management
* Exposure to technologies such as Dynamics 365 or Power Platform (desirable)
* Experience with Office technologies and enterprise systems (desirable)
* Ability to work collaboratively across business and technical teams
* Must be able to obtain a Baseline Security Clearance
* Must have valid working rights in Australia (Australian Citizen or long\-term visa holders only; no sponsorship available)
* As a mandatory requirement for this contract role required by our client, applicants are kindly asked to complete a compliance check and upload their work rights verification at www.charterdiligence.com.au/portal. Incomplete submissions may not be considered. If you have any questions or need assistance with the process, please don’t hesitate to contact our team—we’re here to help.


**Additional Opportunities**
**Role**
 We are also supporting a broader Federal Government ICT program with individual contract roles available across the following disciplines (one position per role):
   

  

* Project Manager (LH\-06079\)
* Cloud Solutions Architect (LH\-06076\)
* Exchange System Administrator (LH\-06078\)
* Front End Developer / UI Designer (LH\-06082\)
* Business Analyst (LH\-06075\)
* Automation Tester (LH\-06074\)
* .NET Software Engineer (LH\-06073\)
* CRM Developer (LH\-06077\)
* Software Engineer (LH\-06080\)
* Senior Storage Infrastructure Engineer (LH\-06129\)


**Application Process**
**Important:** 
 Due to the high volume of applications and the limited submission timeframe, we may not be able to contact all applicants. This is not a reflection of interest, but a result of operational constraints. As part of mandatory government contract requirements, priority will be given to candidates who have completed all necessary compliance checks. For applicants with privacy concerns regarding work rights verification submission, documents may be presented in person at our local offices for sighting.
   

  

 We encourage candidates who are passionate about making a difference and possess the necessary experience and skills to apply. Please apply to this job post or submit your CV along with a cover letter detailing your qualifications and interest in the role to this job post. For confidential inquiries, contact our recruitment team at
 **recruitment@charterdiligence.com.au**

last_kept_snapshot.teaser: We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Business Analyst to join our Technology - Product & Solutions Delivery Team on a 6-month FTC.
last_kept_snapshot.fit_source_text:
Your opportunity 
Within Technology, the Product & Solution Delivery team designs, builds and evolves digital products and platforms that support enterprise operations and customer experience. 
Your role as a Business Analyst – Digital Technology is to support the delivery of digital products and technology initiatives by translating business needs into clear requirements, insights and solution approaches.
Day to day, your main responsibilities will include:

Analyse business needs and translate them into clear, structured requirements.
Facilitate discussions that help teams understand problems and define practical solutions.
Map processes and identify opportunities to improve systems and ways of working.
Develop user stories, documentation and analysis that support product and engineering delivery.
Evaluate whether delivered solutions meet business requirements and intended outcomes

 
This role is a fixed term contract opportunity for 6 months.
 
What sets you apart 
We are looking for a proactive, confident, and detail-oriented individual who enjoys working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate with multiple stakeholders
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Detail-oriented, with a focus on accuracy and quality
Excellent time management skills with the ability to manage conflicting priorities.
You are curious about how businesses operate and how technology can improve outcomes.

About us 
Scentre Group owns 42 Westfield destinations across Australia and New Zealand. We create extraordinary places and experiences that connect and enrich communities. 
We are focused on our customers and creating more reasons for more people to visit our Westfield destinations more often and for longer. 
With approximately 75 professions within our business, our team has the expertise to design, construct, operate, manage and market our Westfield destinations and platforms. 
We want to be the place where talent thrives. To support you thriving with us, we promise to respect, inspire and develop you, and that you will do work that matters. 
Diversity, equity and inclusion underpins our culture, and our vision is that ‘Everyone Belongs’. We foster a workplace experience where everyone feels valued, supported and motivated to realise their full potential. 
We aspire to create a workforce reflective of the communities in which we operate and encourage applications from everyone regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, cultural background, faith, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or life stage.  If you require support or adjustments during the application process, please contact us confidentially at scentregroupcareers@scentregroup.com. 
We offer a range of unique benefits designed to support your wellbeing, career development and lifestyle, including five days paid Life Leave on top of your four weeks annual leave (pro-rated for part-time), 18 weeks gender neutral paid parental leave for primary carers, with no qualifying period and super paid for the duration of the leave period and free parking at your local Westfield destination. 
Discover more about working with us. 
Applications close: Thursday, 7th May 2026 (unless filled prior).

last_kept_snapshot.fit_source_text:
Our User Access Management team is focused on strengthening how we design, assess, and manage identity and access across our Banking and Financial Services division. We are driving a transformation that places simplicity, efficiency, and strong security at the heart of our digital services, ensuring our people can focus on delivering great outcomes for our clients.
   

  

 At Macquarie, our advantage is bringing together diverse people and empowering them to shape all kinds of possibilities. We are a global financial services group operating in 31 markets and with 56 years of unbroken profitability. You’ll be part of a friendly and supportive team where everyone \- no matter what role \- contributes ideas and drives outcomes.
   

  

**What role will you play?**
 You will play a central role in shaping and refining our identity management policies and processes. You will work closely with engineers and agile delivery teams to translate business needs into clear requirements, contribute to feature refinement, and support the adoption of modern cloud‑based identity solutions. Your work will help ensure our access management practices are robust, scalable, and aligned with our broader transformation goals
   

  

**What You Offer**
* 3\+ years of experience in User Access Management, with strong knowledge of identity and access control principles and practices
* Hands‑on working experience with SailPoint IdentityIQ, including role‑based access control and business/IT role mining
* Familiarity with Privileged Access Management tools, such as CyberArk
* Experience in agile delivery environments, with the ability to participate effectively in agile ceremonies and collaborate across technical and non‑technical teams
* Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder engagement skills, combined with a proactive mindset and the ability to contribute to process improvements.


 We love hearing from anyone inspired to build a better future with us, if you're excited about the role or working at Macquarie we encourage you to apply.
   

  

**What We Offer**
**Benefits**
 At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that’s rewarding in all the ways that matter most to you. Macquarie employees can access a wide range of benefits which, depending on employment type, include:
   

  

* 1 wellbeing leave day per year
* Up to 5 additional service bonus leave days per year
* Up to 20 weeks’ paid parental leave for primary caregivers along with 12 days of transition leave upon return to work, and 6 weeks’ paid leave for non\-primary caregivers
* 2 days of paid volunteer leave and donation matching
* Up to 12 months’ gender affirmation leave, including 6 weeks’ paid leave
* Access to Employee Assistance Program and wellbeing benefits including skin and health checks, and flu vaccinations
* Access to a wide range of salary packaging options
* Access to a wide range of learning and development opportunities, including reimbursement for professional membership or subscription
* Hybrid and flexible working arrangements, dependent on role
* Reimbursement for work from home equipment


**About Banking and Financial Services**
 Banking and Financial Services is our technology\-driven retail bank. You will be part of a team that supports clients to achieve their full potential \- whether that’s buying a home, growing a business or investing to manage wealth.
   

  

**Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion**
 We are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and welcome all identities, including race, ethnicity, cultural identity, nationality, gender (including gender identity or expression), age, sexual orientation, marital or partnership status, parental, caregiving or family status, family and domestic violence status, neurodiversity, religion or belief, disability, or socio\-economic background. We welcome further discussions on how you can feel included and belong at Macquarie as you progress through our recruitment process. To learn more, contact our team by clicking here.
   

  

 Our aim is to provide reasonable adjustments to individuals who may need support during the recruitment process and through working arrangements. If you require additional assistance, please let us know in the application process.

Initial 12 months contract to work on CRM systems improvements, collaborating closely with Technical teams and business users. Hybrid work. Sydney.
 



  




* **Major CRM systems improvement project (Dynamics 365 and Digital platforms)**
* **Collaborative \& supportive team and approachable Manager**
* **Hybrid working environment (2 days in Sydney CBD Office)**
* **ASAP start**



  





  





**About the role** 




  





 We’re seeking a Business Analyst for an initial 12\-month contract to support a major CRM systems transformation for an expanding Not for profit organisation.
 



  





 You’ll work across discovery, process analysis, configuration guidance and stakeholder engagement as they improve their CRM systems.
 



  





 With a flexible hybrid model (2 days in the Sydney office), this position offers autonomy, influence and the chance to uplift core CRM functions with strong support from internal stakeholders and technical teams.
 



  





  





**What you’ll do** 




  




* Lead discovery and requirements\-gathering workshops, understanding products and platforms features.
* Analyse, map and document end\-to\-end processes, identifying pain points, inefficiencies and opportunities for redesign.
* Develop clear documentation including process maps, functional specifications, configuration guidance and data requirements.
* Translate specifications into epics and user stories that accurately describe user needs and related product functionality
* Participate in all product meetings including daily scrums and sprint planning to help identify project challenges and contribute to finding solutions
* Support the development of test plans, measure product performance and report on user\-acceptance analysis
* Contribute to continuous adoption and improvement of Agile methodologies
* Proactively contribute feedback and ideas for continuous improvement.



  





  





**What we’d love to see** 




  




* Minimum 4 years of experience in a similar business and technical requirements analysis position
* Strong experience working in Agile environments (Agile certification a plus) with a heavy emphasis on user stories and acceptance criteria through to deployment.
* Experience working with TDD and/or BDD frameworks
* Proven experience working with a multi\-disciplinary product team across all stages of the product development lifecycle
* Excellent documentation capability across requirements, process mapping, functional design and test planning.
* Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 or similar platforms highly regarded

last_kept_snapshot.fit_source_text:
**The Opportunity:**
 Nestlé is looking for an organised and motivated Business Analyst to provide expert support in cost and costing analysis. In this role, you will conduct complex research, interpret financial and operational data, and deliver well‑informed recommendations that strengthen decision‑making and drive business performance.
   

  

**A day in the life:**
 Reporting to the Technical/Operations Controller, you will:
   

  

* Perform period‑end accounting activities including labour hour reconciliations, overhead absorption, WIP/FG valuation, and expense provisions.
* Act as the central contact for variance analysis across factory production costs and overheads.
* Coordinate forecasting and reporting for Total Delivered Cost (TDC) and overheads, ensuring clarity of cost assumptions.
* Support business planning cycles and collaborate with factories and corporate finance on material price and master data queries.
* Lead TDC optimisation by identifying cost‑saving opportunities and supporting savings initiatives.
* Prepare, validate, and monitor CAPEX proposals in line with Nestlé investment policies.
* Ensure accurate application of costing guidelines and act as the single point of contact for inventory and subcontracting matters.


**What will make you successful:**
* Tertiary qualification in Finance, Accounting, or a related field (completed or in progress).
* Experience in accounting or costing, ideally within a factory or supply chain environment.
* Strong governance, risk management, and compliance mindset.
* Proficiency in business processes, systems, and effective planning rhythms.
* Ability to interpret strategy, align stakeholders, and communicate insights clearly.
* Strong analytical capability with the ability to deliver meaningful business analysis and reporting.
* Collaborative, organised, and solutions‑focused, with strong interpersonal skills.


**Benefits**
 You will have the chance to work with an outstanding and highly engaged team, build and grow your career with an inclusive, global FMCG leader.
   

  

 In addition, we offer:
   

  

* Varied career experiences and personalised development support
* Wellbeing benefits including vaccinations and health insurance discounts
* Diversity \& Inclusion initiatives and program
* Paid parental and partner leave
* Purchase Leave Scheme
* Volunteering leave, Sports leave, Emergency Services leave
* Discounted Nestlé products


**Our Story**
 Nestlé enjoys a reputation as one of the world’s largest FMCG companies and a leader in nutrition, health and wellness. Our inclusive and high\-performance culture is a testament to the great training, development, rewards and recognition we extend to every member of our 5000\-strong Oceania workforce.
   

  

 At Nestlé, you will work in a supportive environment where your ideas and points of view will be championed by a collaborative team. Together, we will drive the strength of our brands, the quality of our products, and the future of our business.
   

  

 In return you will have the chance to work with an outstanding team, and build and grow your career with an inclusive, global FMCG leader.
   

  

 We want to make finding your dream job possible. If you require additional support with your application, please contact us at careers@au.nestle.com
   

  

**Apply today!**

last_kept_snapshot.fit_source_text:
**Job Summary**
 We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
   

  

 As the Business Analyst you will be part of the team responsible for
 **building and supporting core business applications** 
 for UMG Australia. With your
 **proven BA experience** 
 and Application Support skills, you will continue to increase the value from existing systems, as well as being a key part of identifying new opportunities to deliver value across various teams within the business.
   

  

**Strong Business Analysts skills** 
 are needed to help guide requirements, building relationships within the business and presenting deliverables in clear language – then project managing these into successful business cases for budget and project completion using a combination of internal resources and external partners. Hands\-on administration of some systems like Salesforce.com, different reporting/dashboarding applications as well as SQL admin and ETL tools.
   

  

**Application Support** 
 across a wide range of business applications is another key part of this role, resolving issues within the team and partnering with Global UMG teams to solve issues in a timely manner.
   

  

 Technical background together with excellent communication skills are important parts of this role, dealing with customers across the business and being
 **able to communicate clearly and with impact** 
 .
   

  

 Job Functions
   

  

* Managing business applications day to day, resolving support cases around access and performance as a key part of the Applications Services team. Interacting with global IT teams for assistance and development of projects and cases.
* Administering systems for continual improvements and making sure the systems keep up with the changing music industry and the needs of the business.
* DBA work involves managing data in and out of the organisation as well as how data is stored and represented to systems for insight and analysis.
* Business analysis – partnering with the business on process mapping, guiding the conversation on options for technology, designing solutions and defining the benefits into a successful business case for funding approval.
* Striving to update the technology stack to take advantage of new tools and systems, reducing risk and costs.
* Keeping up with the latest technological developments in relevant areas, taking responsibility for your own learning and helping others on the same journey by sharing information and supporting a culture of collaboration and learning.
* Relationship management both internally in the local business, global IT community within UMG as well as external partners.


 Job Requirements
   

  

**Skills/Abilities**
* SQL skills – db admin, Stored procedure development, scheduling. Cloud db solutions from AWS, Azure, GBQ and MS SQL Server.
* Salesforce.com administration / development and managing custom\-built business applications.

We are seeking a Technical Business Analyst to join a well\-established international insurer at an active point in their transformation journey. This is a hands\-on role encompassing a claims automation initiative and a modern data platform launch, working closely with a local SME team and a global technical team.
   

  

 You will be responsible for mapping processes, capturing business and data requirements, and producing documentation that both technical and non\-technical teams can act on. The work cuts across underwriting, claims, and finance, so this suits a BA who can step in quickly, manage competing priorities, and deliver outcomes with confidence.
   

  

* Salary: $120k \+ Super
* Location: Sydney, NSW 2000
* 12 month FTC initially


**Responsibilities**
* Partner with stakeholders to understand business processes, systems, and automation opportunities, documenting current and future state
* Analyse and document business requirements across multiple functions, ensuring alignment to business and customer needs
* Translate business needs into clear business, system, and data requirements to support delivery
* Identify opportunities for automation and AI to improve operational efficiency and outcomes
* Map end\-to\-end processes including system interactions, data flows, inputs, outputs, and dependencies
* Capture data requirements including sources, transformations, and reporting outputs
* Support data platform and reporting initiatives by defining requirements and aligning with technical teams
* Review and challenge data models, SQL/dbt logic, and architecture diagrams at a conceptual level
* Prioritise initiatives based on business value, complexity, and delivery impact
* Manage multiple workstreams, maintaining strong stakeholder engagement throughout


**Requirements**
* Strong experience as a Business Analyst in a corporate environment, ideally within insurance or a complex business setting
* Proven experience working on data platform or data warehouse initiatives as a Technical or Data Business Analyst
* Strong analytical and structured thinking skills, with the ability to solve complex problems
* Demonstrated ability to translate business needs into clear system and data requirements
* Solid understanding of system interactions, integrations, and end\-to\-end data flows
* Experience with modern data tooling such as Snowflake (desirable), ELT patterns, and dbt or similar frameworks
* Familiarity with SQL and ability to interpret and challenge SQL/dbt logic at a conceptual level
* Understanding of data modelling concepts (facts, dimensions, grain), data pipelines, transformation layers, and data lineage
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across technical and non\-technical audiences
* High attention to detail with strong documentation capability
* Experience working in agile or hybrid delivery environments


**Benefits**
* Involvement in high\-priority projects that directly impacts operational efficiency
* Opportunity to be part of an AI forward thinking team
* Exposure to a large\-scale international business environment while working in a supportive, team\-oriented local culture


 Does this sound like you? If so, apply now!
