 Harvey Norman’s Information Technology Department’s core focus is to deliver innovative IT solutions by delivering crucial projects to achieve the strategic goals of the business.
 



**About the role** 




 Reporting to the Business Analyst Manager and based on\-site at Homebush West, you will collaborate with internal business stakeholders and the IT team to develop business case outcomes to company standards and secure senior stakeholder endorsement. You will also contribute to key project deliverables within the project delivery framework, including business cases, solution concept designs, and training documentation.
 



 You will;
 


* Deliver comprehensive business requirements and analysis, as well as planning and manage the user acceptance testing stage of projects.
* Model current and future processes, and document business requirements, including functional and non\-functional requirements.
* Manage and support business user acceptance testing activities, including documenting business test scenarios.
* Develop and maintain effective stakeholder relationships to drive high levels of customer satisfaction.
* Contribute to continuous improvement in business analysis methodology, including processes, tools, and templates. Provide oversight to peers, promoting consistency and adherence to best practice standards.
* Partner with technical teams to support solution design and ensure alignment with business and operational realities.
* Contribute to the development of transition materials to transfer business and system knowledge to the production support team.
* Provide process and functional knowledge to support pilot\-period activities and hyper care end\-user support.



**About you** 




 You will bring extensive experience as a Business Analyst in a similar role, with a proven track record of successfully delivering medium to large complex IT projects. Your strengths include analytical thinking and problem\-solving, enabling you to lead workshops to facilitate discussions and provide analysis for your proposed projects. Additionally, you will excel at identifying needs and opportunities for improvement.
 



*You will also have:* 



* Advanced analytical and problem\-solving skills, with strong attention to detail and a commitment to quality documentation.
* Experience in writing business and project documentation to support the implementation of technology solutions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to effectively communicate with business stakeholders.
* Knowledge of project management lifecycles and product implementation methodologies (waterfall, agile, hybrid).
* Proficient in asking the right questions of stakeholders to understand the underlying reasons behind processes.
* Strong ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously and prioritise competing deadlines.
* Expertise in the management and execution of end\-to\-end user acceptance testing (UAT).
* Ability to partner effectively with the business to ensure outcomes align with business needs and objectives.
* Tertiary qualifications in IT, Business or Engineering.



**This opportunity will provide:** 



* Access to Udemy an online training platform with over 5,500 courses
* Salary packaging and novated leasing options for eligible employees.
* Professional development and career progression.
* Experience working with an Iconic Australian Brand with global success in NZ, Asia, and Europe.
* A supportive team environment that celebrates diversity and promotes a healthy work and family life balance.
* Opportunities to make discounted purchases on a great range of products and services.



**Have we got your interest?** 




**Apply now** 
 to be considered to join our dedicated team.
 



 Please note that only people with the right to work in Australia should apply for this position.
 



 Recruitment Agencies \- thank you for thinking of us, however we do endeavour to fill our opportunities through direct channels wherever possible. If we find that we do need agency assistance, we’ll be in touch.

**Company Description**
 Showtime Consulting is a leading provider of Shielded Cloud and Digital Solutions. Based in Australia and New Zealand, we specialise in delivering secure, enterprise‑scale technology solutions across highly regulated environments. Our expertise spans cloud platforms, digital transformation, and complex systems integration, supporting both commercial and government clients.
   

  

 We partner with major organisations to deliver high‑impact programs that demand strong governance, quality delivery, and close collaboration between business and technology teams. Our focus is on building trusted relationships and delivering outcomes that enable long‑term business value.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are seeking an experienced Lead Business Analyst (Lead BA) to oversee business analysis activities for a large enterprise business unit, working within the SmartComms delivery program.
   

  

 In this role, you will work closely with the Iteration Manager, DOC Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), and the Technical Lead during Initiate and Deep Dive phases to define delivery scope, assess solution design and reuse, and contribute to accurate estimation. You will lead and govern all BA activities across multiple initiatives, ensuring consistent, high‑quality requirements, mock‑ups, and technical specifications are delivered in line with agreed standards and processes.
   

  

**Contract and permanent employment options available**
**Key Responsibilities**
* Act as the primary Business Analysis lead for a major enterprise business unit within the SmartComms program.
* Represent SmartComms in Initiate and Deep Dive sessions, working with the Iteration Manager, DOC SMEs, and Technical Lead to define scope, solution approach, level of reuse, and delivery estimates.
* Oversee all initiatives and streams of work, ensuring requirements, mock‑ups, and technical specifications are delivered to a consistently high standard.
* Identify overlaps and reusable components across initiatives to enable effective sequencing, dependency management, and resource allocation.
* Ensure agreed BA processes and standards are consistently applied, including requirements documentation, traceability, and playback sessions.
* Be accountable for the quality of outputs from all Business Analysts aligned to the business unit.
* Lead and facilitate playback of business requirements to the wider program for review and formal sign‑off prior to development commencing.
* Support DOC SMEs through Product Owner (PO) sign‑off activities.
* Identify, analyse, estimate, and manage Change Requests, ensuring impacts to scope, timelines, and delivery are clearly understood.
* Lead System Integration Testing (SIT) arrangements, coordinating with DOC SME testers and delivery teams.
* Approve deployments to higher environments once entry criteria and quality gates are met.
* Act as a key liaison between business, delivery, and technical stakeholders to ensure alignment throughout the delivery lifecycle.


**What You’ll Need**
* Extensive experience as a Senior or Lead Business Analyst within large‑scale enterprise delivery programs.
* Proven experience leading and governing BA teams across multiple initiatives or work streams.
* Strong background in requirements documentation and validation, including functional, non‑functional, and technical requirements.
* Experience working in Agile, iterative, or hybrid delivery environments.
* Ability to work closely with Technical Leads to understand solution design, dependencies, and opportunities for reuse.
* Experience supporting Product Owners and managing Change Requests through formal governance processes.
* Strong understanding of testing lifecycles, particularly System Integration Testing (SIT).
* Excellent stakeholder engagement, facilitation, and communication skills.
* Experience in insurance, financial services, or other highly regulated enterprise environments is highly desirable.
* Experience with SmartComms or document generation platforms is an advantage.


**Why Join Us?**
* Play a key leadership role on a large, high‑profile enterprise delivery program.
* Work closely with senior stakeholders across business and technology teams.
* Join a collaborative, outcome‑focused consulting environment with long‑term engagement opportunities.
* Enjoy flexible working arrangements and a culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.

 9/10
   

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time, temporary 12 months, with strong potential for extension
   

**Location:** 
 4 Parramatta Square (base) and McKell, Rawson Place, Sydney as required from time to time. Hybrid working, which is subject to change based on team needs or broader divisional and DCS flexible work policies.
   

**This role sits within the NSW Fair Trading in the Digital team.**
  

**Be Part of the Future of Fair Trading**
  

 At NSW Fair Trading, we've been on an exciting journey of transformation \- reimagining how we deliver for the people and communities of NSW. Through our recent organisational realignment, we've built a new operating model designed to put customers at the centre of everything we do, strengthen our regulatory impact, and enable our people to thrive.
   

 We're creating a more modern, responsive and risk\-based Fair Trading \- one that understands the needs of people and businesses, embraces collaboration and innovation, and delivers better outcomes across the rental, strata, property and consumer markets we serve.
   

  

  

 This next phase brings new and exciting opportunities to join us in shaping "the new way" \- where you can help design smarter regulation, improve customer experiences, and make a real difference for the people of NSW.
   

 If you're someone who:
   

  

 Thinks deeply about the needs of people and communities
   

 Is motivated by great outcomes, not just processes
   

 Wants to be part of an organisation that's transforming how regulation works
   

 …then there's a place for you in our future.
   

  

 Join us as we build a Fair Trading that's fit for the future \- one that's customer\-centred, evidence\-driven, and proudly focused on public value.
   

  

  

**About the team**
  

 NSW Fair Trading is responsible for the administration of property and consumer protection laws in NSW. The Fair Trading Digital team works collaboratively with key internal and external stakeholders to provide the best digital solutions for our customers.
   

  

  

  

**About the role**
  

 Fair Trading Digital is implementing a multi\-year Digital Modernisation Strategy. As a Senior Business Analyst you will identify, analyse and document business processes, systems, and other functional and non\-functional requirements to facilitate the decommissioning and migration of legacy systems onto a new Salesforce solution. Working with product managers, you will ensure that we deliver value, not just technology change, by translating business needs into a functional and sustainable product. You will also support technical solutioning, software integration, data migration and change activities.
   

  

 This critical and rewarding role requires a deep commitment to product excellence, process efficiency and "hands on" software implementation work. Enable an enjoyable and high performing culture and embody the "gold standard" for digital products in government.
   

  

  

  

  

  

**Your responsibilities:**
  

 ·
 **Collaboration \& stakeholder engagement:** 
 Lead discovery with internal stakeholders to elicit requirements via workshops and meetings. Build strong cross\-functional relationships by collaborating with product managers, service designers, architects and others to align scope, dependencies and user needs. Translate between business and technical teams, ensuring requirements are feasible, testable and designed for adoption.
   

  

 ·
 **Analysis:** 
 Conduct business and systems process analysis, at a complex level, resulting in data, process and software documentation and improvement recommendations. Determine integration requirements and support technical solutioning. Facilitate decision making by framing options, articulating trade\-offs and capturing decisions. Conduct impact assessments for changes across process, data, roles, and controls, documenting risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies.
   

  

 ·
 **Documentation:** 
 Create the documentation necessary to facilitate change and to add clarity to all stakeholders, both technical and non\-technical. This includes actionable user stories with supporting acceptance criteria, workflow diagrams, mock\-ups, data rules, security and accessibility considerations, and other communication resources. Ensure documentation is well\-organised, consistent, and up to date
   

  

 ·
 **Agile delivery:** 
 Participate in Agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, stand\-ups, retrospectives, sprint reviews and showcases. Support iterative design, delivery and continuous user feedback. Collaborate closely with product managers, delivery managers, designers and engineers.
   

  

 ·
 **Quality assurance:** 
 Conduct walkthroughs with engineers and testers. Ensure epics and user stories are well understood. Assist in preparing complete and accurate test scripts, coordinate UAT and complete some testing as required. Contribute to defect triage and resolution.

last_kept_snapshot.fit_source_text:
**This role is being offered as a 12\-month Maximum\-Term contract.**
 At PwC Australia, you will lead and support the company through the build or adoption of new technology, to protect against risk, and deliver valuable data insights that transform our technology capabilities. As an Lead Business Analyst, you’ll play a vital role in working on complex projects, gathering and analysing business requirements to ensure successful project delivery, working with clients across the firm.
   

  

**Why PwC?**
 At PwC Australia, your skills meet purpose. We tackle big challenges across industries like finance, technology, energy, and health—giving you the chance to make a real impact. Here, your growth is our priority. You’ll work with leading teams, explore new technologies, and unlock your full potential.
   

  

 Join a global community of more than 370,000 people who value bold ideas, collaboration, and lasting change. Together, we’re building trust and shaping the future.
   

  

**What you’ll do:**
* Mentor and guide the business analysis team, defining and standardizing analysis processes and frameworks.
* Lead stakeholder collaboration to gather and document detailed business requirements.
* Conduct analysis and research on systems, capabilities, and workflows, including process modeling.
* Design and manage user acceptance testing and ensure consistency and delivery of excellence.
* Collaborate with project teams and managers for planning, execution, feasibility studies, and impact analysis.
* Ensure alignment between business needs and technical solutions throughout the project lifecycle.


**What we’re looking for:**
* Advanced business analysis skills with proficiency in process engineering, workflows, and requirement elicitation.
* Knowledge of project management principles and Agile delivery frameworks.
* Expert facilitation, stakeholder management, and workshop leadership abilities.
* Experienced team leader managing technical experts or medium\-sized teams (5\-20\+ members), able to set annual priorities aligned with business objectives.
* Skilled in leading large, impactful projects and influencing stakeholders to support long\-term strategic goals.
* Competent in budget management and monitoring area spend.


**Technology Specific Experience**
* Skilled in applying LLMs, RAG, and AI agent workflows to business use cases, defining agent intent, inputs, outputs, controls, and success metrics.
* Collaborates with engineering and data teams on solution design, testing, and validation of AI capabilities in production.
* Familiar with platforms like Microsoft 365, OpenAI, ServiceNow, and knowledgeable of responsible AI principles including transparency and auditability.


**Industry Experience**
* Experienced in enterprise environments with complex processes and decision chains across multiple functions.
* Worked in cross\-functional operations including finance, risk, legal, HR, and IT.
* Involved in large\-scale digital, automation, and AI transformation initiatives supporting multi\-business unit adoption and change.


**Other Specific Role Requirements**
* Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving skills, with ability to translate between business and technical teams.
* Skilled in assessing and prioritizing AI opportunities based on value and feasibility, balancing ambition, risk, and delivery constraints.
* Experienced in process mapping, requirements definition, stakeholder engagement, and confident collaborating with senior stakeholders.
* Clear communication skills for executive and delivery audiences, supported by formal education in business or related fields and foundational AI training.


**What you’ll gain:**
* The opportunity to work with leading organisations and cutting\-edge technology that challenge and expand your expertise.
* Flexibility means trusting you to choose when, where, and how you work—balancing what’s best for you, your team, and your clients to grow and thrive together.
* Clear paths for career progression supported by continuous learning and leadership development.
* Generous leave entitlements including four weeks’ annual leave and float public holidays to support your work\-life balance.


 We know that perks are as important as your financial rewards. Explore all the benefits that PwC has to offer here.
   

  

**Ready to grow here and go further?** 
 Join PwC Australia as a Lead Business Analyst and make an impact that goes beyond the expected. Apply now and take your next step with a team shaping the future.
   

  

 We’re committed to treating all our job applicants fairly and with respect, irrespective of their actual or assumed background, disability, neurodivergence, or any other protected characteristic. We want you to have every opportunity to thrive in our selection process. In the application form, you can let us know what adjustments you require during our recruitment process and/or any workplace accommodations you anticipate needing to help you perform your role.
   

  

 No Agencies Please: We kindly request that recruitment agencies do not submit CVs in response to this advertisement. We are only accepting applications direct from individuals.
   

  

**713064WD**

**Senior Business Analyst \- Capital \& Commercial Insights** 









  


* Combine commercial finance acumen with advanced SQL capabilities to deliver insights and steer business performance.
* Permanent, full time role
* Norwest Sydney based with hybrid work arrangements



  






**We are Woolworths Group** 









  




 We are Woolworths Group. 200,000\+ bright minds, passionate hearts and unique perspectives connected by a shared Purpose – ‘to create better experiences together for a better tomorrow.’ It’s that Purpose that fuels our ambition to explore new ideas, make brave commitments and innovate better ways to meet the food and everyday needs of more than 24 million customers every week. 
 








  




 If you’re excited to turn today’s blue sky thinking into a better tomorrow for future generations, you’ll find yourself supported and enriched in a dynamic, inclusive and empowering workplace that reflects the diverse communities we serve. With a culture of genuine care, a flexible approach to work and opportunities across the group to grow your career and make a meaningful impact, the possibilities for what we can achieve together are endless.
 








  




**Welcome to the Finance Team** 









  




 We believe that the Woolworths Finance team is a high performing, innovative and diverse team across Australia and New Zealand, and is an amazing place to advance your career. 
 








  




 Our teams work in a flexible work environment, including working from home 2 days per week. We are committed to flexibility and believe that it should be mutually beneficial. 
 




  






**The Opportunity** 









  




 As a SBA you will maximise capital efficiency and shape the direction of future deployments. You will be 
 

 responsible for analysis and reporting for the performance of the investment program. This ranges from reporting top\-line performance to deep\-diving on drivers such as customer shifts, department optimisations, archetype roll\-outs and store inclusions. This role will use these insights to inform recommendations to the broader 360 team across retail banners. 
 








  




 Additionally, the role is responsible for building and managing trusted relationships with key business partners, including the Director of Format Development, Network \& Strategy, and the Director of Smarter Operations, and their teams. 
 








  




**What you'll do** 





  






 You are more than a reporter; you are a commercial advisor who translates complex datasets into store\-level strategy. More specifically you will:
 





 Conduct Post Implementation Reviews (PIRs) for AU\-Retail, identifying variances between proposed and actual results to extract strategic learnings.
 





 Undertake root cause analysis on POCs and Pilots, utilising financial and customer data to determine how to enhance specific programs.
 





 Build trusted relationships with the Directors of Format Development and Smarter Operations, acting as a "thought leader" in investment decisions.
 





 Ensure insights are incorporated into future deployment plans and help shape the future of the Woolworths network.
 





 Leverage SQL (BigQuery) and Looker to automate reporting pipelines and collaborate with Data Science teams to build scalable data assets.
 




  






**What you'll bring** 









  


* 3\-5 years of post\-qualification experience and a mastery of financial systems like SAP and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* CA/CPA qualification (preferred)
* Advanced data modeling skills with the ability to build "best\-in\-class" business cases that incorporate commercial and performance insights.
* Proven ability to negotiate and influence senior stakeholders, moving projects from initial concept through to successful implementation.
* Exceptional storyboarding and presentation skills, with a demonstrated ability to "make the complex simple" for diverse audiences.
* A deep understanding of capital programs, cost/benefit analysis, and the link between financial modeling and long\-term strategic objectives.
* An innovative and curious approach to problem\-solving, focused on identifying trends, root causes, and opportunities for capital efficiency.







  




**What you’ll experience** 









  


* Hybrid Flexibility: Blend in\-office engagement with work\-from\-home opportunities for a balanced work week.
* A global business with endless career possibilities around every corner and across every discipline – with valuable exposure to a vast and exciting business network.
* Team discounts across our range of Woolworths Group brands you know and love and a robust rewards program that celebrates and incentivises purpose\-driven work.
* 12 weeks paid parental leave for primary caregivers plus paid superannuation for up to 12 months while the Team Member is on parental leave \- eligible from the first day of employment







  




**Everyone belongs at Woolworths Group** 









  




 As one of the largest employers in Australia and New Zealand, we aim to create a truly inclusive workplace where everyone feels that they belong, can be their best selves, and reach their full potential.
 








  




 Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging are key to realising our purpose of better together for a better tomorrow. We recognise the value our team’s diversity brings to our business, customers, and communities and that teams with diverse experiences and backgrounds enrich our group and are better able to innovate and solve problems. 
 








  




 Woolworths Group is an inclusive, team\-first company and we value all skills and experiences. If you meet some, but not all of the requirements, we encourage you to submit your application.

 You are more than a reporter; you are a commercial advisor who translates complex datasets into store\-level strategy. More specifically you will:
 





 Conduct Post Implementation Reviews (PIRs) for AU\-Retail, identifying variances between proposed and actual results to extract strategic learnings.
 





 Undertake root cause analysis on POCs and Pilots, utilising financial and customer data to determine how to enhance specific programs.
 





 Build trusted relationships with the Directors of Format Development and Smarter Operations, acting as a "thought leader" in investment decisions.
 





 Ensure insights are incorporated into future deployment plans and help shape the future of the Woolworths network.
 





 Leverage SQL (BigQuery) and Looker to automate reporting pipelines and collaborate with Data Science teams to build scalable data assets.
 




  






**What you'll bring** 









  


* 3\-5 years of post\-qualification experience and a mastery of financial systems like SAP and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* CA/CPA qualification (preferred)
* Advanced data modeling skills with the ability to build "best\-in\-class" business cases that incorporate commercial and performance insights.
* Proven ability to negotiate and influence senior stakeholders, moving projects from initial concept through to successful implementation.
* Exceptional storyboarding and presentation skills, with a demonstrated ability to "make the complex simple" for diverse audiences.
* A deep understanding of capital programs, cost/benefit analysis, and the link between financial modeling and long\-term strategic objectives.
* An innovative and curious approach to problem\-solving, focused on identifying trends, root causes, and opportunities for capital efficiency.

last_kept_snapshot.fit_source_text:
**Exciting Opportunity for a Senior Business Analyst at Entelect** 




  





 Our growth across Australia and New Zealand is accelerating, and we’re looking for Strong Technical Analysts to join the team.
 



  





 Elevate your career at Entelect, where we prioritise people and nurture a culture of growth, collaboration, and innovation.
 



 Join a dynamic, multidisciplinary environment that encourages versatility, and provides individual attention to career development, including intentional and regular one\-on\-ones with leadership.
 



 Tackle complex challenges and make a meaningful impact alongside passionate professionals who inspire and support each other.
 



  





**What You'll Be Doing:** 




  





***Delivery***
*:* 




  




* Leveraging your expertise to develop world\-class web and mobile applications for leading organisations in South Africa.
* Using structured techniques (design thinking, UML, BPMN, process flows) for software solution diagramming.
* Creating wireframes, UI designs, and documenting customer journeys.
* Developing business requirements documents, functional specifications, and process flows.
* Facilitating user story sessions and backlog grooming with Agile tools.
* Analysing APIs for seamless integration.
* Engaging in various stages of the SDLC, from system design to analysis, scoping, and estimation.
* Researching innovative technologies and implementing them in projects to drive innovation.



  





***People***
*:* 




  




* Demonstrating maturity, motivation, and leadership in the workplace.
* Championing change within the team and fostering a collaborative culture.
* Collaborating with cross\-functional teams to tackle complex business challenges, driving continuous improvement.
* Mentoring and nurturing colleagues to uphold standards of excellence and accountability.



  





***Customer:***




  




* Building strong relationships and understanding customer needs to deliver impactful solutions.
* Managing customer expectations and identifying opportunities for service improvements.
* Ensuring compliance with data security and industry regulations.



  





**What We Need from You:** 




  




* A bachelor’s degree in IT, Engineering, other Sciences or a BCom in Information Systems.
* Minimum 6 years' experience working as a business analyst within an agile software development team.
* Solid understanding of computer science fundamentals.
* Strong knowledge of and experience in business systems and processes.
* Strong ability to translate business requirements into detailed specifications and interface with technical teams.
* Ability to architect and structure small projects within an enterprise environment.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills with a drive for continual improvement.
* Pro hybrid working model working from the office on average 2 – 3 times per week.
* A strong customer\-facing ability.
* Flexibility to work across a variety of different environments and tooling.



  





**What You'll Get from Us:** 




  




* Hybrid working environment
* $400 work\-from\-home setup allowance
* Birthday leave
* Hands\-on support from leadership through regular one on ones and quarterly reviews.
* Continuous development programs offering training in leadership and technical skills.



  





**What To Expect from the Recruitment Process:** 




  





 Our aim is to make the recruitment process as efficient as possible, keeping you informed every step of the way.
 



  




* The first step is an initial conversation with our talent team to get to know you better and introduce you to Entelect and all that we have to offer.
* The next step will be a 1\.5\-hour in\-person practical interview at one of our offices where you will meet some of our leadership team.
* Finally, if we are both aligned, we wrap up the process with salary discussions and present you with an offer of employment.



  





 Not quite ready but eager to learn more? Head to the Culture Site and complete the form to set up an exploratory chat. Our team understands that good things take time and are happy to wait until that time is right for you.

last_kept_snapshot.fit_source_text:
We're looking for a senior Product Owner / Senior Business Analyst to own the functional vision for a major enterprise program and lead business analysis across multiple workstreams. You'll be the bridge between client stakeholders and delivery teams, ensuring what gets built actually delivers business value.
   

  

**What you'll do**
 Own and prioritise the program backlog (epics, features, stories) across POS, SCO, store operations, and integrations. Define and maintain a product roadmap aligned to client priorities and platform constraints.
   

 Lead and mentor a team of Business Analysts, setting standards for documentation, story writing, and requirements traceability across workstreams.
   

 Drive requirements elicitation through workshops, interviews, process mapping, and store visits. Translate findings into clear, testable user stories with well\-defined acceptance criteria.
   

 Build strong relationships with client stakeholders and SMEs, facilitating decisions on scope, priorities, and trade\-offs. Present demos and progress updates to business audiences.
   

 Collaborate with Solution Architects, Program Managers, and QA to ensure requirements are technically feasible, well\-scoped, and tied to test outcomes.

**Job Description**
**What’s the Role:**
 The IAM Technical Business Analyst acts as a key bridge between business stakeholders, architecture, security, and delivery teams, translating business, regulatory, and technical needs into clear, implementable IAM requirements. The role supports complex IAM programs across Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) and Access Management (AM), ensuring solutions are aligned to enterprise security, architecture, and compliance standards.
   

  

 This capability is essential to reduce delivery risk, ensure IAM solutions meet business and regulatory expectations, and enable successful delivery of strategic IAM outcomes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Lead the elicitation, analysis, and documentation of IAM requirements across large‑scale transformation programs.
* Translate business, risk, and regulatory needs into clear functional and non‑functional IAM requirements.
* Define current‑state and future‑state IAM capabilities, including identity lifecycle, access governance, and operating models.
* Provide strong IAM and IGA domain expertise, supporting SailPoint IdentityIQ / IdentityNow implementations.
* Capture and document IAM integration requirements, including REST API, SCIM, and enterprise integration standards.
* Define requirements for access management and authentication using SAML, OAuth, OIDC, and platforms such as Ping, ISVA, and Entra ID.
* Partner with architects, engineers, and delivery teams to ensure traceable, compliant, and business‑aligned IAM outcomes.


**What do I need?**
* Proven experience as a Technical Business Analyst within IAM or cyber security domains.
* Strong understanding of Identity Governance and Access Management (IGA \& AM) concepts and practices.
* Experience working with SailPoint, including identity lifecycle management, provisioning, and access governance.
* Solid understanding of IAM integrations using REST APIs and SCIM.
* Experience capturing requirements for authentication and federation solutions using SAML, OAuth 2\.0, and OpenID Connect (OIDC).
* Experience working with access management platforms such as IBM ISVA, Ping Identity, and/or Microsoft Entra ID.
* Strong analytical and stakeholder engagement skills, with desirable exposure to large‑scale transformations, Zero Trust, and regulated environments.


**Why join us?**
 We’re obsessed with becoming our customers' \#1 banking partner for life and we’re looking for people who are passionate about helping us achieve that goal. In return, we’re committed to making Westpac the best place to work in the country. Here are just a few of the ways we’re already doing that:
   

  

* Special offers on banking products and discounts from top brands, including generous employee only mortgage rates!
* Flexible work arrangements to help you achieve a greater work/life balance, and a variety of leave options including Culture, Lifestyle and Wellbeing leave.
* Tailored learning and development opportunities to help your grow your career within the bank.
* Lots of opportunities to ‘give back’ to the Community by getting involved in our many volunteering initiatives.


**Create your future today**
 To get started, simply click on the APPLY or APPLY NOW button
   

  

 We’re all about creating a supportive and inclusive community. We welcome everyone no matter your age, gender, background, or abilities. We also provide additional support to welcome our veterans, Indigenous Australians and neurodiverse community.
   

  

 If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, you can find out more information and additional contact details by visiting the
 *"People with Disability and/or needing Accessibility Requirements"* 
 page on our website .

last_kept_snapshot.fit_source_text:
About Us 

Automic Group is Australia’s market leader in technology-driven investor administration. Combining proprietary cloud-native technology with expert service, Automic simplifies investor administration and governance for companies and funds. We provide the market's leading registry, employee share plans, IR analytics, and fund administration services for over 1,400 ASX-listed and unlisted organisations.  

Automic’s culture is collaborative, inclusive, and purpose driven. It is grounded in our mission to connect companies and funds to their investors through technology, service, and trust, and guided by our values of One Automic, Go Beyond, Empowered, and Accountable. 
About the Role 

We’re looking for a Business Analyst – Transitions to support the successful delivery of Listed Registry and Employee Share Plan (ESP) client transitions. 

In this role, you’ll sit at the intersection of client requirements, operational processes, and system delivery, ensuring that business needs are clearly defined, documented, and translated into high-quality outcomes. You’ll play a key role across the full transition lifecycle—from requirements gathering through to testing and implementation. 

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys structured problem-solving, stakeholder engagement, and working across complex financial services environments. 

Role Responsibilities: 


	
	Engage stakeholders to elicit, document, and validate business and system requirements  
	



	
	Translate requirements into functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria  
	



	
	Maintain traceability between business needs, solution design, and delivery  
	



	
	Document current and future state processes across registry operations, corporate actions, and ESP workflows  
	



	
	Identify process gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities  
	



	
	Support operational readiness by ensuring processes are clearly defined  
	



	
	Support planning and execution of multiple client transition projects  
	



	
	Work closely with Project Managers, Solution Analysts, and Data teams  
	



	
	Assist in defining data requirements and business rules  
	



	
	Develop test scenarios, test cases, and acceptance criteria  
	



	
	Support System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT)  
	



	
	Assist with defect triage and resolution 
	

Skills and Experience 


	
	Proven experience as a Business Analyst within financial services  
	



	
	Experience in registry, capital markets, or Employee Share Plans (ESP) highly regarded  
	



	
	Strong requirements elicitation and documentation skills  
	



	
	Experience with process mapping and business process design  
	



	
	Strong stakeholder engagement and workshop facilitation capability  
	



	
	Understanding of data, systems, and integration concepts  
	



	
	Experience supporting testing phases (SIT/UAT)  
	



	
	High attention to detail with a structured, analytical approach 
	


About you! 

You’re a structured and detail-oriented Business Analyst who thrives in project-driven, fast-paced environments. You’re confident working with stakeholders, asking the right questions, and translating complex requirements into clear, actionable outputs. 

You bring a proactive mindset and enjoy working collaboratively to deliver high-quality outcomes. 

To succeed in this role you will demonstrate: 


	
	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills  
	



	
	Excellent communication and stakeholder management capability  
	



	
	A structured and organised approach to work  
	



	
	Attention to detail and commitment to quality  
	



	
	The ability to manage multiple priorities across projects  
	



	
	A proactive, solutions-focused mindset 
	


Why join Automic: 

You’ll be part of a team where operational excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement are genuinely valued. This is an opportunity to deepen your expertise, contribute to meaningful outcomes, and grow your career within a high-performing, purpose-led fintech environment. 

Key Benefits include: 


	
	Hybrid working  
	



	
	A High growth, scale-up organisation 
	



	
	Professional career growth & development  
	



	
	Supportive & fast paced environment 
	


 

If the above sounds like you, please apply for this exciting opportunity and be part of the growth journey at Automic! 

 

Applications will be reviewed as they are received and interviews may commence prior to the closing date.

We provide the market's leading registry, employee share plans, IR analytics, and fund administration services for over 1,400 ASX-listed and unlisted organisations.  

Automic’s culture is collaborative, inclusive, and purpose driven. It is grounded in our mission to connect companies and funds to their investors through technology, service, and trust, and guided by our values of One Automic, Go Beyond, Empowered, and Accountable. 
About the Role 

We’re looking for a Business Analyst – Transitions to support the successful delivery of Listed Registry and Employee Share Plan (ESP) client transitions. 

In this role, you’ll sit at the intersection of client requirements, operational processes, and system delivery, ensuring that business needs are clearly defined, documented, and translated into high-quality outcomes. You’ll play a key role across the full transition lifecycle—from requirements gathering through to testing and implementation. 

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys structured problem-solving, stakeholder engagement, and working across complex financial services environments. 

Role Responsibilities: 


	
	Engage stakeholders to elicit, document, and validate business and system requirements  
	



	
	Translate requirements into functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria  
	



	
	Maintain traceability between business needs, solution design, and delivery  
	



	
	Document current and future state processes across registry operations, corporate actions, and ESP workflows  
	



	
	Identify process gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities  
	



	
	Support operational readiness by ensuring processes are clearly defined  
	



	
	Support planning and execution of multiple client transition projects  
	



	
	Work closely with Project Managers, Solution Analysts, and Data teams  
	



	
	Assist in defining data requirements and business rules  
	



	
	Develop test scenarios, test cases, and acceptance criteria  
	



	
	Support System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT)  
	



	
	Assist with defect triage and resolution 
	

Skills and Experience 


	
	Proven experience as a Business Analyst within financial services  
	



	
	Experience in registry, capital markets, or Employee Share Plans (ESP) highly regarded  
	



	
	Strong requirements elicitation and documentation skills  
	



	
	Experience with process mapping and business process design  
	



	
	Strong stakeholder engagement and workshop facilitation capability  
	



	
	Understanding of data, systems, and integration concepts  
	



	
	Experience supporting testing phases (SIT/UAT)  
	



	
	High attention to detail with a structured, analytical approach 
	


About you! 

You’re a structured and detail-oriented Business Analyst who thrives in project-driven, fast-paced environments. You’re confident working with stakeholders, asking the right questions, and translating complex requirements into clear, actionable outputs. 

You bring a proactive mindset and enjoy working collaboratively to deliver high-quality outcomes. 

To succeed in this role you will demonstrate: 


	
	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills  
	



	
	Excellent communication and stakeholder management capability  
	



	
	A structured and organised approach to work  
	



	
	Attention to detail and commitment to quality  
	



	
	The ability to manage multiple priorities across projects  
	



	
	A proactive, solutions-focused mindset 
	


Why join Automic: 

You’ll be part of a team where operational excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement are genuinely valued. This is an opportunity to deepen your expertise, contribute to meaningful outcomes, and grow your career within a high-performing, purpose-led fintech environment. 

Key Benefits include: 


	
	Hybrid working  
	



	
	A High growth, scale-up organisation 
	



	
	Professional career growth & development  
	



	
	Supportive & fast paced environment 
	


 

If the above sounds like you, please apply for this exciting opportunity and be part of the growth journey at Automic! 

 

Applications will be reviewed as they are received and interviews may commence prior to the closing date.

last_kept_snapshot.fit_source_text:
BAE Systems Digital Intelligence is home to 4,500 digital, cyber and intelligence experts. We work collaboratively across 10 countries to collect, connect and understand complex data, so that governments, nation states, armed forces and commercial businesses can unlock digital advantage in the most demanding environments.
Business Analyst
About us
We are seeking talented people to help our customers scope, design and roll out capabilities and grow our existing team. This role will be focused on supporting our customers mission, protecting themselves and others from security risks and implementing new capabilities across a variety of ICT and operational technology (OT) systems. You have BA experience and appreciate what it means to work in a flexible Consulting team, where the tasks from day to day vary according to the differing shape and status of projects and customer needs. You are passionate about enabling customers to achieve their goals and working with your team to get things done. 
About the role
You will be responsible for:

Identification and documentation of stakeholders and their needs and drivers
Facilitating scoping and business priority setting for small, medium or large capability changes, engaging stakeholders as required
Eliciting and authoring scoping document business requirements, system requirements and business processes.
Capture and evaluation of both ‘pain points’ and ideas for improvement, prioritising possible improvements and obtaining buy-in for an improvement plan
Taking an active role in stakeholder workshops
Supporting business development teams as needed, contributing to consulting elements of client responses
Authoring relevant business change-related materials to support rollout of new capabilities
Research into potential tools clients may need to satisfy requirement
Working with engineering teams to ensure they get the information they need from business stakeholders
Highlighting potential opportunities for business growth
Contributing to the development of others and the internal Consulting practice
Maintaining an awareness of the various BAE Systems capabilities

Functional requirements

Must hold a PV clearance
Willingness to travel to client sites for project work

Key skills and experience

Previous Business Analysis experience including:

Authoring of different levels of requirements
Engaging with stakeholders of different types, seniority etc
Running meetings/workshops to elicit information, demonstrate systems etc
Defining as-is and to-be processes
Creation of various artefacts to communicate concepts that are well structured, appropriate for the audience and tell the story in a concise and logical way
Working with engineering teams as part of coherent project delivery

Communicates fluently, orally and in writing, and can present complex information to both technical and non-technical audiences when engaging with colleagues or users/customers
Has attention to detail, is proactive and organised
Is flexible, willing to get involved in a variety of tasks with different people across different projects or internal tasks
Demonstrable stakeholder management and engagement experience 
Takes responsibility for delivering outputs, including work packages and small projects
Shares knowledge and expertise with others
Is able to respond to setbacks in an agile and resilient manner
Maintains an awareness of developing practices and their application and takes responsibility for driving own development

Why BAE Systems?
This is a place where you’ll be able to make a real difference. You’ll be part of an inclusive culture that values diversity of thought, rewards integrity, and merit, and where you’ll be empowered to fulfil your potential. We welcome people from all backgrounds and want to make sure that our recruitment processes are as inclusive as possible. If you have a disability or health condition (for example dyslexia, autism, an anxiety disorder etc.) that may affect your performance in certain assessment types, please speak to your recruiter about potential reasonable adjustments.
Please be aware that many roles at BAE Systems are subject to both security and export control restrictions. These restrictions mean that factors such as your nationality, any nationalities you may have previously held, and your place of birth can restrict the roles you are eligible to perform within the organisation.

last_kept_snapshot.fit_source_text:
**About KPay Group** 




  





 KPay Group (KPay) is a leading fintech company dedicated to empowering businesses of all sizes with simple, smart, seamless, and secure technology solutions. Serving over 80,000 merchants across Hong Kong, Singapore, Japan and Australia, KPay is unleashing merchants' growth potential by building a one\-stop platform for financial management, business operations and digital transformation. KPay secured a record USD55 million in 2024, marking the largest series A fundraise globally in the payments sector of the year.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 We are looking for a sharp, analytical, and driven Business Analytics Associate to become the operational engine of our growth teams. This is not a passive, report\-pulling role. You will be embedded in the business, using data to diagnose problems, pinpoint growth opportunities, and drive key initiatives in our sales, partnership, and market expansion efforts. You will be the link between raw data and actionable strategy, playing a pivotal role in scaling our operations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 Data Analysis \& Insight Generation:
 


* Own the daily and weekly reporting of key performance indicators (KPIs) for the sales and partnerships teams (e.g., lead conversion rates, pipeline health, partner performance).
* Conduct deep\-dive analysis into sales sectors, partner ecosystems, and customer lifecycle to uncover trends, bottlenecks, and opportunities for optimization.
* Transform complex data into clear, compelling insights and visualizations that empower the leadership team to make data\-driven decisions.



 Sales \& Growth Operations:
 


* Act as the data backbone for the sales team, helping to identify high\-potential leads and optimize outreach strategies.
* Analyze individual and team performance to provide actionable feedback for coaching and improvement.
* Manage and ensure the integrity of our data platforms and other operational tools.



 Partnership Strategy Support:
 


* Provide analytical support for the partnerships team by researching potential partners, modeling the financial impact of deals, and tracking post\-launch performance.
* Help build business cases and presentations for new strategic partnership opportunities.



 Process Optimization \& Execution:
 


* Identify operational inefficiencies across sales and partner onboarding processes.
* Design, build, and automate dashboards, reports, and operational playbooks to enhance team productivity and scalability.
* Lead or contribute to cross\-functional projects aimed at solving core business challenges.



  





**Who You Are** 




  




* You are a results\-driven problem\-solver who is never satisfied with the surface\-level "what," but always digs into the "why."
* You have a "get things done" mentality. You are proactive, resourceful, and thrive in a fast\-paced, ambiguous environment where you must create structure.
* You are deeply analytical and fluent in the language of data. You are proficient in tools like Excel/Google Sheets (pivot tables, VLOOKUPs are a must); experience with SQL, Python, or data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI) is a huge plus.
* You are a clear communicator who can translate complex data into simple, actionable recommendations for both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* You are business\-curious, with a strong interest in understanding how sales, partnerships, and operations drive growth in a fintech company.



  





**Requirements** 




  




* 0\-2 years of professional experience. We value demonstrable problem\-solving skills, a stellar work ethic, and a rapid learning ability above all.
* A strong academic background or demonstrable project experience in a quantitative or analytical field is preferred.
* A first\-round case study interview is required to demonstrate your analytical and problem\-solving skills.



  





**What We Offer** 




  




* Unparalleled leadership exposure and the opportunity to shape the strategic direction of a high\-growth fintech company.
* A role at the intersection of everything – you will see the direct impact of your work on revenue and company growth.
* A steep learning curve and mentorship from seasoned professionals.

**Who Is Lumi?** 




 We’re a leading Fintech small business lender fuelling growth by making finance more accessible.
 



 We deliver fast \& flexible funding designed to meet the unique needs of Australian businesses. With over $1\.5 billion funded since 2018 and backing for 15,000\+ small businesses, we're trusted for our speed, high quality service, and tailored approach.
 



  





**Working At Lumi** 




 We are building a culture where you can grow and make a difference for customers. We are looking for people to join us on this journey who are passionate, curious and great problem\-solvers.
 



 We are incredibly proud of our awards, including most recently our Deputy CEO, Anna Hawter, receiving the Finnies’ 2025 Outstanding FinTech Leader of the Year award. We also ranked in the top \#3 on the 2024 Australian Financial Review BOSS Best Places to Work Banking, Superannuation and Financial Services list, 2023 Best Workplace Diversity Award by FinTech Australia and the 2022 Empowering Innovation Affie Award. We also ranked \#36 among the fastest\-growing technology companies in Australia in the 2022 Deloitte Technology Fast 50 Australia.
 



 We foster a workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging and respect and can reach their full potential. If you need any adjustments for a fair recruitment process, please let us know when applying.
 



  





**Our Values** 




 Egos at the door
 



 We own. We don’t judge. We don’t blame. We are open. We are in this together. We are respectful.
 



 See the customer
 



 We show up. We understand. We anticipate. We do what we say. We genuinely focus on solutions.
 



 Think lean
 



 We make things simple. We are resourceful. We understand the problem. We think ahead.
 



 Learn to grow
 



 We are curious. We challenge. We try. We fail forward. We learn. We try again.
 



  





**The Role** 




 ● Primarily conduct analysis and reviews of individual applications to validate Lumi’s automated decisioning process.
 



 ● Prepare and generate regular reports and develop clear and concise presentations to communicate insights and findings to stakeholders effectively.
 



 ● Analyse data, identifying trends, patterns and potential areas of concern. Provide valuable recommendations to enhance our risk management and automation strategies.
 



 ● Participate in initiatives to enhance our streamlined credit risk decisioning process, contributing to increased efficiency and accuracy in our credit risk function.
 



 ● Support various credit risk projects, including the enhancement of credit risk systems and automated decisioning processes.
 



  





**This Person Is Someone With** 




 ● Previous working experience as a Credit Analyst/Underwriter operating within a DLA is essential.
 



 ● Experience with SME credit assessment and an understanding of the SME market is preferred.
 



 ● Tertiary qualification in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field (or equivalent relevant experience)
 



 ● Strong understanding of financial concepts and credit risk fundamentals.
 



 ● Basic knowledge of SQL, Python and/or visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, PowerBI) is considered an advantage.
 



 ● Excellent attention to detail, and strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
 



 ● Strong communication and presentation abilities.
 



  





**Perks \& Benefits** 




 Wellbeing: Free counselling, seasonal activities, Wellbeing Allowance, wellness room, flu shots
 



 Work Life: Home Workspace Allowance, Purchased Leave, Parental Leave, Parental Flex Leave, Lumi Life Leave for challenging events, breastfeeding/expressing space
 



 Social \& Food: Monthly lunches, regular celebrations, stocked kitchen, beer \& kombucha on tap, board games, rooftop BBQs
 



 Rewards \& Recognition: Competitive pay, referral bonuses, shout\-out recognitions
 



 Community Support: Paid volunteer leave, cultural celebrations, company volunteer days
 



 Career \& Growth: Rapid advancement opportunities, higher education sponsorship, hackathons

**About the Role:** 




 We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst to join a major software implementation and consolidation program. This role will play a critical part in analysing current systems and processes, defining future\-state requirements, and supporting the successful delivery of a new consolidated platform.
 



 Working closely with Project Managers, Developers, and the external software vendor, you will act as the key bridge between business stakeholders and the technical delivery teams. You will ensure requirements are clearly defined, understood, and translated into effective solutions that meet business needs.
 








**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Elicit, analyse, and document business and functional requirements across multiple stakeholder groups
* Facilitate workshops and stakeholder interviews to understand current\-state processes and identify improvement opportunities
* Translate business needs into clear user stories, functional specifications, and process documentation
* Work closely with Project Managers to support planning, scope management, and delivery milestones
* Collaborate with developers and the vendor to clarify requirements and ensure alignment with the solution design
* Support solution configuration, integration discussions, and data migration activities
* Assist with test planning, user acceptance testing (UAT), and validation of delivered functionality
* Help drive business process standardisation as part of the system consolidation
* Provide ongoing communication and updates to stakeholders throughout the program lifecycle








**Key Skills \& Experience:** 



* Proven experience as a Business Analyst working on software implementation or transformation programs
* Strong experience gathering and documenting requirements (BRDs, user stories, process maps)
* Experience working in cross\-functional project teams including project managers, developers, and external vendors
* Strong stakeholder engagement and facilitation skills
* Experience supporting system consolidation, migration, or large\-scale platform implementations
* Familiarity with Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery environments
* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving capability
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills








**Desirable:** 



* Experience with enterprise systems within the Financial Services domain
* Specific expertise around Loan Origination, Credit, Mortgages, Internet banking
* Experience supporting testing, UAT coordination, or change management activities








**Why Join Us:** 



* Work on a high\-impact transformation program
* Collaborate with experienced project and technology teams
* Opportunity to shape future\-state systems and business processes







 This role is 5 days in office.

**Job Description**

 At
 **Ampol** 
 , we believe in the Power of Us \- the extraordinary power of people to connect, act, and make a difference.
   

  

  

  

 As a leading energy company operating across Australia, New Zealand, Singapore and from the United States, our work spans fuel supply, energy solutions, convenience retail, infrastructure, trading and shipping. Every role at Ampol plays a part in something bigger \- powering progress for our customers, communities, and people.
   

  

 Your career here is yours to shape. We back our people with real opportunities, the tools to grow, and a culture that rewards ownership and initiative. Whether you’re deepening your expertise or taking on something new, we’ll support you to power a career that works for you.
   

  

 We’re building a workplace where everyone feels welcome, respected, and valued \- because when people are free to be themselves, powerful things happen.
   

  

  

  

**About Group Corporate**
  

 Our Group teams enable the broader business to perform \- providing strategic, financial, legal, people and governance expertise. With roles across Australia, Singapore and the US, we’re critical partners to the business and help shape Ampol’s future.
   

  

 We work across borders, collaborate widely, and lead with purpose \- always looking for ways to improve how we operate, support our people, and deliver results.
   

  

  

  

**About the role**
  

 The Senior Business Analyst will support the Finance workstream on an integration project, reporting to the Head of Finance Transformation. The role will work closely with Finance stakeholders across the Group to support Day 1 readiness, transition reporting, and ongoing integration activities.
   

  

 This is a highly stakeholder intensive role requiring deep engagement across Group Finance, Shared Services, and Business Unit Finance teams to understand current operations, align future state design, and drive agreement on Finance integration outcomes.
   

  

 The role has a strong focus on current state and future state Finance process mapping, underpinned by technical accounting knowledge and SAP centric systems expertise. The primary system focus is SAP (ECC and S4H), with downstream consolidation and reporting tools such as OneStream considered where they consume SAP outputs.
   

  

 This role is a
 **12\-month, fixed\-term contract** 
 based in our
 **Alexandria** 
 NSW office. Ampol offer a hybrid working arrangement but there is a strong onsite presence required for this role.
   

  

  

  

**Key responsibilities**



* Act as the finance\-facing Senior Business Analyst owning Finance integration analysis and delivery
* Establish and maintain trusted relationships with senior Group Finance including Shared Services, and Business Unit Finance stakeholders
* Lead Finance stakeholder engagement to understand current processes, pain points, close requirements, and operational constraints
* Facilitate Finance workshops and deep dives to elicit, challenge, and align requirements across diverse stakeholder groups
* Lead end\-to\-end as\-is and to\-be Finance process mapping across Record\-to\-Report, Order to Cash and Procure to Pay.
* Identify process gaps, risks, manual workarounds, and control impacts, and recommend pragmatic Day\-1 and transition\-state solutions
* Translate Finance process, accounting, reporting, and SAP needs into clear business, functional, and data requirements
* Work closely with Group Reporting and Technical Accounting teams to ensure Finance integration considerations support compliant, audit\-readyoutcomes
* Lead Finance\-side SAP impact analysis across ECC and S/4HANA, including structures, data flows, and close dependencies
* Collaborate with Technology and SAP teams to support configuration, testing, and Day\-1 readiness, with awareness of downstream reporting tools



**Qualifications \& Experience**



* Extensive experience as a Business Analyst in complex Finance and ERP integration environments
* Proven ability to engage, influence, and partner effectively with senior finance leaders and cross\-functional stakeholders
* Strong background in Finance process analysis, mapping and redesign across end to end Finance value chains
* Deep understanding of core Finance processes including Record\-to\-Report, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay.
* Hands\-on SAP Finance experience across ECC and or S/4HANA, with the ability to articulate complex Finance and SAP concepts to varied audiences
* CA/CPA qualification is highly desirable



**Benefits**



* Our total remuneration is competitive.
* We are flexible. Many of our teams have embraced hybrid work, balancing time spent remote working, with time spent at an office to connect and work together where it adds value.
* We value recognition.  We have an internal recognition platform amplifying the achievements of those who do great work and demonstrate our capabilities and values.
* Career development and learning opportunities including LinkedIn Learning and other tailored training solutions.
* Leave Options – Flexible leave options include generous annual leave, optional additional purchased leave, wellbeing days throughout the year, and a paid day to volunteer for a cause you care about.



  

  

**Want to take your career to the next level? Apply today.**



**Additional Information**

 By clicking apply, you confirm you have read and agree to our Ampol Recruitment Privacy Collection Statement.
   

  





*We’re an equal opportunity workplace. We not only embrace diversity and inclusion; we celebrate what makes you unique. We welcome applications from people of all ages, cultural backgrounds, and diverse sexualities and genders (including if you identify as transgender). We also highly encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples to apply for roles with Ampol.*

**The Opportunity**
 BRG is supporting a requirement within the Department of Industry, Science and Resources (DISR), specifically within the Chief Information Officer Division (CIOD).
   

  

 This opportunity is suited to experienced ICT Business Analysts who can operate in complex delivery environments, supporting a range of digital and emerging technology projects, including AI\-driven initiatives.
   

  

**Key Details**
* APS6 equivalent Business Analyst role
* Based in Canberra (on\-site)
* Baseline clearance required at commencement
* Working across multiple ICT projects and initiatives
* Agile delivery environment


**Role Overview**
 You will play a key role in analysing business needs, facilitating stakeholder engagement, and translating requirements into clear, actionable deliverables to support ICT project outcomes.
   

  

 Working closely with business stakeholders, delivery teams, and technical specialists, you will contribute to the successful delivery of complex digital solutions across the Division.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
**Business Analysis \& Requirements**
* Analyse current and future business processes and information management environments
* Gather and document business and technical requirements
* Translate business needs into clear techno\-functional requirements


**Stakeholder Engagement**
* Facilitate workshops to define business scenarios and requirements
* Engage with stakeholders to understand needs and validate solutions
* Collaborate with technical teams to ensure alignment


**Artefact Development**
* Develop high\-quality documentation including:
+ Business requirements specifications
+ Functional and non\-functional requirements
+ Process maps and data models
+ User stories and acceptance criteria
+ Business cases and reports


**Solution Analysis \& Delivery Support**
* Evaluate solution options and provide recommendations
* Conduct technical research and analysis
* Support Agile delivery including backlog refinement and sprint activities


**What You'll Need**
**Essential Experience**
* Strong experience facilitating workshops and developing:
+ Business scenarios
+ Process maps
+ Data models
+ Use cases

* Experience developing user stories and acceptance criteria
* Proven experience working on complex ICT projects in Agile environments
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills


**Desirable Experience**
* Experience supporting ICT service delivery and implementation
* Experience documenting requirements for Office technologies
* Experience using Azure DevOps for backlog and user story management
* Exposure to Dynamics 365 and/or Power Platform


**Additional Requirements**
* Must hold a current Baseline security clearance at commencement
* Ability to work on\-site in Canberra
* Strong written response required (1\-page pitch addressing criteria)

* Highlighting potential opportunities for business growth
* Contributing to the development of others and the internal Consulting practice
* Maintaining an awareness of the various BAE Systems capabilities


**Functional Requirements**
* Must hold a PV clearance
* Willingness to travel to client sites for project work

+ Working with engineering teams as part of coherent project delivery

* Communicates fluently, orally and in writing, and can present complex information to both technical and non\-technical audiences when engaging with colleagues or users/customers

* Demonstrable stakeholder management and engagement experience
* Takes responsibility for delivering outputs, including work packages and small projects
* Shares knowledge and expertise with others
* Is able to respond to setbacks in an agile and resilient manner
* Maintains an awareness of developing practices and their application and takes responsibility for driving own development


**Why BAE Systems?**

We welcome people from all backgrounds and want to make sure that our recruitment processes are as inclusive as possible. If you have a disability or health condition (for example dyslexia, autism, an anxiety disorder etc.) that may affect your performance in certain assessment types, please speak to your recruiter about potential reasonable adjustments.
   

  

 Please be aware that many roles at BAE Systems are subject to both security and export control restrictions. These restrictions mean that factors such as your nationality, any nationalities you may have previously held, and your place of birth can restrict the roles you are eligible to perform within the organisation.

**Description**
* We’re a ‘Family Friendly’ certified workplace – we understand the often many and varied roles our team members need to play within their own unique family setting and actively support them.


 Our team feel Leidos is a great place to work. Learn more about our culture and benefits by visiting us here https://www.leidos.com/company/global/australia/careers
   

  

**Do Work That Matters**
 Leidos Australia delivers IT and airborne solutions that protect and advance the Australian way of life. Our 2000 local experts, backed by our global experience and network of partners, are working to solve the world’s toughest challenges in government, intelligence, defence, aviation, border protection and health markets.
   

  

**Your New Role And Responsibilities**
 We are seeking Business Analysis professionals across Business Process and Business Systems disciplines to support a program delivering capability in a classified environment.
   

  

 The program delivers new capability by building on and integrating existing systems and processes, applying a reuse \- buy \- build approach to achieve operational outcomes while managing risk, schedule and security constraints. Business Analysis plays a critical role in ensuring business needs are met while leveraging existing capability wherever possible.
   

  

 The Business Analysis team operates under the direction of the Program Manager, with day\-to\-day leadership provided by the Senior Business Systems Analyst, and works closely with business, technical and security stakeholders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Analyse and document existing business processes to form the foundation of delivered capability.
* Support the design of future‑state (to‑be) processes enabling integration of reused, purchased and newly built solutions.
* Engage stakeholders to understand operational workflows, decision points and constraints in a classified environment.
* Identify opportunities for process reuse or adaptation and analyse business and operational needs to support reuse, buy or build solutions.
* Document functional and non‑functional requirements, support traceability across business needs and system capabilities, and work with technical specialists within an agreed architecture and delivery approach.


**About You And What You'll Bring**
* Demonstrated experience as a Business Analyst, Business Process Analyst or Business Systems Analyst supporting complex ICT or digital delivery in regulated or security‑conscious environments.
* Ability to analyse and document existing processes and systems, including as‑is / to‑be process analysis, to support future capability.
* Strong stakeholder engagement skills across business and technical audiences, with comfort working under direction in complex operational environments.
* Experience supporting integrated or multi‑component solutions across on‑premise and/or cloud environments, with awareness of security considerations.
* Exposure to systems analysis across commercial (COTS), customised and bespoke systems, with ability to identify process reuse or adaptation opportunities and work within defined scope and delivery priorities.


*This role does require the successful applicant to be an Australian Citizen and hold a minimum TSPV level security clearance.*
**Diverse Team Members, Shared Values and a Common Purpose**
*Providing our customers with smarter solutions takes an incredible team with diversity of thought, experience and perspectives driving innovation. Inclusion is at the heart of our culture and is one of our core values. It's about creating a workplace where everyone can do important work, feels welcome, valued, and respected, and has equal access to opportunities to thrive. Paul Chase – Chief Executive, Leidos Australia.*
 Leidos Australia is an equal opportunities organisation and is committed to creating a truly inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islanders, culturally and linguistically diverse people, people with disabilities, veterans, neurodiverse people, and people of all genders, sexualities, and age groups.
   

  

 Our five Advocacy Groups (Women and Allies Network, Young Professionals, Defence \& Emergency Services, Action for Accessibility and Abilities and Pride\+) provide an opportunity for team members to connect and collaborate on shared interests, and work to support and celebrate our diverse community.
   

  

**Next Steps**
* To apply for this role, follow the links or apply via our Careers page.
* Recruitment process \- virtual / face to face interview \& background checks.
* Applicants may also need to meet International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) requirements. In certain circumstances this can place limitations on persons who hold dual nationality, permanent residency or are former nationals of certain countries as per ITAR 126\.1\.
* We are committed to making our recruitment process accessible to all candidates. Please contact our Careers team careers.au@au.leidos.com if you’d like to discuss any additional support during your application or throughout the recruitment process.


 If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.
   

  

**Original Posting**
 For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above.
   

  

**Pay Range**
 The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.
   

  

**About Leidos**
 Leidos is an industry and technology leader serving government and commercial customers with smarter, more efficient digital and mission innovations. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, with 47,000 global employees, Leidos reported annual revenues of approximately $16\.7 billion for the fiscal year ended January 3, 2025\. For more information, visit www.Leidos.com.
   

  

**Pay And Benefits**
 Pay and benefits are fundamental to any career decision. That's why we craft compensation packages that reflect the importance of the work we do for our customers. Employment benefits include competitive compensation, Health and Wellness programs, Income Protection, Paid Leave and Retirement. More details are available at www.leidos.com/careers/pay\-benefits.
   

  

**Securing Your Data**
 Beware of fake employment opportunities using Leidos’ name. Leidos will never ask you to provide payment\-related information during any part of the employment application process (i.e., ask you for money), nor will Leidos ever advance money as part of the hiring process (i.e., send you a check or money order before doing any work). Further, Leidos will only communicate with you through emails that are generated by the Leidos.com automated system – never from free commercial services (e.g., Gmail, Yahoo, Hotmail) or via WhatsApp, Telegram, etc. If you received an email purporting to be from Leidos that asks for payment\-related information or any other personal information (e.g., about you or your previous employer), and you are concerned about its legitimacy, please make us aware immediately by emailing us at LeidosCareersFraud@leidos.com.
   

  

 If you believe you are the victim of a scam, contact your local law enforcement and report the incident to the U.S. Federal Trade Commission.
   

  

**Commitment to Non\-Discrimination**
 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law. Leidos will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with relevant laws.
