last_kept_snapshot.fit_source_text:
Bridge business and tech without the endless meetings or vague requirements that make most BA roles frustrating.
 



  





 You'll translate stakeholder needs into technical specifications that developers can actually build from. You'll work with SQL databases, AWS cloud infrastructure, and APIs to analyse existing systems and design better solutions. Plus you'll support testing cycles and change management when new systems go live.
 



  





 You'll work with a modern tech stack including Snowflake, Oracle, and ETL tools like dbt and Informatica. The team uses IBM applications and .NET frameworks, so you'll get exposure to enterprise\-grade systems that handle serious scale. Government moves at a steadier pace than startups, which means you actually get time to do the analysis properly instead of rushing into half\-baked solutions.
 



  





 You'll have real autonomy over how you approach problems and who you consult with. The ICT Program Director gives you project priorities and timelines, but you decide how to get there. You'll present directly to stakeholders across the organisation, so your recommendations actually get heard and implemented rather than disappearing into committee hell.
 



  





 What You'll Do:
 



 \- Gather requirements from stakeholders and turn them into detailed technical specifications and system designs
 



 \- Analyse databases, APIs and cloud infrastructure to identify gaps and improvement opportunities
 



 \- Create test scenarios, support UAT cycles, and manage defects through to resolution
 



 \- Support change management activities and implementation planning for technical solutions
 



  





 What You'll Need:
 



 \- Strong SQL skills plus experience with AWS, Snowflake, Oracle, and API integration
 



 \- Hands\-on experience with ETL tools like dbt, Informatica, or custom SQL pipelines
 



 \- Background in requirements gathering, technical documentation, and UAT testing processes
 



 \- Experience with IBM applications, .NET frameworks, and reverse engineering tools like ERwin
 



  





 About the Company:
 



 They operate the land registry system that underpins billions of dollars of property transactions across NSW. They're modernising decades\-old processes with cloud technology and online services while maintaining the security and reliability that the entire property market depends on.
 



  





 Apply:
 



 Please click the 'Apply' button. Don't worry if your CV isn't up to date \- just send what you have.

**About Us** 




 Automic Group is Australia’s market leader in technology\-driven investor administration. Combining proprietary cloud\-native technology with expert service, Automic simplifies investor administration and governance for companies and funds. We provide the market's leading registry, employee share plans, IR analytics, and fund administration services for over 1,400 ASX\-listed and unlisted organisations.
 



  





 Automic’s culture is collaborative, inclusive, and purpose driven. It is grounded in our mission to connect companies and funds to their investors through technology, service, and trust, and guided by our values of
 ***One Automic, Go Beyond, Empowered, and Accountable***
*.* 




  





**About the Role** 




 We’re looking for a Business Analyst – Transitions to support the successful delivery of Listed Registry and Employee Share Plan (ESP) client transitions.
 



  





 In this role, you’ll sit at the intersection of client requirements, operational processes, and system delivery, ensuring that business needs are clearly defined, documented, and translated into high\-quality outcomes. You’ll play a key role across the full transition lifecycle—from requirements gathering through to testing and implementation.
 



  





 This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys structured problem\-solving, stakeholder engagement, and working across complex financial services environments.
 



  





*Role Responsibilities:* 



* Engage stakeholders to elicit, document, and validate business and system requirements
* Translate requirements into functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Maintain traceability between business needs, solution design, and delivery
* Document current and future state processes across registry operations, corporate actions, and ESP workflows
* Identify process gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities
* Support operational readiness by ensuring processes are clearly defined
* Support planning and execution of multiple client transition projects
* Work closely with Project Managers, Solution Analysts, and Data teams
* Assist in defining data requirements and business rules
* Develop test scenarios, test cases, and acceptance criteria
* Support System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
* Assist with defect triage and resolution



  





*Skills and Experience* 



* Proven experience as a Business Analyst within financial services
* Experience in registry, capital markets, or Employee Share Plans (ESP) highly regarded
* Strong requirements elicitation and documentation skills
* Experience with process mapping and business process design
* Strong stakeholder engagement and workshop facilitation capability
* Understanding of data, systems, and integration concepts
* Experience supporting testing phases (SIT/UAT)
* High attention to detail with a structured, analytical approach



  





  





**About you!** 




 You’re a structured and detail\-oriented Business Analyst who thrives in
 **project\-driven, fast\-paced environments** 
 . You’re confident working with stakeholders, asking the right questions, and translating complex requirements into clear, actionable outputs.
 



 You bring a proactive mindset and enjoy working collaboratively to deliver high\-quality outcomes.
 



  





 To succeed in this role you will demonstrate:
 


* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management capability
* A structured and organised approach to work
* Attention to detail and commitment to quality
* The ability to manage multiple priorities across projects
* A proactive, solutions\-focused mindset



  





**Why join Automic:** 




 You’ll be part of a team where operational excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement are genuinely valued. This is an opportunity to deepen your expertise, contribute to meaningful outcomes, and grow your career within a high\-performing, purpose\-led fintech environment.
 



  





 Key Benefits include:
 


* Hybrid working
* A High growth, scale\-up organisation
* Professional career growth \& development
* Supportive \& fast paced environment



  





 If the above sounds like you, please apply for this exciting opportunity and be part of the growth journey at Automic!
 



  





*Applications will be reviewed as they are received and interviews may commence prior to the closing date.*

**Description**
**About Pace**
 At Pace Farm, we’re proud of our strong family values that have guided us since the 1970s. From humble beginnings, we've grown into one of Australia’s largest egg producers, delivering the freshest, tastiest eggs nationwide. As the leading supplier of farm\-fresh eggs and egg products, our mission is to continue setting the standard in the industry by valuing our people and equipping them with the skills to deliver top\-quality products and service. With egg\-citing growth and expansion on the horizon, now’s a great time to join us and be part of our continued success!
   

  

**About The Role**
 Senior Business Analyst (ERP)
   

  

 Up to 18\-month fixed term contract
   

  

 Norwest NSW with one day working from home
   

  

 This position requires occasional travel for a few days each month, may include VIC interstate trips.
   

  

 Our ERP program has reached a key milestone, with core systems now in place across critical areas. The focus is on stabilisation, enhancing reporting and analytics, and strengthening business ownership to ensure the platform supports real operational needs.
   

  

 As an ERP Business Analyst, you will align business needs with technology solutions by analysing, documenting and improving processes, and collaborating with stakeholders to deliver clear, effective outcomes.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Lead the elicitation, analysis, and documentation of complex business requirements for new solutions and enhancements.
* Drive end\-to\-end business process improvement, leveraging technology to deliver measurable value and improved stakeholder outcomes.
* Facilitate senior stakeholder workshops and process mapping sessions to define strategic objectives and future\-state outcomes.
* Translate business needs into clear, high\-quality specifications and solution designs.
* Ensure end\-to\-end traceability of requirements across the full project lifecycle.
* Partner with business leaders to design and implement future\-state operating models and processes.
* Oversee and guide User Acceptance Testing (UAT), ensuring alignment with business objectives and quality standards.
* Lead change and release readiness activities, including governance, change control, and documentation.


**About You**
 You operate with a high degree of autonomy, influencing stakeholders across multiple departments and leading analysis on complex, cross\-functional initiatives, including ERP enhancements, reporting, and process optimisation.
   

  

 You are a confident stakeholder partner, skilled in eliciting requirements, clarifying expectations, and removing ambiguity. With a strategic mindset, you assess current processes and design efficient future\-state workflows, while supporting change and translating business needs into clear, scalable solutions.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For**
* Minimum 5\+ years’ experience as a Business Analyst within medium to large organisations.
* Demonstrated experience working with enterprise systems, ideally within complex environments.
* Strong expertise in business process modelling and continuous improvement.
* Advanced analytical capability, with proven experience identifying root causes and delivering actionable insights.
* Highly developed stakeholder engagement, facilitation, and communication skills, with the ability to influence at all levels.
* Proactive, well\-organised, and detail\-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership.
* Proven ability to manage competing priorities and deliver outcomes within tight timeframes.


 Ideally, you have experience in manufacturing, logistics, or agriculture, possess a business analysis certification, and are familiar with Agile or hybrid delivery frameworks.
   

  

**Why Join Pace Farm?**
* A collaborative and inclusive work environment that fosters teamwork and growth.
* Monthly office\-wide birthday celebrations
* Access to ongoing learning and development opportunities to support your professional growth.
* Enjoy regular free products plus discounts on groceries, fuel, dining and more.


 To find out more about us, visit https://www.pacefarm.com
   

  

 Pace Farm acknowledges the Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples as First Peoples of Australia. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all individuals, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability or age background, feel valued and respected. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply.
   

  

**Company Overview**
 Pace Farm – home of the enjoyable egg. We've been providing Australia with the freshest and tastiest eggs since the 1970s. Since then, we have grown into one of the largest egg producers in Australia. Pace Farm is a leading Australian owned supplier, marketer and distributor with a diverse range of farm fresh eggs and egg products.

 The team has had some reactive ways of working in the past and is looking for individuals who can take ownership, get ahead of problems, and operate as true self\-starters.

* You’re someone who doesn’t just write SQL, you use it to understand how systems actually work.

**Challenge and opportunity** 




  




* Work across a complex, multi\-faceted transformation program

* Assess impact of system changes on data and document pipelines
* Operate in an environment shifting from reactive to proactive ways of working
* Take ownership of analysis and drive clarity across ambiguity



  





  





**What you will be doing** 




  




* Interrogating existing data environments and pipelines
* Writing advanced SQL queries to analyse and validate data flows
* Working across BigQuery and existing data platforms
* Collaborating with stakeholders to understand system changes and impacts
* Managing and contributing to backlog via Jira and Confluence
* Documenting findings and helping shape future state data flows



  





  





**What we are looking for** 




  




* Strong SQL capability (advanced in some cases)
* Experience working across complex or legacy data models
* Tech BA skillset with strong communication
* BigQuery experience
* Experience working in large\-scale digital transformation programs
* Ability to operate independently and take ownership
* Comfortable working in environments with limited documentation
* Experience with Confluence and Jira



  





  





**Culture and work style** 








 This team needs proactive, self\-sufficient individuals who can operate with autonomy and bring structure to ambiguity. You’ll be stepping into a changing environment where your ability to think critically and move things forward will be key.
 



  





 Keen to discuss further, or know someone who would be a strong fit?
 



  





**Reach out to Emily or Laura, or apply directly via LinkedIn.**

last_kept_snapshot.fit_source_text:
BAE Systems Digital Intelligence is home to 4,500 digital, cyber and intelligence experts. We work collaboratively across 10 countries to collect, connect and understand complex data, so that governments, nation states, armed forces and commercial businesses can unlock digital advantage in the most demanding environments.
   

  

**Business Analyst**
**About Us**
 We are seeking talented people to help our customers scope, design and roll out capabilities and grow our existing team. This role will be focused on supporting our customers mission, protecting themselves and others from security risks and implementing new capabilities across a variety of ICT and operational technology (OT) systems. You have BA experience and appreciate what it means to work in a flexible Consulting team, where the tasks from day to day vary according to the differing shape and status of projects and customer needs. You are passionate about enabling customers to achieve their goals and working with your team to get things done.
   

  

**About The Role**
 You will be responsible for:
   

  

* Identification and documentation of stakeholders and their needs and drivers
* Facilitating scoping and business priority setting for small, medium or large capability changes, engaging stakeholders as required
* Eliciting and authoring scoping document business requirements, system requirements and business processes.
* Capture and evaluation of both ‘pain points’ and ideas for improvement, prioritising possible improvements and obtaining buy\-in for an improvement plan
* Taking an active role in stakeholder workshops
* Supporting business development teams as needed, contributing to consulting elements of client responses
* Authoring relevant business change\-related materials to support rollout of new capabilities
* Research into potential tools clients may need to satisfy requirement
* Working with engineering teams to ensure they get the information they need from business stakeholders
* Highlighting potential opportunities for business growth
* Contributing to the development of others and the internal Consulting practice
* Maintaining an awareness of the various BAE Systems capabilities


**Functional Requirements**
* Must hold a PV clearance
* Willingness to travel to client sites for project work


**Key Skills And Experience**
* Previous Business Analysis experience including:
+ Authoring of different levels of requirements
+ Engaging with stakeholders of different types, seniority etc
+ Running meetings/workshops to elicit information, demonstrate systems etc
+ Defining as\-is and to\-be processes
+ Creation of various artefacts to communicate concepts that are well structured, appropriate for the audience and tell the story in a concise and logical way
+ Working with engineering teams as part of coherent project delivery

* Communicates fluently, orally and in writing, and can present complex information to both technical and non\-technical audiences when engaging with colleagues or users/customers
* Has attention to detail, is proactive and organised
* Is flexible, willing to get involved in a variety of tasks with different people across different projects or internal tasks
* Demonstrable stakeholder management and engagement experience
* Takes responsibility for delivering outputs, including work packages and small projects
* Shares knowledge and expertise with others
* Is able to respond to setbacks in an agile and resilient manner
* Maintains an awareness of developing practices and their application and takes responsibility for driving own development


**Why BAE Systems?**
 This is a place where you’ll be able to make a real difference. You’ll be part of an inclusive culture that values diversity of thought, rewards integrity, and merit, and where you’ll be empowered to fulfil your potential. We welcome people from all backgrounds and want to make sure that our recruitment processes are as inclusive as possible. If you have a disability or health condition (for example dyslexia, autism, an anxiety disorder etc.) that may affect your performance in certain assessment types, please speak to your recruiter about potential reasonable adjustments.
   

  

 Please be aware that many roles at BAE Systems are subject to both security and export control restrictions. These restrictions mean that factors such as your nationality, any nationalities you may have previously held, and your place of birth can restrict the roles you are eligible to perform within the organisation.

**Description**
* We’re a ‘Family Friendly’ certified workplace – we understand the often many and varied roles our team members need to play within their own unique family setting and actively support them.


 Our team feel Leidos is a great place to work. Learn more about our culture and benefits by visiting us here https://www.leidos.com/company/global/australia/careers
   

  

**Do Work That Matters**
 Leidos Australia delivers IT and airborne solutions that protect and advance the Australian way of life. Our 2000 local experts, backed by our global experience and network of partners, are working to solve the world’s toughest challenges in government, intelligence, defence, aviation, border protection and health markets.
   

  

**Your New Role And Responsibilities**
 We are seeking Business Analysis professionals across Business Process and Business Systems disciplines to support a program delivering capability in a classified environment.
   

  

 The program delivers new capability by building on and integrating existing systems and processes, applying a reuse \- buy \- build approach to achieve operational outcomes while managing risk, schedule and security constraints. Business Analysis plays a critical role in ensuring business needs are met while leveraging existing capability wherever possible.
   

  

 The Business Analysis team operates under the direction of the Program Manager, with day\-to\-day leadership provided by the Senior Business Systems Analyst, and works closely with business, technical and security stakeholders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Analyse and document existing business processes to form the foundation of delivered capability.
* Support the design of future‑state (to‑be) processes enabling integration of reused, purchased and newly built solutions.
* Engage stakeholders to understand operational workflows, decision points and constraints in a classified environment.
* Identify opportunities for process reuse or adaptation and analyse business and operational needs to support reuse, buy or build solutions.
* Document functional and non‑functional requirements, support traceability across business needs and system capabilities, and work with technical specialists within an agreed architecture and delivery approach.


**About You And What You'll Bring**
* Demonstrated experience as a Business Analyst, Business Process Analyst or Business Systems Analyst supporting complex ICT or digital delivery in regulated or security‑conscious environments.
* Ability to analyse and document existing processes and systems, including as‑is / to‑be process analysis, to support future capability.
* Strong stakeholder engagement skills across business and technical audiences, with comfort working under direction in complex operational environments.
* Experience supporting integrated or multi‑component solutions across on‑premise and/or cloud environments, with awareness of security considerations.
* Exposure to systems analysis across commercial (COTS), customised and bespoke systems, with ability to identify process reuse or adaptation opportunities and work within defined scope and delivery priorities.


*This role does require the successful applicant to be an Australian Citizen and hold a minimum TSPV level security clearance.*
**Diverse Team Members, Shared Values and a Common Purpose**
*Providing our customers with smarter solutions takes an incredible team with diversity of thought, experience and perspectives driving innovation. Inclusion is at the heart of our culture and is one of our core values. It's about creating a workplace where everyone can do important work, feels welcome, valued, and respected, and has equal access to opportunities to thrive. Paul Chase – Chief Executive, Leidos Australia.*
 Leidos Australia is an equal opportunities organisation and is committed to creating a truly inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islanders, culturally and linguistically diverse people, people with disabilities, veterans, neurodiverse people, and people of all genders, sexualities, and age groups.
   

  

 Our five Advocacy Groups (Women and Allies Network,Young Professionals, Defence \& Emergency Services, Action for Accessibility and Abilities and Pride\+) provide an opportunity for team members to connect and collaborate on shared interests, and work to support and celebrate our diverse community.
   

  

**Next Steps**
* To apply for this role, follow the links or apply via our Careers page.
* Recruitment process \- virtual / face to face interview \& background checks.
* Applicants may also need to meet International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) requirements. In certain circumstances this can place limitations on persons who hold dual nationality, permanent residency or are former nationals of certain countries as per ITAR 126\.1\.
* We are committed to making our recruitment process accessible to all candidates. Please contact our Careers team careers.au@au.leidos.com if you’d like to discuss any additional support during your application or throughout the recruitment process.


 If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.
   

  

**Original Posting**
 For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above.
   

  

**Pay Range**
 The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline onlyand not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.
   

  

**About Leidos**
 Leidos is an industry and technology leader serving government and commercial customers with smarter, more efficient digital and mission innovations. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, with 47,000 global employees, Leidos reported annual revenues of approximately $16\.7 billion for the fiscal year ended January 3, 2025\. For more information, visit www.Leidos.com.
   

  

**Pay And Benefits**
 Pay and benefits are fundamental to any career decision. That's why we craft compensation packages that reflect the importance of the work we do for our customers. Employment benefits include competitive compensation, Health and Wellness programs, Income Protection, Paid Leave and Retirement. More details are available at www.leidos.com/careers/pay\-benefits.
   

  

**Securing Your Data**
 Beware of fake employment opportunities using Leidos’ name. Leidos will never ask you to provide payment\-related information during any part of the employment application process (i.e., ask you for money), nor will Leidos ever advance money as part of the hiring process (i.e., send you a check or money order before doing any work). Further, Leidos will only communicate with you through emails that are generated by the Leidos.com automated system – never from free commercial services (e.g., Gmail, Yahoo, Hotmail) or via WhatsApp, Telegram, etc. If you received an email purporting to be from Leidos that asks for payment\-related information or any other personal information (e.g., about you or your previous employer), and you are concerned about its legitimacy, please make us aware immediately by emailing us at LeidosCareersFraud@leidos.com.
   

  

 If you believe you are the victim of a scam, contact your local law enforcement and report the incident to the U.S. Federal Trade Commission.
   

  

**Commitment to Non\-Discrimination**
 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law. Leidos will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with relevant laws.

 Title : Senior Business Analyst
 



 Location: Sydney, Australia \- 3days a week
 



  





 Skills Required
 



**Quoting/ CPQ, Hiring/ Scheduling, Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Visio,** 




  




* Key expectations from the candidates: in\-depth experience in understanding complex business processes, converting requirements into project deliverables, and collaborating closely with cross\-functional teams to ensure successful outcomes.
* Deep understanding of customer business processes in at least 2 of the 3 domains (Quoting/ CPQ, Hiring/ Scheduling in ERP, Contract Management).

* Work closely with development teams to clarify requirements and ensure delivered features align with business expectations.
* Partner with QA teams to ensure test cases, scripts, and results fully reflect business needs and acceptance criteria.
* Understand and manage dependencies across app modules, features, and user stories.
* Support backlog refinement, sprint planning, and overall Agile ceremonies in collaboration with PO and PM/ SM.
* Create and maintain a comprehensive bi‑directional traceability matrix.
* Produce high\-quality documentation including BRD, FRD, user manuals, training content, and release notes.
* Plan and deliver training sessions tailored to different end‑user personas.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with client stakeholders.
* Exceptional analytical and problem‑solving abilities.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while maintaining outstanding quality standards.
* Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Visio, etc.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery frameworks.
* Good to have certification (CBAP, PMI‑PBA or domain‑specific credentials).

last_kept_snapshot.fit_source_text:
Job SummaryWe are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.  
As the Business Analyst you will be part of the team responsible for building and supporting core business applications for UMG Australia. With your proven BA experience and Application Support skills, you will continue to increase the value from existing systems, as well as being a key part of identifying new opportunities to deliver value across various teams within the business. 
Strong Business Analysts skills are needed to help guide requirements, building relationships within the business and presenting deliverables in clear language – then project managing these into successful business cases for budget and project completion using a combination of internal resources and external partners. Hands-on administration of some systems like Salesforce.com, different reporting/dashboarding applications as well as SQL admin and ETL tools. 
Application Support across a wide range of business applications is another key part of this role, resolving issues within the team and partnering with Global UMG teams to solve issues in a timely manner. 
Technical background together with excellent communication skills are important parts of this role, dealing with customers across the business and being able to communicate clearly and with impact. 
Job FunctionsManaging business applications day to day, resolving support cases around access and performance as a key part of the Applications Services team. Interacting with global IT teams for assistance and development of projects and cases. 
Administering systems for continual improvements and making sure the systems keep up with the changing music industry and the needs of the business. 
DBA work involves managing data in and out of the organisation as well as how data is stored and represented to systems for insight and analysis. 
Business analysis – partnering with the business on process mapping, guiding the conversation on options for technology, designing solutions and defining the benefits into a successful business case for funding approval. 
Striving to update the technology stack to take advantage of new tools and systems, reducing risk and costs. 
Keeping up with the latest technological developments in relevant areas, taking responsibility for your own learning and helping others on the same journey by sharing information and supporting a culture of collaboration and learning. 
Relationship management both internally in the local business, global IT community within UMG as well as external partners. 
Job RequirementsSkills/Abilities: 
SQL skills – db admin, Stored procedure development, scheduling. Cloud db solutions from AWS, Azure, GBQ and MS SQL Server. 

Salesforce.com administration / development and managing custom-built business applications. 
Business Intelligence platform experience, Google Looker, Business Objects, MODLR, Domo or similar 
ETL/Automation tools for data integration, automation, building robust processes. 
Project management skills, high attention to detail and experience with collaboration tools such as Monday.com 
High level of initiative, self-motivated to deliver on projects and moving forward. An enthusiastic attitude towards learning how the various teams within UMG operate and to identify opportunities for improvement. 
Team player attitude, friendly and respectful towards others and open to sharing information and mentoring others as part of a bigger Tech team. 
Change management experience is important, as an industry leader we are constantly moving forward. 
Experience/Educatation: Bachelor's degree in IT related field  
A minimum of 5 years' experience in IT with a focus on BA and App Support work. 
Experience dealing with end users / business users translating technical terms and outcomes into clear language, proven track record in being an enthusiastic force for good.  
Universal Music Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. 
Diversity & Inclusion
At Universal Music we are committed to fostering diversity and inclusivity as an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply for our roles regardless of their gender, race, ethnicity, nationality, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, intersex status, marital or family status, neurodiversity, religion or belief, disabilities, or socio-economic background. We also encourage people from all cultural backgrounds to apply, including First Nations people. It is through our diversity and inclusivity that we bring together different perspectives, enhancing our creative and evolving workplace. Music is Universal.

last_kept_snapshot.teaser: Permanent Senior BA role - Process Engineering within Financial Services - High visibility role
last_kept_snapshot.fit_source_text: The Role:   I'm currently looking for a heavy-hitting Senior Business Analyst who specialises in Process Engineering to join a fast-paced financial services firm. This isn't your typical "sit in the corner and write requirements" BA role. This is a high-visibility, high-impact position designed for someone who wants to take a "blank sheet" environment and build a gold-standard operational framework.   The business is growing rapidly, but the documentation hasn't kept pace. We need a self-starter who can walk into various divisions, identify the "tribal knowledge" keeping things afloat, and formalise it into streamlined, efficient workflows. What you'll actually be doing  Process Mapping from Scratch: Since there isn't much currently documented, you'll be leading the charge in discovering, documenting, and "owning" the end-to-end business processes. Process Engineering & Optimisation: Using Lean, Six Sigma, or similar methodologies to identify bottlenecks and redundant steps. You won't just document the "As-Is"—you will design and pitch the "To-Be." Challenging the Status Quo: You'll need to "ruffle a few feathers." We need someone who isn't afraid to look a Department Head in the eye and explain why their 10-year-old manual process is holding the business back. last_kept_snapshot.fit_source_text:
Our Customer Core Salesforce team is leading a digital transformation within our client service solutions, focused on improving efficiency and enhancing the client experience. We work collaboratively to equip service teams with modern tools that enable more effective, informed and personalised support.
   

  

 At Macquarie, our advantage is bringing together diverse people and empowering them to shape all kinds of possibilities. We are a global financial services group operating in 31 markets and with 56 years of unbroken profitability. You’ll be part of a friendly and supportive team where everyone \- no matter what role \- contributes ideas and drives outcomes.
   

  

**What role will you play?**
 As a Salesforce Business Analyst, you will play a key role in shaping how our service teams support clients, working closely with a Lead Business Analyst, Product Manager and delivery team. You will analyse current service and client processes, help design improved ways of working, and contribute to the delivery of new tools that support a more consultative service model. Your work will help ensure solutions are well understood, clearly defined and deliver real value for both clients and service teams.
   

  

**What You Offer**
* A curious and analytical mindset, with the ability to understand existing processes and identify opportunities to improve how people work
* A strong interest in learning new technologies, particularly customer service platforms such as Salesforce, and how they can improve client experience
* Experience with, or a keen interest in, artificial intelligence concepts and tools, such as virtual assistants, automation, data\-driven insights or language models
* Clear and confident communication skills, with the ability to listen, ask thoughtful questions and share ideas with a range of stakeholders
* A collaborative, team\-focused approach and a genuine passion for improving experiences for both customers and the people who support them.


 We love hearing from anyone inspired to build a better future with us, if you're excited about the role or working at Macquarie we encourage you to apply.
   

  

**What We Offer**
**Benefits**
 At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that’s rewarding in all the ways that matter most to you. Macquarie employees can access a wide range of benefits which, depending on employment type, include:
   

  

* 1 wellbeing leave day per year
* Up to 5 additional service bonus leave days per year
* Up to 20 weeks’ paid parental leave for primary caregivers along with 12 days of transition leave upon return to work, and 6 weeks’ paid leave for non\-primary caregivers
* 2 days of paid volunteer leave and donation matching
* Up to 12 months’ gender affirmation leave, including 6 weeks’ paid leave
* Access to Employee Assistance Program and wellbeing benefits including skin and health checks, and flu vaccinations
* Access to a wide range of salary packaging options
* Access to a wide range of learning and development opportunities, including reimbursement for professional membership or subscription
* Hybrid and flexible working arrangements, dependent on role
* Reimbursement for work from home equipment


**About Banking and Financial Services**
 Banking and Financial Services is our technology\-driven retail bank. You will be part of a team that supports clients to achieve their full potential \- whether that’s buying a home, growing a business or investing to manage wealth.
   

  

**Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion**
 We are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and welcome all identities, including race, ethnicity, cultural identity, nationality, gender (including gender identity or expression), age, sexual orientation, marital or partnership status, parental, caregiving or family status, family and domestic violence status, neurodiversity, religion or belief, disability, or socio\-economic background. We welcome further discussions on how you can feel included and belong at Macquarie as you progress through our recruitment process. To learn more, contact our team by clicking here.
   

  

 Our aim is to provide reasonable adjustments to individuals who may need support during the recruitment process and through working arrangements. If you require additional assistance, please let us know in the application process.

Job Req Number: 113677
   

  

 Time Type: Full Time
   

  

 Are you passionate about putting customers first, delivering the best performance, and fostering true collaboration to keep the supply chains flowing? Join us and be a part of DSV’s global family.
   

  

 DSV is seeking to hire a skilled and passionate Data Analyst in AUS – New South Wales.
   

  

 We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Analyst to play a pivotal role in the development of objectives, strategies, and plans aimed at achieving customer satisfaction and the efficient use of organizational resources. This role involves collaborating with clients, assessing organizational shortcomings, analysing current systems, and recommending improvements to enhance overall efficiency and productivity.
   

  

 Salary range for the role is $89,000 to $95,000 excluding superannuation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Assist in the development of objectives, strategies, and plans that are aligned with the organization's goals.
* Encourage the implementation of strategies to achieve customer satisfaction and optimize resource utilization
* Engage with clients to discuss business and organizational shortcomings.
* Maintain effective communication with clients to understand their specific needs and concerns
* Analyze and evaluate current systems and structures within the organization
* Assess the effectiveness and efficiency of existing processes.
* Discuss current systems with staff at all levels of the organization.
* Observe and document processes and systems to identify areas for improvement
* Elicit and translate business, financial, and operational requirements into analytical system specifications, including data inputs, calculation logic, and validation rules
* Define system behaviours to support labour productivity monitoring, cost allocation, and performance reporting
* Prepare and recommend proposals to revise methods and procedures, alter work flows, redefine job functions, and resolve organizational problems
* Configure logic, validation, and system parameters to ensure accurate performance metrics


**About you:**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Management, or a related field (Master's degree preferred)
* 5 years proven experience as a Business Analyst within logistics role.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
* Proficiency in data analysis and use of relevant software tools.
* Knowledge of business process improvement methodologies.
* Attention to detail and a commitment to quality


**DSV – Global transport and logistics**
 Working at DSV means playing in a different league.
   

  

 As a global leader in transport and logistics, we have been on an extraordinary journey of growth. Let’s grow together as we continue to innovate, digitalise and build on our achievements.
   

  

 With close to 150,000 colleagues in over 90 countries, we work every day to offer solid services and meet our customers’ needs and help them achieve their goals. We know that the best way to achieve this is by bringing in new talent, fresh perspectives and ambitious individuals like you.
   

  

 At DSV, performance is in our DNA. We don’t just work – we aim to shape the future of logistics. This ambition fuels a dynamic environment built on collaboration with world\-class team players, accountability and action. We value inclusivity, embrace different cultures and respect the dignity and rights of every individual. If you want to make an impact, be trusted by customers and grow your career in a forward\-thinking company – this is the place to be.
   

  

**Start here. Go anywhere**
 Visit dsv.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Facebook.
   

  

 At DSV, we believe diversity gives us a competitive edge and as such we value the diverse backgrounds and experiences that people bring to our business. We welcome everyone from all walks of life including First Nations Peoples, Veterans, and people of all ages, genders, and abilities. Everyone should feel welcome here. We're all about hiring the best talent. We want a team that's as diverse and dynamic as our communities.

**Transform lives, every single day** 




 Do you want a career that means more? At Anglicare Sydney, we bring the strength, the support and the strategy to make it happen. As a trusted not\-for\-profit with a strong presence across NSW, we support people to live with dignity, independence and connection \- and strong systems and insights are critical to delivering this mission.
 







 We are seeking an experienced
 **Business Analyst** 
 to serve as the primary BA for
 **Anglicare At Home** 
 , supporting Seniors Communities through data driven insight, system optimisation and continuous improvement.
 







 This is a 12\- month fixed term hire.
 







**Your opportunity** 




 Reporting to the Process Improvement Manager, you will oversee all system related activities for Anglicare At Home. You'll analyse data, produce insightful reports, and deliver recommendations that drive operational efficiencies and improve service delivery.
 







 Working closely with leadership teams, operational managers, project teams, IT and external partners, this role plays a key part in supporting growth, enhancing client relationships and embedding a culture of continuous improvement.
 







 This is an initial 12 month fixe term hire.
 







**With integrity and resilience, you will:** 



* Deliver insights and reporting to support operational performance and growth
* Analyse data and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations
* Gather requirements and document business needs, designs and system solutions
* Identify and implement opportunities to improve business processes and systems
* Support change initiatives and adoption in line with Anglicare's PROSCI framework
* Review implemented solutions and optimise outcomes where required
* Build strong relationships with stakeholders to support successful delivery







**What you'll bring** 



* Strong business process mapping and continuous improvement capability
* Ability to translate complex business requirements into practical technical solutions
* Excellent data analysis, interpretation and reporting skills
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum and/or Waterfall environments
* Strong relationship management, business acumen and presentation skills
* Detail oriented with excellent documentation and organisational skills
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work cross functionally
* Experience in aged and community care (highly regarded)







**Qualifications and technical capability** 



* Experience with Microsoft 365, including
 **Power BI** 
 (preferred)
* Experience with
 **Microsoft Power Platform** 
 (Dynamics, Power Apps, Power Automate)
* Microsoft certifications (e.g. Dynamics 365 Functional Consultant, Power Platform App Maker) highly regarded
* Experience working in fast paced, multifunctional or hybrid roles







**Why join Anglicare?** 




 At Anglicare, you'll be part of a compassionate, respectful and purpose driven community where values guide how we work every day. We offer the stability of a well\-established organisation alongside the opportunity to shape meaningful change for clients, families and communities.
 







 You'll also enjoy:
 


* Flexible work options
* Salary packaging to increase your take home pay\- Up to $15,900 of your salary is tax free
* Ongoing professional development and career growth
* Access to wellbeing programs, discounts and employee support initiatives







**Are you ready for a career that means more?** 




 To apply, please click
 **Apply** 
 and submit your resume and cover letter. All applicants will receive a response.
 







 Anglicare Sydney values diversity and inclusion. While we are guided by Christian based values, we welcome people of all faiths and backgrounds and strongly encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, and people of all ages, genders, abilities and cultural backgrounds.

last_kept_snapshot.fit_source_text:
This is a SaaS business in growth mode, building and delivering a configurable platform used by enterprise and mid\-market customers to run critical parts of their operations.
 



  





 The product is already well established, but with new client wins and ongoing platform evolution, they are looking to bring in a Senior Business Analyst who can operate at the intersection of customer, product and delivery.
 



 This is not a passive BA role. It is hands\-on, customer\-facing and requires someone who can take ownership from discovery through to delivery.
 



  





**The Role** 




 You will work closely with customers to understand how they operate, what they need from the platform, and how that translates into a scalable, configurable solution.
 



  





**You will be involved across:** 



* Running discovery sessions and stakeholder workshops
* Translating business needs into structured requirements
* Working closely with product and engineering teams on delivery
* Supporting configuration and implementation of the platform
* Driving clarity, alignment and momentum across multiple workstreams



  





 You will be expected to think beyond documentation and contribute to how the solution actually works in practice.
 



  





**What Makes This Different** 



* A true SaaS environment, not a traditional project\-based BA role
* High level of customer interaction and ownership
* Work on a configurable platform, not one\-off builds
* Exposure to both product thinking and delivery execution
* A business that values clear thinking and practical outcomes over process for the sake of it



  





**What They’re Looking For** 



* Strong experience as a Business Analyst within SaaS or technology environments

 9/10

**This role sits within the Strategy and Business Case team within the Strategy, Commercial and Risk Division.
   

  

 About the team**
 The Strategy \& Business Case team creates and executes strategies, assesses market trends, secures funding and drives innovation to help shape Telco's future and ensure its long\-term success. The primary purpose of this role is to develop financial models and conduct analysis to support delivery of the Public Safety Mobile Broadband (PSMB) Business Case and other key strategic initiatives.
   

**Your responsibilities will include;**



* Develop financial and business case modelling, cost and benefit analysis and provide analytical solutions for projects including Return on Investment (ROI), Net Present Value (NPA) and Cost\-benefit Analysis (CBA)
* Analyse and interpret data to draw meaningful insights and drive assumptions to support informed decision making
* Liaise with subject matter experts and stakeholders to identify opportunities offering insights, validating assumptions, and influencing outcomes
* Support the decision\-making processes, using outstanding technical and commercial skills on strategic projects
* Utilise communication skills to present outcomes and make recommendations
* Support the development and delivery of business cases and proposals.



 For more information on the role and its accountabilities, click here to view the role description.
   

  

**To be successful in this role you will have:**



* Proven analytical and financial modelling capabilities, with the ability to interrogate large datasets in a commercial and/or public sector contexts to generate actionable insights for diverse stakeholders
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a strong ability to engage stakeholders and translate complex information into clear, compelling narratives
* Demonstrated capability to combine rigorous analysis with persuasive storytelling to develop impactful business cases
* Attention to detail, and the ability to work independently and manage competing deadlines in a dynamic environment
* Tertiary qualifications in the field of finance/accounting/business or equivalent (essential) and CA or CPA accreditation (desirable).



 A talent pool may be created from this recruitment action for future temporary or ongoing vacancies in roles with similar capability requirements.

 We work with emergency services and telecommunications carriers to protect communications assets during emergencies and natural disasters.
   

  

 NSWTA is a delivery agency with responsibility for over $1\.5 billion in key NSW Government projects that connect communities and support emergency services.
   

  

 We lead and coordinate whole\-of\-government connectivity strategy to bridge the digital divide and help keep people and places safe.
   

  

 NSWTA operates as a standalone Statutory Authority within the Department of Customer Service. We promote flexibility and we will consider part time, job share and other flexible arrangements.

 We understand the importance of continuing to learn and grow in your career and provide a range of training and development opportunities to keep upskilling and nurturing our people. We're also committed to creating opportunities for job mobility and new experiences within our organisation or the wider public sector.
   

  

 For more information, go to NSW Telco Authority

last_kept_snapshot.fit_source_text:
**Location:** 
 Parramatta
 



**Day Rate:** 
 Competitive (dependent on experience)
 



**Role Highlights:** 
 Career\-defining opportunity to work with the Head of Data at a values\-driven national retailer. This is a high\-impact role where you'll build the foundational understanding of the organisation's data ecosystem, directly influencing strategic decisions that drive customer value and operational efficiency. Report into a supportive data leader while establishing trusted relationships across the business.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 Reporting to the Head of Data, you'll be responsible for mapping and documenting the organisation's data landscape across key business units. On a weekly basis, you'll engage with stakeholders across operations, supply chain, and finance to understand their processes, systems, and data flows. You'll conduct hands\-on analysis using SQL and Python to investigate data structures, trace data lineage, and identify opportunities for improved data quality and governance. Daily, you'll be building relationships, gathering requirements, documenting workflows, and translating complex technical findings into business\-relevant insights.
 



  





 This role offers the unique opportunity to shape the data strategy for a large\-scale retail operation from the ground up. You'll contribute to establishing data governance frameworks, identifying data ownership across departments, and building the foundations for scalable analytics capabilities. Your investigative work will directly support the organisation's mission to deliver exceptional value to customers through better\-informed operational and commercial decisions.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Map data flows across the organisation's systems including SAP and SQL\-based platforms, documenting critical data elements and their lineage
* Conduct hands\-on data analysis to understand current data structures, identify quality issues, and develop business rules for data governance
* Work closely with business units to gather requirements, understand operational processes, and identify how data is created, used, and managed
* Build trusted relationships with stakeholders across departments to facilitate knowledge transfer and capture operational expertise
* Document workflows, processes, and data ownership structures to create a comprehensive view of the data ecosystem
* Identify candidates for data governance and accountability within business units, supporting the establishment of data stewardship
* Contribute to the development of the broader data strategy for the National Data Office, translating discovery insights into practical frameworks
* Translate complex data and process information into clear, business\-relevant insights for diverse stakeholder groups



  





**Candidate Profile** 




 You are a curious and persistent professional with proven experience documenting data systems and processes in large\-scale enterprise environments. Your technical foundation in SQL and Python enables you to assess data structures and understand how information flows across platforms like SAP or similar ERP systems. You bring strong analytical thinking to investigate current states, identify gaps, and translate operational knowledge into actionable insights.
 



  





 Your communication and relationship\-building skills are exceptional\-you can engage stakeholders across operational teams, earn their trust, and gather the information needed even in complex, fast\-paced settings. You're comfortable challenging assumptions and navigating competing priorities without formal authority. Ideally, you have exposure to FMCG, retail, supply chain, or similarly operationally focused industries. Most importantly, you're passionate about understanding how data drives better outcomes for organisations and their customers, and you care about the impact of your work on both efficiency and customer experience.
 



  





**Culture \& Benefits** 




 This organisation champions a 'Good Different' culture\-celebrating diversity, supporting work\-life balance, and creating an environment where people can bring their authentic selves to work. With a strong focus on sustainability and community impact, they've achieved industry\-leading initiatives including 100% renewable energy operations and significant charitable contributions. You'll work in a supportive environment that values kindness, development, and recognition.
 


* **Influence outcomes \-** 
 Work directly with the Head of Data in a role that shapes national data strategy
* **Hybrid flexibility \-** 
 3 days working from home per week
* **Values\-driven culture \-** 
 Join an organisation passionate about customer value, sustainability, and social responsibility



  





**Apply** 




 If this sounds like you, please send your resume by clicking the "apply" link below. The reference number for this role NG70046\. Please allow for 3\-5 working days for us to process all applications. All applicants will hear back from us, either via email or a telephone call.

last_kept_snapshot.fit_source_text: Location: Parramatta  Day Rate: Competitive (dependent on experience)  Role Highlights:  Career-defining opportunity to work with the Head of Data at a values-driven national retailer. This is a high-impact role where you'll build the foundational understanding of the organisation's data ecosystem, directly influencing strategic decisions that drive customer value and operational efficiency. Report into a supportive data leader while establishing trusted relationships across the business.  Role Overview  Reporting to the Head of Data, you'll be responsible for mapping and documenting the organisation's data landscape across key business units. On a weekly basis, you'll engage with stakeholders across operations, supply chain, and finance to understand their processes, systems, and data flows. You'll conduct hands-on analysis using SQL and Python to investigate data structures, trace data lineage, and identify opportunities for improved data quality and governance. Daily, you'll be building relationships, gathering requirements, documenting workflows, and translating complex technical findings into business-relevant insights.  This role offers the unique opportunity to shape the data strategy for a large-scale retail operation from the ground up. You'll contribute to establishing data governance frameworks, identifying data ownership across departments, and building the foundations for scalable analytics capabilities. Your investigative work will directly support the organisation's mission to deliver exceptional value to customers through better-informed operational and commercial decisions.  Responsibilities Map data flows across the organisation's systems including SAP and SQL-based platforms, documenting critical data elements and their lineageConduct hands-on data analysis to understand current data structures, identify quality issues, and develop business rules for data governanceWork closely with business units to gather requirements, understand operational processes, and identify how data is created, used, and managedBuild trusted relationships with stakeholders across departments to facilitate knowledge transfer and capture operational expertiseDocument workflows, processes, and data ownership structures to create a comprehensive view of the data ecosystemIdentify candidates for data governance and accountability within business units, supporting the establishment of data stewardshipContribute to the development of the broader data strategy for the National Data Office, translating discovery insights into practical frameworksTranslate complex data and process information into clear, business-relevant insights for diverse stakeholder groupsCandidate Profile  You are a curious and persistent professional with proven experience documenting data systems and processes in large-scale enterprise environments. Your technical foundation in SQL and Python enables you to assess data structures and understand how information flows across platforms like SAP or similar ERP systems. You bring strong analytical thinking to investigate current states, identify gaps, and translate operational knowledge into actionable insights.  Your communication and relationship-building skills are exceptional-you can engage stakeholders across operational teams, earn their trust, and gather the information needed even in complex, fast-paced settings. You're comfortable challenging assumptions and navigating competing priorities without formal authority. Ideally, you have exposure to FMCG, retail, supply chain, or similarly operationally focused industries. Most importantly, you're passionate about understanding how data drives better outcomes for organisations and their customers, and you care about the impact of your work on both efficiency and customer experience.  Culture & Benefits  This organisation champions a 'Good Different' culture-celebrating diversity, supporting work-life balance, and creating an environment where people can bring their authentic selves to work. With a strong focus on sustainability and community impact, they've achieved industry-leading initiatives including 100% renewable energy operations and significant charitable contributions. You'll work in a supportive environment that values kindness, development, and recognition. Influence outcomes - Work directly with the Head of Data in a role that shapes national data strategyHybrid flexibility - 3 days working from home per weekValues-driven culture - Join an organisation passionate about customer value, sustainability, and social responsibilityApply  If this sounds like you, please send your resume by clicking the "apply" link below. The reference number for this role NG70046. Please allow for 3-5 working days for us to process all applications. All applicants will hear back from us, either via email or a telephone call.

last_kept_snapshot.title: Scrum Master
last_kept_snapshot.teaser: Lead and manage the project product backlog within a large, complex technology transformation project.
last_kept_snapshot.fit_source_text:
At ASIC, you can be the change that ensures a fair, strong and efficient financial system for the benefit of all Australians. Contribute to delivering on ASIC's purpose, vision, and strategic priorities to help maintain the integrity of the financial system and protect consumers from harm.
 
ASIC's Digital, Data & Technology (DD&T) group is seeking a dynamic highly skilled Scrum Master to join their team. The successful candidate will lead and manage the project product backlog within a large, complex technology transformation project.
 

24-month fixed term position based in either Sydney or Melbourne


Salary from $152,074 up to $163,970 (depending on experience) + 15.4 % superannuation


Applications close at 11:59pm AEST, Monday 27 April 2026

 
The team 
The Digital, Data & Technology (DD&T) group at ASIC is at the forefront of driving transformational change and delivering cutting-edge technology services. This dynamic group encompasses Information Technology, Cyber Security, Data, Digital, Portfolio Office and Registry Connect, which is modernising ASIC's Business Registers.
These teams are pivotal in supporting ASIC's development and business transformation in areas such as data and analytics, cloud, mobility and application modernisation. By harnessing the latest technology and prioritising data sharing and analytics, ASIC is on a mission to become a ‘best in class' regulator for the Australian Financial Markets.
 
The role
The Scrum Master will be responsible for managing the project product backlog, collaborate with Project Managers and Product Owners and ensure timely task delivery. They will drive backlog grooming, sprint planning and provide sprint reporting. Additionally, they will resolve blockers, lead agile adoption and monitor scope changes.
More specifically, you will: 

Manage the project product backlog, collaborating with Project Managers and Product Owners to track task delivery within the agreed sprint.
Drive backlog grooming and sprint planning.
Provide sprint reporting to support project status updates.
Identify and resolve product backlog blockers with Project Managers and Product Owners.
Contribute to Project Board reporting as needed.
Lead and coach agile process adoption across project teams.
Monitor and escalate any additional scope items added to the product backlog.
Identify delivery capacity per sprint with resource teams.
Ensure decisions are made by the agreed stakeholders in collaboration with Project Managers and Product Owners.
Communicate project updates to key stakeholders with the Sponsor, Project Managers and Product Owners.

 
About you
The ideal candidate for this role will have extensive experience working within large-scale, complex banking and finance organisations. They will have a proven track record in leading and supporting complex technology transformation projects, as well as demonstrated success in transitioning from waterfall to agile methodologies in such environments.
In addition, you will have:

Relevant tertiary qualifications or extensive practical experience.
Scrum Master certification.
Strong leadership, organisational, communication, and engagement skills.
Experience as a Scrum Master for large-scale projects.
In-depth knowledge of Scrum techniques and artifacts (e.g., definition of done, user stories, automated testing, backlog refinement)
Familiarity with software development.
Proficient in problem-solving and conflict resolution.
Ability to present complex information effectively to both project and executive-level audiences, verbally and in writing.

 
Click ‘apply' to start your application. Applications close at 11:59pm AEST, Monday 27 April 2026.
 
About ASIC
ASIC's remit is one of the broadest of regulators across the world. ASIC regulates corporations, markets, financial services and consumer credit and monitors and promotes market integrity and consumer protection in the Australian financial system. Through our enforcement work, we hold to account those who contravene the law, working to achieve strong outcomes that address the greatest consumer and investor harms. 
ASIC is an equal opportunity employer seeking people who want to make a difference. ASIC is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace where the very best talent in Australia chooses to work. Applications from people of all ages, cultural backgrounds, abilities, LGBTIQ+ identity, and people of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent are encouraged to apply. 
We offer a range of employee benefits including:

Attractive superannuation
Additional leave entitlements
50/50 hybrid work-from home model
Flexible work arrangements
Assistance for study and professional development

Click here to view ASIC's salary and benefits guide.
To read more about ASIC, you can visit our website or review our Corporate Plan.
To work with us, you need to be an Australian citizen and be prepared to complete an ASIC Suitability and Baseline Assessment.

last_kept_snapshot.fit_source_text:
Founded in 1978, Dicker Data is Australia’s leading locally owned and operated distributor of ICT hardware, software, cloud and IoT solutions for over 10,000 reseller partners across Australia and NZ. 

An ASX listed (ASX: DDR) company, we are recognised in the industry for our award-winning record of gender equality, diversity and inclusion and we pride ourselves on building sustainable business practices. We understand the importance of hiring the right people to build successful teams, and of supporting our people to reach their full potential in every aspect of work and life.

Our Vision 

To inspire, educate and enable Australian technology resellers to achieve their full potential through the delivery of unparalleled service, technology and logistics.

Our Values

At Dicker Data, we pride ourselves on our family centric culture. Our people band together for a common goal, willing to lend a helping hand and often going above and beyond to support their colleagues. The values that underpin our company culture are the drivers of our ongoing success:


	Agile
	Solution focused
	Respect for all people
	Integrity in the way we operate

About You



You are an experienced, results-driven Business or Category Analyst with 3+ years’ experience in the consumer retail space, bringing strong capability across data analytics, financial modelling and business intelligence to translate complex insights into commercial outcomes.

What you will do in the role






	Assist with business unit (vendor and customer) custom reporting and analysis, ensuring data integrity to optimise sales strategies
	Liaise with internal and external stakeholders to design reporting and data analytic dashboards
	Utilise BI tools to create dashboards and reports
	Maintain and update BI dashboards and reports, including data inputs
	Perform data transformation and cleansing of existing and available reports as per reporting needs
	Profitability and GP analysis and tracking which requires working closely with the Sales & Product teams
	Effectively manage claims, accruals, rebates and ensure timely payments for business unit
	Assist with inventory planning for the business unit, if and when needed
	Drive efficiencies for the BU by way of automation and process improvement
	Consistently meeting and exceeding company/business unit KPIs/targets
	Provide mentorship, and training to relevant staff within the business unit

What you will need to succeed in the role






	Relevant university degree in Commerce or Business Analytics & IT System
	Distribution, consumer retail or brand experience 
	Data visualisation, business intelligence and reporting skills required
	Technical skills across SQL and Power BI
	Advanced Excel automation skills (Power Pivot and Power Query)
	Proactiveness, operational excellence, problem solving skills
	Strong mathematical, research and analytical skills
	Able to work well in a team as well as autonomously
	Work well under pressure in a fast-paced environment
	Strong stakeholder management skills
	Display a high attention to detail
	Multi-tasking and excellent prioritisation skills
	Problem solving and implementing process efficiencies


Our Benefits


	A highly competitive salary package depending upon experience
	Hybrid and sustainable working environment
	Staff only on-site gym & weekly corporate fitness classes
	A selection of freshly prepared lunch options provided daily
	Free on-site parking and electric parking stations
	A relaxed, modern office setting with smart casual dress
	Access to discounted banking, superannuation, and health and wellbeing offers via our corporate partners
	Company paid parental leave scheme
	Employee Assistance Program
	On site school holiday program for children of Dicker Data staff


This job ad is open effective 21st April 2026.  Applications close 20th May 2026.

Only those with the legal right to work in Australia may apply for this position.
Only short-listed candidates will be contacted.

last_kept_snapshot.fit_source_text:
About Us 
Automic Group brings together modern purpose-built technology with a dynamic and experienced team to tailor solutions for companies and funds to understand, engage and manage their investors. We provide a cloud-native single registry, employee share plan and board management platform, and professional services including company secretarial, ESG, accounting and finance, and investor and media relations. 

Today, over 1,400 ASX listed and unlisted clients trust Automic’s 250 employees to manage their registry, investor and board requirements – and Automic is ranked number one on the ASX by number of companies serviced, with 750 listed clients. In the past two financial years, Automic has won 50%of IPOs and 70% of listed companies who have switched registries. 

Our culture is innately entrepreneurial, comprising people who thrive in an atmosphere where ideas, actions and initiative are encouraged. Our core values, Customer Success, Ambition, Equality and Team are at the foundation of who we are and how we operate.

We are growing and are looking for an experienced Senior Technical Business Analyst to join our team in Sydney!
About the Role

This role requires an experienced BA who can independently own complex system changes end-to-end and who can work closely with business and technical stakeholders to deliver build-ready requirements as our tech grows. 

Key Responsibilities include:


	Operating in strict accordance with Automic’s Information Security Management System (ISMS), ensuring compliance with security, governance, and data protection standards.
	Leading end-to-end business analysis activities across new features, enhancements, and strategic initiatives.
	Collaborating with senior management, IT, Sales, Marketing, and Operations to gather, analyse, and prioritise business requirements.
	Facilitating and driving requirements workshops, solution design sessions, and stakeholder discussions.
	Working closely with developers and UX designers to refine and clarify requirements throughout the delivery lifecycle.
	Translating high-value business priorities into clearly defined Minimum Viable Products (MVPs).
	Supporting testing and validation activities to ensure delivered solutions meet business intent.
	Identifying risks, dependencies, and impacts across systems and processes.
	Continuously improving analysis practices, documentation standards, and tools to enhance productivity, quality, and security.

About you!

 

To be successful in this role, we are looking for someone with:


	A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, Finance, or related discipline.
	At least 8+ years’ experience as a Business Analyst in enterprise software environments working within an Agile delivery framework
	Demonstrated experience delivering across full software development life cycles.
	Proven hands-on technical capability from functional requirements gathering to user stories & high-quality acceptance criteria & mapping multisystem impact analysis
	Able to work independently owning delivery outcomes, escalating risk when required
	Proven experience of leading structured workshops with key stakeholders able to manage up effectively to get the right outcomes
	A systems level thinker, understanding cross system impacts 
	Experience within financial services is highly desirable, particularly within share/unit registry, managed funds, fund admin, wealth/ market infrastructure or investor lifecycle platforms


Why join Automic:

You’ll be part of a team where operational excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement are genuinely valued. This is an opportunity to deepen your expertise, contribute to meaningful outcomes, and grow your career within a high-performing, purpose-led fintech environment.

Key Benefits include:


	Hybrid working
	Professional career growth & development 
	Supportive & fast paced environment
	Opportunity to grow with the business 


If the above sounds like you, please apply for this exciting opportunity and be part of the growth journey with Automic!
