**About the Company** 




  
 



 At Future Secure AI, we're building something genuinely new — and we're looking for people bold enough to build it with us. We work at the frontier of AI, tackling big, real\-world problems for global enterprises across multiple industries, armed with state\-of\-the\-art technology and a culture that prizes courage, rigor, and relentless curiosity. Our BRAVER values aren't just words on a wall — they describe the kind of people we are and the standard we hold ourselves to every day. Our leadership team is entrepreneurial, experienced, and accessible, with an open\-door policy that means you'll never be just a number here. We invest seriously in your growth because we know our success depends on yours. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry, push into uncharted territory, and do work that genuinely matters, Future Secure AI is the place for you.
 



 Future Secure AI is not another AI vendor—we’re an enterprise AI partner who build cutting edge AI Co\-Workers to support enterprise business. Backed by one of the world’s largest financial institutions and trusted by C\-suite leaders across global organisations. Our mandate is bold: re\-engineer how the world’s biggest companies operate and give teams the ability to deliver 10x performance through intelligent systems.
 



**We’re scaling fast.** 
  And we’re looking for a Senior Technical Business Analyst who wants to
 **build, influence,** 
  and
 **lead transformation** 
  at speed.
 



**Why FSAI** 




 We don’t do theory. We build AI Co\-Workers that get shipped, adopted, and scaled across global enterprises.
 



 ·       Work on real enterprise AI initiatives with real customers.
 



 ·       Collaborate directly with senior executives, product leaders, and world\-class engineers.
 



 ·       High\-ownership culture.
 



 ·       Help shape product direction, delivery models, and the next wave of AI Co\-Workers.
 



 ·       Access and contribute to cutting\-edge use cases across multiple industries inc.: Finance, Health, Services and Social impact.
 



**The Role** 




 This is a role for someone who loves complexity, thrives in ambiguity, and knows how to turn strategy into clarity. You’ll be the connective tissue between business, engineering, and product—ensuring that FSAI’s AI systems don’t just get built, but land with precision and impact.
 



 You will lead discovery, shape roadmaps, break down problems, and unlock velocity across AI delivery teams. Your fingerprints will be on some of the most important AI programs happening inside major global enterprises.
 



**What You’ll Do** 




 ·       Facilitate workshops, uncover real requirements, and turn business ambition into actionable user stories to build AI Coworkers
 



 ·       Analyse data, workflows, and operational patterns to inform decisions and reduce delivery risk.
 



 ·       Partner directly with senior leaders to drive prioritisation, clarity, and strategic alignment.
 



 ·       Support engineers and product teams by removing blockers and enabling fast, confident execution.
 



 ·       Build deep expertise in FSAI’s AI capabilities and shape how new features and use cases evolve.
 



 ·       Operate in a squad on 2\-3 use cases in parallel
 



**About You** 




 You’re a Senior BA who wants to sit at the centre of AI transformation, not on the sidelines. You move with urgency. You bring structure to chaos. You communicate with precision. And you know how to influence up, down, and across.
 



**You bring:** 




 ·       8\+ years of Business Analysis experience in enterprise, consulting, or product\-led environments.
 



 ·       Proven leadership across 
 **complex technology, AI, data, or automation programs.** 




 ·       Experience in automation, 
 **UI/UX** 
  and 
 **project management** 
  is highly desired.
 



 ·       Expert workshop facilitation and requirements definition.
 



 ·       A strong understanding of SDLC, compliance, risk, and enterprise delivery fundamentals is desired.
 



 ·       Experience operating in fast\-paced agile teams.
 



 ·       Ability to shape narratives, influence direction, and guide senior stakeholders.
 



**What Success Looks Like** 




 ·       You build trust rapidly with executives and delivery teams.
 



 ·       You bring clarity, structure, and momentum to complex programs.
 



 ·       You help shape the trajectory of new AI initiatives and product capabilities.
 



 ·       You elevate performance across teams by driving alignment and focus.
 



  
 



  

**Why Join Us?** 



* A high\-performance culture
* State\-of\-the\-art technology
* Experience world\-class leadership
* Scale of impact and purpose
* A competitive salary and a huge growth trajectory
* Work with the best in the industry
* Flexible work environment
* Diversity and creativity



  

**Disclaimer:** 
 We do not wish to be contacted by recruitment agencies. Our hiring process is managed in\-house and the best way for candidates to express interest is by applying with your resume through our company website.
 


 Future Secure AI Privacy Policy
 
 At Future Secure AI, we are committed to protecting your privacy and adhering to the principles of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Australian Privacy Principles (APPs) under the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth). Our Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, share, and protect your personal data when you visit our website at

 A large, complex organisation operating a multi‑billion‑dollar capital works program is seeking an experienced Technical Business Analyst to support the delivery of technology outcomes across major infrastructure and digital transformation projects. This organisation offers a collaborative environment where technology, construction, and stakeholders intersect to enable future‑focused outcomes.
 



  





**Your new role** 




 As a Technical Business Analyst, you will play a critical role acting as the interface between business stakeholders, construction partners, architects, and technical delivery teams. You will be responsible for capturing, translating, and managing complex business and technical requirements to support IT infrastructure, digital platforms, and systems integration across capital works projects.
 



  





 Key responsibilities include:
 


* Capturing, analysing, validating, and documenting business and technical requirements across IT, AV, cybersecurity, academic, and operational domains
* Translating business needs into clear functional and non‑functional technical requirements
* Facilitating workshops and stakeholder sessions to define and refine requirements
* Working closely with solution architects, network engineers, cybersecurity specialists, and vendors
* Supporting technical scopes of work, specifications, procurement, and delivery activities
* Maintaining requirements traceability throughout design, build, testing, and handover
* Supporting testing activities including system integration testing and UAT
* Contributing to operational readiness and transition to BAU
* Identifying and managing requirement‑related risks, issues, and dependencies



  





  





**What you’ll need to succeed** 



* Proven experience as a Technical Business Analyst working across IT infrastructure, systems integration, or nanobiotechnology projects
* Experience within university environments or higher education (highly regarded)
* Experience in construction‑led or capital works environments (highly regarded)
* Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, networks, enterprise systems, and cybersecurity principles
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex business and technical needs into structured requirements
* Experience supporting solution design, procurement, testing, and commissioning
* Excellent stakeholder engagement and facilitation skills
* Strong documentation, analytical, and problem‑solving capability
* Relevant tertiary qualifications in IT, Business Information Systems, Engineering, or similar (or equivalent experience)



  





  





**What you’ll get in return** 



* A day rate contract working on high‑profile, complex capital works projects
* Exposure to large‑scale technology and infrastructure initiatives
* Collaborative, multi‑disciplinary working environment
* Competitive contract rates and long‑term engagement potential



  





  





**What you need to do now** 




 If you’re an experienced Technical Business Analyst with a background in infrastructure or enterprise technology delivery and are looking for your next contract opportunity, click Apply Now or send your CV to

 .

**The role** 












  





 The Business Analyst partners with business and technology stakeholders to understand business goals, analyse problems and opportunities, and translate needs into clear requirements, early designs, and prototypes. The role supports the delivery of user\-centred digital solutions by shaping product and process improvements, validating concepts early, and enabling efficient delivery through well\-defined user stories, acceptance criteria, and solution options.
 











  





**The team** 












  





 APRA's Technology team delivers, maintains, and enhances essential information technology services that support the organisation's productivity, strategic objectives, and business unit priorities.
 







 Technology partner with stakeholders to design, implement and maintain IT solutions that meet the needs of the organisation and ensuring these are secure and aligned with APRA's technology architecture.
 







  





**Key accountabilities** 




  





  




* Build strong relationships with business stakeholders to quickly understand objectives, pain points and desired outcomes, and identify where digital products and solutions can add value.
* Translate business needs into functional and non\-functional requirements, ensuring they are testable, feasible and aligned to outcomes.
* Produce high\-quality analysis artefacts such as user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps, and impact assessments to support delivery.
* Facilitate solution option analysis including costs, benefits, risks, dependencies, and delivery impacts to inform decision\-making.
* Collaborate with business and technical teams to create early design concepts (e.g., wireframes, workflow diagrams, low\-fidelity screens).
* Develop and iterate prototypes to validate requirements, user journeys, and usability with stakeholders and end users early in the lifecycle.
* Coordinate and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) planning and execution, including test scenarios, defect triage, and acceptance sign\-off.
* Develop and maintain system, training, and user support resources to drive adoption and meet user needs and expectations.
* Communicate changes clearly and tailor messages and materials to different audiences, including non\-technical stakeholders.



  









**About you** 




  





  




* Demonstrated experience as a Technical Business Analyst working in digital delivery environments, with strong capability across discovery, requirements elicitation and high‑quality documentation.
* Strong experience delivering digital solutions across platforms such as Microsoft 365, Power Platform, ServiceNow and Oracle Fusion, with hands‑on technical understanding to shape solution design, integrations and delivery outcomes.
* Experience facilitating user research, journey mapping and applying human‑centred design approaches.
* Proven experience delivering initiatives across multiple digital domains, including web platforms, workflow, automation and enterprise business products.
* Solid understanding of end\-to\-end product lifecycle, digital architecture, agile methodologies and IT service delivery best practices.
* Excellent facilitation, communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence outcomes and gain agreement across diverse business and technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to manage priorities, driving outcomes in an agile, business\-focused, collaborative environment.



  









 To work with us you need to be an Australian Citizen and have the ability to gain a Defence Clearance.
 















  





**About APRA** 








  





 Australian Prudential Regulation Authority (APRA) was established in 1998 as an independent statutory authority that supervises almost 1,200 financial institutions that manage $8\.6 trillion in assets for Australians across the banking, insurance and superannuation sectors.
 







 In overseeing the safety, competitiveness and stability of the financial system, we seek to recruit, develop and retain highly skilled professionals, who want to help shape financial services and protect the financial wellbeing of the Australian community. Our employee base of almost 900 come predominantly from the commercial financial services industry or other government agencies; as such, we have the feel of a small corporate organisation that can work flexibly and with agility.
 







 At APRA, we're committed to providing an inclusive workplace where everyone belongs, feels valued and respected. We aspire to attract and foster diversity of background, thought, and experience, recognising that a broad range of perspectives, approaches and ideas makes us stronger, and better enables us to meet our obligation to protect the financial wellbeing of the Australian community. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, please inform at application stage so we can do our best to accommodate your requirements.

At Thales, we know technology has the ability to make our world more secure, sustainable, and inclusive – and that it’s all driven by human intelligence.
   

  

 Because it takes human intelligence to build and power the systems and solutions that people depend on every day. So we stay curious and make space for diverse points of view. We share what we know and we challenge what’s possible.
   

  

 From manufacturing and engineering to cybersecurity and space, we’re driving progress in some of the world’s most important industries – and working together to build a future we can all trust.
   

  

 IS/IT delivers a shared IT service to all Thales Australia business units located across Australia. We are currently on a transformational journey, and we are looking for an engaging candidate who will be an active participant in that journey which includes aligning multiple ERP’s into an Oracle EBS deployment, driving process and business intelligence maturity. The role has elements of business analysis and project management, and the ability to understand technical and functional aspects of applications.
   

  

**Our Benefits**
* Competitive remuneration \+ Bonus \+ Medical Insurance
* Fitness Passport Discount – Access to a network of Gyms across Australia
* Employee discounts with a number of affiliates (Travel, Car hire, Tech, Medical Insurance)
* Modernised Paid Parental Leave
* Veterans Leave
* Novated Lease options
* Family support through our partnership with Parents at Work
* Personal \& professional training development opportunities
* Sonder – Wellbeing \& Support Partner


**RESPONSIBILITIES (Key Accountabilities And Responsibilities)**
 As part of the Applications and Database team the Technical Business Analyst is responsible for the following:
   

  

* Partner with business units to identify, plan, and deliver process and system improvements
* Support the ERP patching process including functional testing, end\-user assistance/guidance
* Support Australian Unifi Program on the transition of Australian Businesses to the UniFi Applications solution including Data Migration and Test phase strategy, Process compliance and Post Go Live Support and ongoing operational support using ITIL processes
* Lead process Reviews and process improvements within the organisation focusing on standardisation and automation of key processes ensuring quality of service to internal customers is still maintained.
* Lead System Access Reviews to manage and coordinate half yearly Unifi user system access reviews by the CPO
* Reporting Improvements in conjunction with the UniFi design authority to identify, document and validate new Financial reporting requirements
* Advise businesses regarding reporting structures and methodologies to ensure integrity of background integration accounting is maintained
* Support the Systems Accountant with monthly close process addressing any integration issues to ensure system is ready for users to transact


**Knowledge And Experience**
**To be successful in your role, you will have demonstrated and/or acquired the following knowledge and experience:**
* Undergraduate Degree or relevant industry qualifications
* Expert Knowledge of ORACLE Financials (E\-Business Suite) 11\.5\.10/R12
* Functional Knowledge in Supply Chain, Manufacturing and Procurement domains
* Excellent planning and organising skills
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, including the analysis and interpretation of data with the capacity to devise and implement solutions.
* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Ability to meet tight deadlines


**GOOD TO KNOW**
 Prior to being offered employment, you will need to complete pre\-employment police and (role dependent) medical checks. Applicants must be Australian citizens and be eligible to obtain necessary security clearance.
   

  

 Additional information with regards to clearances is available from the Australian Government Security Vetting Agency website http://www.defence.gov.au/AGSVA/. In some cases, individuals who hold a current clearance from a foreign government may be eligible to have this clearance recognised by the Australian Government and be eligible for this role.
   

  

 The Australian Defence Trade Controls Act (DTCA) is applicable and as such, your nationality may be a factor in determining your suitability for this role. The U.S. International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and/or Export Administration Regulations (EAR) are applicable and as such, your nationality may be a factor in determining your suitability for this role.
   

  

**WE ENCOURAGE YOU TO APPLY**
 After you have applied, you will receive an email acknowledging your application. We’ll then provide a personalised experience for suitable applicants as we progress the selection and assessment process. Prior to being offered employment, you will need to complete pre\-employment police and depending on the role type, medical checks as well.
   

  

 It’s easy to dismiss the perfect opportunity if you don’t see yourself as the perfect fit. If this role feels right – no matter your background or personal circumstances – please introduce yourself or join our community. We’re committed to supporting a diverse workplace, and that starts here.
   

  

 We’re proud to be endorsed by WORK180 as an Employer for All Women, but we know there’s always more we can do. We’ll continue to foster industry partnerships, employee resource groups (ERGs) and development opportunities to make Thales a genuinely equitable employer, for everyone.
   

  

 Read more about our WORK180 endorsement.

last_kept_snapshot.fit_source_text:
The
 **Senior Business Analyst** 
 within our
 **Real World Evidence (RWE)** 
 , supports the delivery of life sciences research solutions on IQVIA data collection platforms.
   

  

 This role serves as a key analysis and delivery lead on protocol‑driven, regulated healthcare studies, including observational, registry, and direct‑to‑participant research.
   

  

**This position can be based anywhere in Australia.**
**12 month fixed term contract**
**Key Responsibilities**
* Perform end‑to‑end business and systems analysis for HRS‑based RWE studies, translating life sciences protocols into clear, testable system requirements.
* Support study initiation and delivery by contributing to scope definition, feasibility discussions, configuration decisions, and risk identification under guidance from senior leadership.
* Apply domain knowledge of Real World Evidence study designs, participant data collection, and scientific data workflows to inform system design and delivery decisions.
* Support configuration activities of data managers, including ensuring alignment to product capabilities. Integrate configuration documents with requirements documentation. Assess, analyze, and document requirements for custom development using appropriate techniques for highly configurable projects (e.g., protocol review, workshop output analysis, document analysis, review with product team, client approvals).
* Produce high‑quality requirements artifacts leveraging reusable and single sourced content, including business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and data flows.
* Support the data managers to convey configuration and integration needs to the technical teams, aligned with HRS platform capabilities and product standards.
* Support engineering teams throughout build and test phases by clarifying configuration and requirements, validating solutions, and minimizing rework.
* Apply good data management practices to ensure data integrity, privacy, and compliance with HIPAA, GDPR, and other applicable research regulations.
* Identify risks, issues, and dependencies within assigned studies and escalate appropriately with recommended mitigations.
* Support audits, inspections, and internal reviews by maintaining accurate, complete, and compliant documentation.
* Work closely with Project Managers to support delivery planning, milestone tracking, and change management activities.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Epidemiology, and Data Management partners to ensure requirements align with scientific objectives and platform capabilities.
* Communicate clearly with internal stakeholders and external clients to explain system functionality, requirements decisions, and delivery impacts.
* Support user acceptance testing and deployment activities.
* Provide informal mentoring and peer review support to Business Analysts, promoting consistent analysis quality and adherence to standards.
* Contribute to reusable templates, documentation standards, and best practices for HRS life sciences delivery.
* Continuously build domain and technical expertise in real world evidence, healthcare data standards, and regulated system delivery.


**Required Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Health Sciences, Biotechnology, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* Typically 6\+ years of experience in business or systems analysis, including hands‑on experience delivering healthcare or life sciences data systems.
* Working knowledge of Real World Evidence study designs.

**Who we are** 




 At Police Bank, we exist to serve those who serve. For over 60 years, we’ve supported our members with trusted, straightforward banking. We’re evolving into a more modern, member\-first organisation one that combines strong foundations with forward\-thinking ideas, where people are empowered to make an impact and do meaningful work.
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




 Based in the Projects team and reporting through to the Senior Delivery Lead, the Technical Business Analyst role is a business facing role that works with stakeholders to understand their processes, document needs and requirements into agreed artefacts, then works with project and stakeholder teams to design, implement and test agreed technical and process changes.
 



  





**What you’ll be doing** 



* Discovering, eliciting, refining and modelling business requirements for agreed projects
* Documenting processes, requirements and changes to agreed standard and format
* Current state and future state process mapping
* Identifying delivery and operational risks
* Impact assessment and input to process and system solution design
* Organising and coordinating business analysis efforts
* Assessing the performance and value of solutions in use.



  





**What are we looking for?** 



* Previous experience as a Technical Business Analyst/Business Analyst within the Banking or Financial Services space is a must.
* Tertiary qualifications in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Highly skilled in eliciting, documenting, and managing requirements for technical solutions.
* Exceptional analytical and problem\-solving abilities
* Ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly to non\-technical audiences and vice\-versa, with strong presentation and negotiation skills.
* A selfstarter with a strong sense of ownership and accountability, capable of managing multiple priorities effectively



  





**Why join us?** 




 We know people do their best work when they feel supported, trusted, and connected to purpose.
 



 At Police Bank, you’ll find:
 



  




* **Meaningful work** 
 – what you do directly supports our members and community
* **Real impact** 
 – your ideas and contributions won’t get lost in layers
* **Trusted environment** 
 – we value outcomes over hierarchy
* **Flexibility** 
 – we support balance in how you work
* **Growth** 
 – opportunities to develop, stretch, and progress your career



  





**What can we offer you** 
 ?
 



**💼 Work\-Life Balance \& Wellbeing** 




 Enjoy flexible and hybrid working options, generous parental leave, and unique leave types that support your wellbeing and life circumstances. Access wellbeing programs, EAP support, and regular health initiatives.
 



  





**💰 Rewards \& Benefits** 




 Benefit from competitive superannuation, salary packaging options, novated leasing, and exclusive access to financial services and employee discounts. Plus, earn through our referral program.
 



  





**📚 Learning \& Development** 




 Grow your career with study support, paid study leave, professional membership reimbursement, and access to online learning resources.
 



  





**🎉 Recognition \& Community** 




 Be celebrated through awards, milestone recognition, birthday perks, and volunteer leave—while contributing to a supportive and purpose\-driven workplace.
 



  





**What happens next?** 




 If this role sounds like the right fit, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now!
 



  





 No recruitment agencies please. We've got this. Thank you!
 



  





***Police Bank is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or disability status. This role is open to Australian and New Zealand Citizens and permanent residents only.***

**Job Description**
 Create your best future and join Westpac as a Senior IT Business Analyst (with Data Analysis Skills).
   

  

**What’s the role?**
 We are seeking an individual with a distinctive personality \- someone who brings enthusiasm, vitality, and a positive attitude to the team. The ideal candidate is eager to go above and beyond expectations, contributing proactively with new ideas and sharing knowledge within the GCM Team and BA Community of Practices (BACoP) without needing encouragement. We value those who do more than just fulfil the basic requirements and can invigorate our team with their energy.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess the ability to work independently, quickly assimilate new and complex concepts, and contribute effectively within a dynamic team setting. This position demands strong collaboration skills, especially when facilitating detailed discussions involving data and technical matters.
   

  

 Additionally, the candidate should exhibit proficiency in producing high\-quality documentation and communications, with meticulous attention to detail and a strong interest in data and sophisticated technical solutions.
   

  

 Your key responsibilities include:
   

  

* Representing the team as a GCM Functional and Data SME and continuously building knowledge around all GCM application components.
* Working with Business and Technical Stakeholders to understand the current and to\-be Technology and Data landscape and undertake functional / technical gap analysis, data analysis, identifying opportunities to improve the Business / System Processes, Technology and Business Landscape.
* Working with Business and Technical Stakeholders to execute functional / technical analysis to elicit, define, analyse, document, communicate, validate, trace, and manage Data and Technology service functional and non functional requirements and data / business rules through the Project Delivery lifecycle.
* Facilitating Functional, Data and Solution Definition workshops.
* Analysing complex Data patterns emanating from various Technology sources and applications.
* Defining and documenting Data rules and requirements through elicitation from GCM Team members and business/Project stakeholders.
* Gathering, analysing, manipulating, merging, translating, and defining Data from source to destination systems, and documenting such Data flows in a suitable format for developers, testers, Projects, and business stakeholders to consume, review and approve.
* A major focus on Data mapping and Data definition from consumer system, middleware, to source system components (GCM application components), as well as Systems Integration Projects.
* Ensuring the agreed and documented requirements and design are correctly defined and aligned to support the business requirements, business problem and business need.
* Reviewing and providing feedback on technical documentation, such as solution designs, technical specifications, test cases and scripts, implementation plans etc.
* Supporting testing and implementation activities to ensure the successful delivery of the overall business and Technology solutions.
* Providing recommendations for data re\-design, process re\-design, system improvements and usage.
* Participate in all Agile Team Ceremonies as and when required, such as Stand\-Ups, Sprint Planning, Sprint Retrospectives, and Backlog Grooming Sessions.
* Adherence to Group and internal Team governance, methodologies, frameworks, and processes to manage and mitigate risk.


 We envisage this role to be part of our long\-term core Team, hence we are interested in individuals who would like a longer\-term role in our Team (minimum 24 months’), to build their knowledge around GCM, and who would be willing to invest their time in doing so. We would also like the individual to be able and willing to participate in the ongoing Transformation and Engagement Improvement Initiatives in our domain as we build the Lines of Business capability within the Team.
   

  

**What do I need?**
 Essential:
   

  

* At least 5 years of experience in IT Business Analysis.
* Demonstrated experience in Data Analysis (e.g. SQL proficiency, Data Mapping, Data Profiling) within an IT Business Analysis capacity.
* Demonstrable experience in complex Systems Integration Projects, preferably API experience, AND experience in Data Migration projects.
* Tertiary qualifications in Business / Information Technology or equivalent experience.
* Knowledge and practical experience in Business Analysis, Data Analysis, and Project Management (Desirable) disciplines, processes, best practices, tools, and techniques.
* Process analysis, mapping, and re\-engineering experience.
* Waterfall principles and best practices and how to write robust functional and non functional specifications.
* Agile principles and best practices and how to write robust and complete user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Senior\-level experience in Functional, Data, Technology Service Specification Writing – no / minimal supervision required.
* Practical Experience in delivering end\-to\-end Agile and Waterfall Projects, including exposure to all related delivery processes, principles, best practices, tools, and techniques.
* A strong understanding of, and experience in, Technology and Business Systems strategically and operationally.
* At least 2 to 3 years Financial Services Experience.


 Desirable:
   

  

* Demonstrable Data Analytics Knowledge and Practical Experience such as – Data Analysis, Data Profiling, Data Mapping, Data Modelling, Reporting / Data Visualisation, Transforming Complex Data Sets into Clear Business Solutions and Outcomes, Translating Technical Data into valuable insights to help drive Business/Technical decisions to Enable Business Improvement. Hands\-on experience with SQL, ETL processes, data mining, data extraction, data collation, data transformation, data migration.
* A strong understanding of, and experience in, Westpac Methodologies and Processes: Waterfall (SELC) \& Agile (AEF) delivery methods, (GDPF) processes.
* Having prior experience or familiarity with Westpac Technology, applications, and methodologies or processes will be highly regarded.


**Why join us?**
 We’re obsessed with becoming our customers' \#1 banking partner for life and we’re looking for people who are passionate about helping us achieve that goal. In return, we’re committed to making Westpac the best place to work in the country. Here are just a few of the ways we’re already doing that:
   

  

* Special offers on banking products and discounts from top brands, including generous employee\-only mortgage rates!
* Flexible work arrangements to help you achieve a greater work/life balance, and a variety of leave options including Culture, Lifestyle and Wellbeing leave.
* Tailored learning and development opportunities to help your grow your career within the bank.
* Lots of opportunities to ‘give back’ to the Community by getting involved in our many volunteering initiatives.


**Create your future today**
 To get started, simply click on the APPLY or APPLY NOW button
   

  

 We’re all about creating a supportive and inclusive community. We welcome everyone – no matter your age, gender, background, or abilities. We also provide additional support to welcome our veterans, Indigenous Australians and neurodiverse community.
   

  

 If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, you can find more information and contact details on our FAQs and how to contact us page , under the ‘Diversity, sustainability and flexibility’ section.
   

  

 \- Hybrid.

**Job Description**
 Are you an experienced Senior Technical Business Analyst looking to return to work after a career break?
   

  

 Westpac understands that re‑entering the workforce can be challenging, especially in the fast‑paced world of technology.
   

  

 That’s why we’ve created the EmpowerUp Tech Returnship Program — designed to support people returning to tech after time away for parenting, travel, caregiving, personal health, or other life priorities.
   

  

 What we offer:
   

  

* A 24‑week structured program with hands‑on experience and dedicated support
* A collaborative cohort model with peers who share similar experiences
* People leaders trained to support flexibility and work‑life balance


 Join us at Westpac and take the next step in your tech career. Let’s EmPOWERUP together.
   

  

 We’re seeking a
 **Senior Technical Business Analyst** 
 to help improve how infrastructure services are experienced by customers. Based in
 **Sydney** 
 , this role sits within the Technology Infrastructure Team and supports the Infrastructure Customer Experience Improvement Program by identifying pain points, analysing processes, and designing more customer‑centred ways of working. There is
 **potential for this role to be job‑shared** 
 .
   

  

 You’ll work closely with customers and technology teams to map journeys, uncover insights, and drive practical, continuous improvements. Prior infrastructure experience isn’t required—what matters most is a strong technical foundation, analytical thinking, curiosity, and empathy.
   

  

 The role is based in Sydney and there is the potential do job share.
   

  

**What's the role?**
* Explore and map current and future customer journeys, processes, and service touchpoints
* Engage with customers and stakeholders to understand needs, challenges, and opportunities
* Analyse data and experience metrics to measure outcomes and improvement impact
* Apply continuous improvement practices informed by Lean Six Sigma principles
* Identify root causes and co\-design practical, customer‑focused solutions
* Document insights, journey maps, and process designs (e.g. using Figma)
* Communicate clearly across technical and non‑technical audiences


**What do I need?**
* Experience as a Business Analyst in a technology‑enabled environment
* Strong customer‑centric mindset with journey and process mapping experience
* Confidence using data to support insight‑driven decisions
* Exposure to Lean, Lean Six Sigma, or continuous improvement (or willingness to learn)
* Clear, empathetic communication and strong stakeholder engagement skills
* Experience facilitating workshops and collaborative sessions
* Familiarity with tools such as JIRA, Confluence, and Microsoft Power Platform
* Strong problem‑solving, analytical, and design thinking capability
* Capability in process and workflow design, with interest in automation and AI‑enabled ways of working


**Why join us?**
 We’re obsessed with becoming our customers' \#1 banking partner for life and we’re looking for people who are passionate about helping us achieve that goal. In return, we’re committed to making Westpac the best place to work in the country. Here are just a few of the ways we’re already doing that:
   

  

* Special offers on banking products and discounts from top brands, including generous employee\-only mortgage rates!
* Flexible work arrangements to help you achieve a greater work/life balance, and a variety of leave options including Culture, Lifestyle and Wellbeing leave.
* Tailored learning and development opportunities to help your grow your career within the bank.
* Lots of opportunities to ‘give back’ to the Community by getting involved in our many volunteering initiatives.


**Create your future today**
 To get started, simply click on the APPLY or APPLY NOW button
   

  

 We’re all about creating a supportive and inclusive community. We welcome everyone – no matter your age, gender, background, or abilities. We also provide additional support to welcome our veterans, Indigenous Australians and neurodiverse community.
   

  

 If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, you can find more information and contact details on our FAQs and how to contact us page , under the ‘Diversity, sustainability and flexibility’ section.

last_kept_snapshot.fit_source_text:
Eaton is an intelligent power management company dedicated to improving the quality of life and protecting the environment for people everywhere. The Power Quality (PQ) division at Eaton Electrical provides power management solutions including uninterruptable power supplies (UPS’s), surge protective devices, power distribution units (PDU’s), remote monitoring, software, power factor correction, airflow management, rack enclosures and services. We strive for continued success in leveraging technical innovation to develop next-generation solutions.
Due to growth, we are looking for a Project Coordinator to provide high‑quality administrative, commercial, and systems support to Project Managers for UPS, and critical infrastructure projects. The role is responsible for maintaining accurate project data, managing SAP project transactions, supporting financial governance, and ensuring projects are executed in line with contractual, commercial, and PMO requirements.


Key Duties:


Creating and maintaining project records in line with PMO processes, including SAP, SharePoint, Clockify, and related systems. Acting as a subject matter expert for SAP Project System (PS) and project-related contract transactions.
Managing project financial administration, including invoices, revenue, purchase orders, sales orders, forecasting, inventory, and margin tracking. Coordinating billing schedules and revenue recognition in line with contract milestones and project structure.
Leading month end financial close activities by working with Project Managers, Engineers, and Finance to ensure timely approval of revenue, billing, and supporting documents.
Preparing invoices, delivery notes, and commercial documentation, including bank guarantees and maintenance contracts. Monitoring and reporting overall project financial health and provide weekly project status, billing, revenue, and margin forecasts.
Coordinating procurement activities, including purchase order management and supplier creation requests with SCM. Supporting continuous PMO process improvement by standardising, documenting, and improving project and financial processes.



Qualifications:


Trade, Diploma or Degree qualification in project management or related areas
2+ years' experience in business, data analysing, financial reporting and project coordination area
Intermediate skill in MS Office - Word, advanced skill in MS Excel, beginner skill in Adobe Acrobat and familiar with VLOOKUP, SUMIF, Pivot table, etc.
Proficiency in an enterprise CRM software such as SAP, Oracle and or Salesforce highly desired 



What We Offer:

The Power Quality (PQ) division at Eaton Electrical provides power management solutions including uninterruptable power supplies (UPS’s), surge protective devices, power distribution units (PDU’s), remote monitoring, software, power factor correction, airflow management, rack enclosures and services. We strive for continued success in leveraging technical innovation to develop next-generation solutions.
Due to growth, we are looking for a Project Coordinator to provide high‑quality administrative, commercial, and systems support to Project Managers for UPS, and critical infrastructure projects. The role is responsible for maintaining accurate project data, managing SAP project transactions, supporting financial governance, and ensuring projects are executed in line with contractual, commercial, and PMO requirements.


Key Duties:


Creating and maintaining project records in line with PMO processes, including SAP, SharePoint, Clockify, and related systems. Acting as a subject matter expert for SAP Project System (PS) and project-related contract transactions.
Managing project financial administration, including invoices, revenue, purchase orders, sales orders, forecasting, inventory, and margin tracking. Coordinating billing schedules and revenue recognition in line with contract milestones and project structure.
Leading month end financial close activities by working with Project Managers, Engineers, and Finance to ensure timely approval of revenue, billing, and supporting documents.
Preparing invoices, delivery notes, and commercial documentation, including bank guarantees and maintenance contracts. Monitoring and reporting overall project financial health and provide weekly project status, billing, revenue, and margin forecasts.
Coordinating procurement activities, including purchase order management and supplier creation requests with SCM. Supporting continuous PMO process improvement by standardising, documenting, and improving project and financial processes.



Qualifications:


Trade, Diploma or Degree qualification in project management or related areas

Intermediate skill in MS Office - Word, advanced skill in MS Excel, beginner skill in Adobe Acrobat and familiar with VLOOKUP, SUMIF, Pivot table, etc.

Step into the action 


Step into a role where clarity, momentum, and delivery confidence shape business-critical outcomes at Tabcorp. You’ll join a fast-paced, collaborative technology delivery environment, supporting multiple teams to stay aligned, accountable, and focused on what matters most. This is 6 month daily rate contract role where your organisation skills and calm coordination keep big ambitions moving forward.


 
Your role, your impact Reporting to a senior delivery leader, this role acts as the heartbeat of milestone delivery across teams. Lead the maintenance of a centralised milestone tracker across teams and delivery streams

Prepare clear, consolidated status reports and dashboards for stakeholders

You are an organised, proactive delivery professional who brings structure to complexity and thrives in collaborative environments. You balance attention to detail with a big-picture mindset and communicate confidently with teams and senior stakeholders alike.  



Experience coordinating milestones across multiple teams using Jira, with strong governance routines
Strong understanding of Agile ways of working and cross-team planning approaches 
Proven capability in dependency mapping, risk management, and early issue escalation 
Skilled in producing clear, executive-ready reporting and delivery insights 
Ability to manage plan changes, communicate impacts, and maintain agreed baselines 
Highly organised and calm under pressure with a strong accountability mindset





 
Who we are TAB is part of Tabcorp, Australia’s leading gambling entertainment company. We’re an iconic brand trusted by millions, creating excitement across 4,400 venues nationwide as well as through our digital, phone and on-track channels. With over 1.1 billion bets taken each year, TAB is where Australians come for unforgettable moments - and where you can belong where the action is. 


 
Make your move
Ready to make TAB your home ground? Join a team that thrives on collaboration, inclusion, respect, and face to face connection. We welcome and support people of all abilities - if you need adjustments during the process, email careers@tabcorp.com.au.

last_kept_snapshot.fit_source_text: Who are we?    Standards Australia (SA) is the peak standards development organisation in Australia, with a rich history that dates back to 1922. Currently, we are undergoing a significant transformation and growth phase. In recent years, our workforce has doubled, and we now proudly employ over 200 professionals dedicated to helping shape Australia’s future and fulfilling our mission of empowering communities.    Our organisation brings experts together to create national and international standards that serve as essential guidelines for products and services, ultimately benefiting the Australian community. Our vision is to be a global leader in providing trusted solutions that improve life today and tomorrow.  About the role  We are seeking a Project Coordinator to join the Group Project Management Office (GPMO) at Standards Australia. Reporting to the Program Lead, this role supports the delivery of initiatives across the organisation by providing structured coordination and execution support across projects. Working closely with Senior Project Managers, Project Managers, Business Analysts and delivery teams, you will help ensure initiatives are well planned, tracked and governed. This role plays an important part in maintaining delivery discipline, supporting project momentum and ensuring accurate reporting and governance across project initiatives What you’ll do  Support Project Managers and Senior Project Managers in planning and coordinating cross-functional initiatives Coordinate day-to-day delivery activities including scheduling, milestone tracking and action management Maintain project documentation including plans, RAID logs, issue registers and reporting artefacts Track technical and business milestones and escalate risks or delivery issues where required Assist with project governance updates and portfolio reporting activities Independently manage smaller workstreams or lower-risk projects within established governance frameworks Support financial tracking, reporting accuracy and compliance with documentation standards Assist with change readiness activities including communications and training coordination Support testing coordination including user acceptance testing (UAT) scheduling and defect tracking Assist with transition-to-BAU activities ensuring implementation documentation is complete  About you You are a highly organised and delivery-focused professional with experience supporting projects in structured environments. You will bring:  1–3 years’ experience in a project coordination, project support or junior project management role Exposure to end-to-end project lifecycle activities, including planning, execution support and implementation Experience maintaining project governance artefacts such as plans, RAID logs and reporting documentation Working knowledge of project management methodologies such as PRINCE2, Agile or hybrid delivery models Strong organisational skills and attention to detail Strong communication and collaboration skills when working with cross-functional teams Experience using project and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, MS Project or similar PRINCE2 Foundation, Agile Foundation or equivalent certification preferred (or working towards  Culture & Benefits    Standards Australia is proud to have been awarded the prestigious Employer of Choice Award for two consecutive years, 2023 and 2024. This recognition highlights our commitment to creating an exceptional workplace and fostering a culture of excellence. Our iCARE values form the basis of all we do - Integrity, Courage, Accountability, Respect, and Excellence.    We offer a range of People Perks that support flexibility, wellbeing, career growth, and recognition - helping you thrive at work and beyond.  What's next?    If Standards Australia sounds like the place for you, please submit your CV outlining your experience and suitability to this role. Eligible applicants must be Australian Citizens, Permanent Residents or have legal rights to work in Australia. Shortlisted applicants will be contacted within 15 business days of their application.    At Standards Australia, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to fostering a working environment that values diversity, inclusion, and belonging. Our mission is to empower our communities, and in doing so, we strive to create an organisation that genuinely reflects and respects the diversity of the communities we serve; putting people at the heart of all we do. We welcome applications from people of all cultural and linguistic groups, people of all ages and genders, people of Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander background, people with a disability, and people from the LGBTQIA+ community. Should you need any adjustments to be made to our recruitment process, please contact recruitment@standards.org.au

last_kept_snapshot.fit_source_text:
Your Next Opportunity
Campbell Property Group (CPG) — one of Australia’s leading residential construction and property development companies — is seeking a highly capable Senior Business Analyst to join our Project Management Office (PMO) team in Norwest.In this role, you will play a key part in driving business transformation initiatives across the organisation. Partnering closely with business leaders, project teams and technology specialists, you will analyse complex business challenges, define clear requirements and help deliver practical solutions that improve processes, systems and outcomes. If you’re an experienced analyst who enjoys turning business needs into well-designed solutions and influencing meaningful change, this is a fantastic opportunity to contribute to strategic initiatives within a leading Australian builder.
What you’ll do
Lead the elicitation, analysis and documentation of functional and non-functional business requirements
Facilitate workshops and stakeholder consultation sessions to gather, validate and refine requirements
Analyse current business processes and identify opportunities for improvement, automation and efficiency
Translate business needs into clear requirements that support effective solution design and delivery
Provide analysis, advice and recommendations to stakeholders on solution options and implementation impacts
Support solution design discussions and participate in testing, including user acceptance testing
Contribute to business cases, benefits realisation planning and project workstream planning
Provide reporting on analysis progress, risks and issues to project leadership and stakeholders
About YouTo succeed in this role, you will bring:
Demonstrated experience working as a Business Analyst or Senior Business Analyst, with 3-7 years' experience in business analysis, process improvement, and systems analysis


Proven ability to gather requirements, analyse processes and design practical solutions
Experience working across business and technology teams to deliver system or process improvements
Strong understanding of business analysis frameworks and practices (e.g. BABOK)
Familiarity with Agile, Scrum or hybrid delivery environments
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capability
Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, including facilitating workshops
Highly organised and proactive, able to manage multiple priorities and influence outcomes
Experience in the Construction or Property industry highly desirable
IIBA Certification or equivalent also highly regarded
What’s on offerWhen you join Campbell Property Group, you’ll enjoy:
Ongoing coaching and mentoring from industry leaders 
Health and wellbeing perks – gym discounts, health insurance, annual nutrition & fitness check-ins 
Retail discounts across travel, groceries, and lifestyle
Savings on home builds, trades, suppliers, and utilities
Ongoing learning and development through the CPG Academy
Generous leave - including birthday, parental, volunteer and community service leave
Wellbeing support for you and your family (EAP, financial coaching, health programs)

At Campbell Property Group (CPG), we’re passionate about creating better futures, one home at a time.
Our businesses include:
Clarendon Homes – award-winning, innovative homes across QLD and NSW
Domaine Homes – affordable, stylish homes designed for modern families
CPG Estates – developing vibrant, sustainable communities
Loan Market Elevate – expert financial solutions to support our customers’ property journeys

With over 40 years in the home building industry, we’ve built a reputation for quality, integrity, and customer care.At Campbell Property Group (CPG), everyone has a home. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive workplace where everyone feels safe, respected and supported and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

last_kept_snapshot.fit_source_text:
Business Analyst 
 
 
At CSR, we are building a better future together.
 
We are a team of 2,600 people across Australia and New Zealand, and we are all collaborating every single day towards a shared purpose - 'Building solutions for a better future'. As a leading Australian Manufacturing business, we are at the forefront of developing innovative, sustainable, and high performing building products and systems.
 
At CSR, we put people first. We are committed to creating a safe, respectful, supportive, and inclusive working environment that enables everyone to feel valued, grow and truly thrive. We are committed to providing equal opportunity for everyone and welcoming people of all backgrounds, identities, experiences, abilities,and life stage.
 
 
About the role:
 
This full‑time Business Analyst role, based at our North Ryde Head Office, sits between the business and IT, focusing on improving operational processes and system use across the organisation. The role suits someone with experience in production planning, costing, scheduling, bills of material and production routing within manufacturing operations, who can analyse and map workflows to drive efficiency, consistency, and stronger process compliance. A key focus is uplifting system capability and supporting teams to use systems and new tools more effectively across end‑to‑end business processes.
 

Analyse existing business processes, identify inefficiencies, and develop improved workflows supported by detailed process documentation.
Conduct root‑cause analysis to address performance issues and recommend practical, innovative solutions.
Gather and document business requirements, translating stakeholder needs into clear and testable technical specifications.
Contribute to solution design and ensure alignment with organisational priorities throughout implementation.
Collaborate with IT and project teams to support delivery, including reviewing test plans, performing regression testing, and conducting UAT.
Assist with training, change management, and BAU adoption to ensure smooth rollout of new processes and solutions.
Build and maintain strong stakeholder relationships, ensuring effective communication and alignment on project goals.

 
 
 What you bring to the role:
 

Proven experience analysing, mapping, and improving end‑to‑end workflows to drive operational efficiency, process compliance, and better system utilisation across the organisation.
Background in production planning, costing, scheduling, bills of material and production routing within manufacturing operations.

last_kept_snapshot.fit_source_text: The role   The Business Analyst partners with business and technology stakeholders to understand business goals, analyse problems and opportunities, and translate needs into clear requirements, early designs, and prototypes. The role supports the delivery of user-centred digital solutions by shaping product and process improvements, validating concepts early, and enabling efficient delivery through well-defined user stories, acceptance criteria, and solution options.   The team   APRA's Technology team delivers, maintains, and enhances essential information technology services that support the organisation's productivity, strategic objectives, and business unit priorities. Technology partner with stakeholders to design, implement and maintain IT solutions that meet the needs of the organisation and ensuring these are secure and aligned with APRA's technology architecture. Key accountabilities Build strong relationships with business stakeholders to quickly understand objectives, pain points and desired outcomes, and identify where digital products and solutions can add value. Translate business needs into functional and non-functional requirements, ensuring they are testable, feasible and aligned to outcomes. Produce high-quality analysis artefacts such as user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps, and impact assessments to support delivery. Facilitate solution option analysis including costs, benefits, risks, dependencies, and delivery impacts to inform decision-making. Collaborate with business and technical teams to create early design concepts (e.g., wireframes, workflow diagrams, low-fidelity screens). Develop and iterate prototypes to validate requirements, user journeys, and usability with stakeholders and end users early in the lifecycle. Coordinate and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) planning and execution, including test scenarios, defect triage, and acceptance sign-off. Develop and maintain system, training, and user support resources to drive adoption and meet user needs and expectations. Communicate changes clearly and tailor messages and materials to different audiences, including non-technical stakeholders.  About you Demonstrated experience as a Technical Business Analyst working in digital delivery environments, with strong capability across discovery, requirements elicitation and high‑quality documentation. Strong experience delivering digital solutions across platforms such as Microsoft 365, Power Platform, ServiceNow and Oracle Fusion, with hands‑on technical understanding to shape solution design, integrations and delivery outcomes. Experience facilitating user research, journey mapping and applying human‑centred design approaches. Proven experience delivering initiatives across multiple digital domains, including web platforms, workflow, automation and enterprise business products. Solid understanding of end-to-end product lifecycle, digital architecture, agile methodologies and IT service delivery best practices. Excellent facilitation, communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence outcomes and gain agreement across diverse business and technical stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to manage priorities, driving outcomes in an agile, business-focused, collaborative environment.  To work with us you need to be an Australian Citizen and have the ability to gain a Defence Clearance.    About APRA Australian Prudential Regulation Authority (APRA) was established in 1998 as an independent statutory authority that supervises almost 1,200 financial institutions that manage $8.6 trillion in assets for Australians across the banking, insurance and superannuation sectors. In overseeing the safety, competitiveness and stability of the financial system, we seek to recruit, develop and retain highly skilled professionals, who want to help shape financial services and protect the financial wellbeing of the Australian community. Our employee base of almost 900 come predominantly from the commercial financial services industry or other government agencies; as such, we have the feel of a small corporate organisation that can work flexibly and with agility. At APRA, we're committed to providing an inclusive workplace where everyone belongs, feels valued and respected. We aspire to attract and foster diversity of background, thought, and experience, recognising that a broad range of perspectives, approaches and ideas makes us stronger, and better enables us to meet our obligation to protect the financial wellbeing of the Australian community. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, please inform at application stage so we can do our best to accommodate your requirements.

Are you an organised, proactive Project Coordinator who enjoys keeping projects on track and clients happy? Join our Security Consulting Project Management Operations (PMO) team and play a key role in delivering high‑quality security projects that exceed client expectations.
About UsAt The Missing Link, we don’t just keep up with the pace of technology - we set it. With 28+ years of innovation, a team of 200+ specialists, and the backing of global powerhouse Infosys, we’ve become one of Australia’s most awarded IT providers.
We help businesses move faster with cutting-edge Cyber Security, IT & Cloud, and AI & Automation solutions. And we’re growing - fast.
If you want to work where ambition meets opportunity, you’ve found your place.
About the RoleAs a Project Coordinator, you will be the central point connecting clients, sales, technical and delivery teams. You will own the coordination and delivery of small to medium‑scale security projects, ensuring timelines, budgets and quality standards are met.
You will also support purchasing, sales administration and billing activities within the Security team, making this a varied, hands‑on role with real visibility across the business.
What You’ll Be DoingManage the Security Projects inbox and register new projects in our CRM

Coordinate the end‑to‑end delivery of assigned projects
Assign and coordinate internal engineers, consultants and contractors
Prepare project plans and facilitate project kick‑off and internal review meetings
Track milestones, timelines and budgets using ConnectWise
Maintain clear, regular communication with clients and stakeholders
Run client status meetings, capture actions and follow up outcomes
Review and quality‑check reports and project documentation before release
Escalate incidents or risks to the Principal Project Coordinator as required

 Resource & Project CoordinationCoordinate resourcing schedules to ensure efficient delivery

Maintain strong working relationships with vendors and clients
Hold internal project update meetings and track progress
Ensure all in‑scope deliverables are completed to standard

 Billing & Sales SupportUpdate and track weekly project billings

Ensure invoices are raised accurately and on time
Assist clients with billing queries
Maintain accurate and up‑to‑date client information

 Administration & SupportMaintain staff biographies and certification records

Assist with project and ticket setup in ConnectWise
Support day‑to‑day administration for the Security PMO team
Stay informed on company products and services
Manage time effectively with minimal supervision

Requirements
About YouYou are detail‑driven, organised and confident working across multiple projects at once. You communicate clearly, enjoy coordinating people and processes, and take pride in delivering quality outcomes.
Skills & Experience
Tertiary qualification or equivalent experience
1+ year experience in the IT industry (Project Coordination experience preferred)


Strong Microsoft Word (Advanced) and Excel (Intermediate) skills
Experience with Microsoft Project and ConnectWise
At least one recognised project management certification
Additional technical certifications highly regarded

Benefits
A great company culture is very important to The Missing Link. Keeping everyone happy is one of our top priorities.
Here are some of the best bits about working at The Missing Link and some of the ways we try and maintain our staff happiness levels:

Supportive, collaborative and respectful environment
Opportunity to work with an experienced team of Service Experience Engineers
Potential for future career opportunities within our company
Great environment with regular staff events
Free breakfast, soft drinks/juices and monthly lunches
Company culture that fosters learning and development through training and mentoring programs

**Your Next Opportunity** 
 Campbell Property Group (CPG) — one of Australia’s leading residential construction and property development companies — is seeking a highly capable Senior Business Analyst to join our Project Management Office (PMO) team in Norwest.
 



  





 In this role, you will play a key part in driving business transformation initiatives across the organisation. Partnering closely with business leaders, project teams and technology specialists, you will analyse complex business challenges, define clear requirements and help deliver practical solutions that improve processes, systems and outcomes. If you’re an experienced analyst who enjoys turning business needs into well\-designed solutions and influencing meaningful change, this is a fantastic opportunity to contribute to strategic initiatives within a leading Australian builder.
 



  





**What you’ll do** 



* Lead the elicitation, analysis and documentation of functional and non\-functional business requirements
* Facilitate workshops and stakeholder consultation sessions to gather, validate and refine requirements
* Analyse current business processes and identify opportunities for improvement, automation and efficiency
* Translate business needs into clear requirements that support effective solution design and delivery

* Meet critical project deadlines
* Generate ideas for how our solutions can make our customers more successful.

* Understanding of Microsoft operating systems and server technologies
* Experience with MS\-SQL Server and/or database structures and principles
* A strong understanding of Reporting Services would be an asset
* Clear understanding and agile, Kanban, and full software development life cycle
* Solid understanding of Project Management Principles
* Minimum 3 years of experience in software development projects business analysis and/or application support with exposure to large\-scale enterprise support implementation required
* Solid background in asset backed structured finance, securitization, and accounting principles is desired, background in finance at least is required.
* Exceptional interpersonal and client\-handling skills with the ability to present to and train groups of people in a clear and concise manner are essential
* Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Mathematics, Computer Science or Applied Science is preferred
* CFA designation and/or PMP certification is an asset
* Autonomous self\-starter with a preference for a collaborative, agile work environment


 What you can expect from us
   

  

 Our performance\-driven culture is built on teamwork. We are ranked as one of the top companies to work for by Great Place to Work Canada and recognized as one of the best places to work in technology. Passionate about fostering an environment that positions each team member to succeed and grow their career. We are committed to diversity and inclusion and demonstrate our values through equitable pay, fantastic benefits, and an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone.
   

  

**Benefits**
 We invest time and resources to ensure TAO Solutions is as good as the people we hire. Here are some of the perks and benefits you can expect working at TAO Solutions:
   

  

* Competitive compensation package,
* Participation in TAO's bonus program (where applicable)
* Profit\-Sharing Program
* Hybrid work model
* Flexible work arrangements to support you and your team
* Collaborative organization that exemplifies autonomy and creativity
* Openness to new technology adoption and software advancement
* Robust benefits package including: vision, medical, and dental
* Yearly learning \& professional development allowance
* Company wide socials
* Internal team recognition platform (Bonusly)


 Applicant Screening Notice
   

  

 At TAO, we leverage artificial intelligence (AI) technology to enhance our recruitment process. These tools assist with tasks such as resume screening, drafting preliminary job descriptions, generating initial interview questions, and occasionally sourcing prospective candidates. However, AI is never used to make final hiring decisions; our use of AI serves to support repetitive and administrative tasks in order to streamline our hiring and recruitment workflows. We are committed to the responsible use of AI in our hiring practices, prioritizing both an improved candidate experience and operational efficiency. Our standardized hiring practices remain focused on reducing biases, with all key hiring decisions solely made by our team. We continuously review and refine our hiring practices to align with industry best practices and evolving legal guidelines
   

  

 \*\*\*PDF RESUMES PREFERRED \- ENSURE YOUR APPLICATION IS OCR (Optical Character Recognition) ENABLED\*\*\*
   

  

 TAO Solutions Inc. is an equal opportunity employer, committed to inclusion and diversity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national or ethnic origin, colour, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, family status, genetic characteristics, disability or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law, and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruitment process.
   

  

 This role is for an existing vacancy on our Service Delivery team based in Australia. TAO Solutions Inc. will communicate with you only through official email addresses and connected Linkedin profiles. We do not use WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, etc. Our team will not ask you to send us money or technology through our processes.
   

  

 RECRUITERS PLEASE DO NOT CONTACT

last_kept_snapshot.fit_source_text:
**About The Role**
 We are seeking a highly motivated and process\-driven
 **Business Analyst** 
 with a sharp eye for detail and a passion for process excellence. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on analyzing, documenting, and improving business processes—especially those related to communication templates, marketing workflows, and stakeholder engagement.
   

  

 As a Business Analyst, you will be instrumental in mapping and refining cross\-functional processes that support marketing initiatives, campaign management, and customer communications. This is not a technical role—a strong functional understanding and process orientation is key.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with Marketing, Communications, and Product teams to map end\-to\-end business processes related to campaigns, templates, and content workflows
* Lead process mapping of templates, identifying interdependencies, gaps, and process inefficiencies
* Conduct Business Verification Testing (BVT) to ensure processes and changes are aligned with business expectations before rollout
* Document and analyze current\-state vs future\-state processes, identifying bottlenecks, risks, and improvement opportunities
* Translate functional requirements into clear and structured process documentation using tools like Visio, Lucidchart, or equivalent
* Facilitate workshops and process walkthroughs with stakeholders to validate business needs and drive alignment
* Support governance of communication templates—tracking changes, approvals, and ownership across teams
* Maintain a strong understanding of business objectives to ensure process improvements align with strategic goals


**What We’re Looking For**
* 7\+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, preferably in a process\-heavy or operations\-focused environment
* Strong experience in working with XMLs
* Proven experience in process mapping, process documentation, and functional analysis
* Hands\-on experience with Business Verification Testing and process validation techniques
* Strong functional understanding of marketing or communication workflows, including template governance and campaign execution
* Prior exposure to Airdocs and Salesforce Marketing Cloud (or similar marketing automation/communication platforms)
* High proficiency in Excel, Jira, and Confluence for documentation, tracking, and collaboration
* Familiarity with BPMN, Visio, Lucidchart, or similar process modeling platforms
* Ability to work cross\-functionally and communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and a passion for continuous improvement


**Please note:** 
 This role requires you to work from the office 3 days a week. (Location: Sydney CBD)

 Project Delivery Services | Sydney

Business Analyst (ICT Business Analyst)

Permanent /Full time opportunity
Every role at Simplus requires a professional who has a broad understanding of professional services and who possess the tool kit of a consultant. That tool kit will include stakeholder management, keen business acumen, the ability to create and maintain collateral, strong collaboration skills, the ability to lead workshops, kick offs and training sessions. As a member of Simplus we all have three primary responsibilities:

Be a critical thinker: solve tough problems for the world’s biggest brands, work together, and be relentless in ensuring successful outcomes for clients.
Be a steward: look after each other and the company on our collective journey to success by being accountable, doing the right thing, and promoting a caring corporate culture.
Be an underdog: be determined, crafty, spirited, resilient, and tenacious. Challenge conventional wisdom and refuse to take no for an answer.

Responsibilities/ Duties

Participate in sessions with Salesforce.com customers and other team members to understand Business Requirements and Business Processes Analysis
Document detailed business, functional & technical requirements and analyze data and execute data migration strategies and mapping
Configuration of Salesforce.com and related third party application
Testing – creation and execution of testing scripts
Development of training material and training delivery to clients
Assist project managers to manage delivery outcomes, time frames and change management processes
Liaison with clients on an ongoing basis, to maintain and develop the business relationship ensure satisfaction with services provided and identify opportunities for further growth
Co-ordinate escalations to bring about resolution to meet client standards
Always Promote the Company’s business in a positive and professional manner

Qualifications/ Experience/ Knowledge Required

Education level, knowledge and work/industry experience
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Management Information Systems, and/or a related field
Enterprise consulting experience, including implementation experience with major technology programs
Ability to understand and be responsive to customer needs and to advocate for customer success
Experience defining and delivering enterprise applications on the Salesforce platform
Ability to work independently and as part of a distributed team and a willingness to take ownership of problems
Strong presentation and facilitation skills - must be able to deliver workshops and strategize at a C level.

Professional/ Technical Skills

Ability to translate data/facts/info into opportunities
Expertise in drawing activity flow and architecture diagrams
Ability to explain technical issues with non-technical personnel
Expertise in designing, sizing, implementing and testing Salesforce solutions
Behavioral (e.g. negotiation skills, presentation skills)
Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to have presence in a meeting environment
Ability to prepare and deliver workshops/training

This job description is a close guideline as to what you will be asked to do in your role. It is not exhaustive and you may be asked to contribute to work outside of what is set within this document.
