**About the Company** 




  
 



 At Future Secure AI, we're building something genuinely new — and we're looking for people bold enough to build it with us. We work at the frontier of AI, tackling big, real\-world problems for global enterprises across multiple industries, armed with state\-of\-the\-art technology and a culture that prizes courage, rigor, and relentless curiosity. Our BRAVER values aren't just words on a wall — they describe the kind of people we are and the standard we hold ourselves to every day. Our leadership team is entrepreneurial, experienced, and accessible, with an open\-door policy that means you'll never be just a number here. We invest seriously in your growth because we know our success depends on yours. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry, push into uncharted territory, and do work that genuinely matters, Future Secure AI is the place for you.
 



 Future Secure AI is not another AI vendor—we’re an enterprise AI partner who build cutting edge AI Co\-Workers to support enterprise business. Backed by one of the world’s largest financial institutions and trusted by C\-suite leaders across global organisations. Our mandate is bold: re\-engineer how the world’s biggest companies operate and give teams the ability to deliver 10x performance through intelligent systems.
 



**We’re scaling fast.** 
  And we’re looking for a Senior Technical Business Analyst who wants to
 **build, influence,** 
  and
 **lead transformation** 
  at speed.
 



**Why FSAI** 




 We don’t do theory. We build AI Co\-Workers that get shipped, adopted, and scaled across global enterprises.
 



 ·       Work on real enterprise AI initiatives with real customers.
 



 ·       Collaborate directly with senior executives, product leaders, and world\-class engineers.
 



 ·       High\-ownership culture.
 



 ·       Help shape product direction, delivery models, and the next wave of AI Co\-Workers.
 



 ·       Access and contribute to cutting\-edge use cases across multiple industries inc.: Finance, Health, Services and Social impact.
 



**The Role** 




 This is a role for someone who loves complexity, thrives in ambiguity, and knows how to turn strategy into clarity. You’ll be the connective tissue between business, engineering, and product—ensuring that FSAI’s AI systems don’t just get built, but land with precision and impact.
 



 You will lead discovery, shape roadmaps, break down problems, and unlock velocity across AI delivery teams. Your fingerprints will be on some of the most important AI programs happening inside major global enterprises.
 



**What You’ll Do** 




 ·       Facilitate workshops, uncover real requirements, and turn business ambition into actionable user stories to build AI Coworkers
 



 ·       Analyse data, workflows, and operational patterns to inform decisions and reduce delivery risk.
 



 ·       Partner directly with senior leaders to drive prioritisation, clarity, and strategic alignment.
 



 ·       Support engineers and product teams by removing blockers and enabling fast, confident execution.
 



 ·       Build deep expertise in FSAI’s AI capabilities and shape how new features and use cases evolve.
 



 ·       Operate in a squad on 2\-3 use cases in parallel
 



**About You** 




 You’re a Senior BA who wants to sit at the centre of AI transformation, not on the sidelines. You move with urgency. You bring structure to chaos. You communicate with precision. And you know how to influence up, down, and across.
 



**You bring:** 




 ·       8\+ years of Business Analysis experience in enterprise, consulting, or product\-led environments.
 



 ·       Proven leadership across 
 **complex technology, AI, data, or automation programs.** 




 ·       Experience in automation, 
 **UI/UX** 
  and 
 **project management** 
  is highly desired.
 



 ·       Expert workshop facilitation and requirements definition.
 



 ·       A strong understanding of SDLC, compliance, risk, and enterprise delivery fundamentals is desired.
 



 ·       Experience operating in fast\-paced agile teams.
 



 ·       Ability to shape narratives, influence direction, and guide senior stakeholders.
 



**What Success Looks Like** 




 ·       You build trust rapidly with executives and delivery teams.
 



 ·       You bring clarity, structure, and momentum to complex programs.
 



 ·       You help shape the trajectory of new AI initiatives and product capabilities.
 



 ·       You elevate performance across teams by driving alignment and focus.
 



  
 



  

**Why Join Us?** 



* A high\-performance culture
* State\-of\-the\-art technology
* Experience world\-class leadership
* Scale of impact and purpose
* A competitive salary and a huge growth trajectory
* Work with the best in the industry
* Flexible work environment
* Diversity and creativity



  

**Disclaimer:** 
 We do not wish to be contacted by recruitment agencies. Our hiring process is managed in\-house and the best way for candidates to express interest is by applying with your resume through our company website.
 


 Future Secure AI Privacy Policy
 
 At Future Secure AI, we are committed to protecting your privacy and adhering to the principles of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Australian Privacy Principles (APPs) under the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth). Our Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, share, and protect your personal data when you visit our website at
 
  
 
 www.futuresecure.ai
 
  
 
 (the "Website") and use our services.

**About us:**




 At NCS Australia, we believe in doing technology services better. Our commitment to quality, focus on people, and willingness to challenge traditional thinking set us apart. Our team brings this belief to life by partnering with our clients and communities to make tomorrow together.
   

  





 We are committed to creating an environment that prioritises innovation, collaboration, and purposeful work. Our diverse team is empowered to make a meaningful impact with curiosity, creativity and resilience to shape better outcomes. Join us and accept the challenge of creating a better tomorrow
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 We are seeking a
 **Process Re‑engineering Business Analyst** 
 to join a Process Excellence team working within a technology‑led environment. This role is responsible for analysing existing business processes and designing improved future‑state processes that support technology delivery and business outcomes.
   

  





 The role sits at the intersection of process improvement and IT change, supporting initiatives where process redesign is required to enable or optimise technology solutions. You will collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to understand how work is currently performed, identify improvement opportunities, and help shape practical, scalable process designs.
   

  





 This role will suit a Business Analyst with proven process improvement experience who is comfortable working across IT teams and delivery environments, and who brings a pragmatic, collaborative approach to their work.
   

  

  

  




**Qualifications**
* Demonstrated experience as a Business Analyst or Process Analyst with a focus on process redesign, optimisation, or continuous improvement.
* Experience working on technology or IT‑related initiatives, with an understanding of systems delivery and how processes align to technology outcomes.
* Strong experience mapping and analysing end‑to‑end business processes and designing future‑state process models.
* Hands‑on experience using process modelling tools or notations (e.g. Signavio, BPMN or similar).
* Proven ability to engage and collaborate effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.
* Experience supporting process change within Agile, hybrid or structured delivery environments.
* Background in complex enterprise environments (e.g. telecommunications or technology‑driven organisations) is beneficial but not essential.
* A grounded, practical working style with strong communication skills and a team‑oriented mindset.


**Additional Information**

**Why join us:**




 NCS Australia is where you can feel at home, nurturing your talents and skills as we make tomorrow together, one day at a time. Our benefits include paid parental leave, initiatives focused on your well\-being and discounted health insurance. You will also enjoy discounts on various products and services and be regularly recognised and rewarded for high performance. We are committed to your career development through our Capability Fingerprint, industry and partner training programs, special interest groups, and an AI\-driven learning platform. No matter where you are in your career, we offer meaningful work and opportunities for growth.
   

  





  

  





 NCS Australia is an equal\-opportunity employer, and we take pride in our commitment to valuing and supporting our people and the communities we serve.We are dedicated to attracting, retaining and developing our people regardless of gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability and age. Applications are encouraged from all sectors of the community and we strongly encourage applications from the Veterans, Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander community.
   

  





 At NCS Australia, we are committed to supporting adjustments throughout the recruitment and selection process, as well as during employment. We actively support and encourage people with disability to apply.
   

  





  

  





**Agencies:**




 We’ve got this. We request that you do not contact NCS employees outside of the Talent Acquisition team. NCS exclusively accepts resumes from agencies on our preferred supplier panel through the NCS Agency Portal. Agencies that submit resumes must have a valid fee agreement and be assigned to the particular requisition by the Talent Acquisition team. Any resumes that are submitted outside of this process will become the sole property of NCS. If a candidate is hired outside of this process, no fee or payment will be given.
   

  





  

  





**Work rights and background checks:**




 To be eligible for a position with us, applicants will need to have valid work rights for Australia and be willing to undergo a comprehensive background checking process, including probity and police checks

**Job Description**
 Create your best future and join Westpac as a
 **Senior Business Analyst, Customer Origination and Servicing.**
 This role will play a crucial part of the UNITE team. UNITE is our business\-led, tech\-enabled transformation, and a key priority for the Group. UNITE is about delivering 'one best way' to make our processes, systems and tech simpler so we can deliver a better experience for our customers and make things easier for our people.
   

  

* Location: Sydney\-based role only
* On\-site Requirement: 3 days in the office per week
* Why On\-site? This is a highly collaborative position involving regular face\-to\-face workshops and close team interaction, making in\-office presence essential.


**What’s the role?**
 As a Senior Business Analyst, you will partner closely with business stakeholders and program leadership to support the seamless migration of products, processes, and data from legacy systems to a new core banking platform. You will bridge business needs and technical solutions, ensuring the migration delivers operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and an improved customer experience across impacted portfolios.
   

  

 Additionally, you'll elicit, document, and validate detailed business requirements relating to customer data, product portfolios, and end‑to‑end workflows. You will map current‑state (AS‑IS) processes and design future‑state (TO‑BE) processes aligned with the target platform, while proactively identifying gaps, dependencies, and potential risks within migration plans.
   

  

 You will act as a key liaison between business and technology teams, ensuring alignment on requirements and delivery outcomes. You will also support user acceptance testing, data validation cycles, and defect triage to ensure solutions are fit for purpose and ready for successful deployment.
   

  

**What do I need?**
* Extensive Senior Business Analyst experience within the banking or financial services sector, delivering large‑scale transformation programs.
* Strong expertise in customer origination, servicing, and end‑to‑end product origination processes.
* Proven experience in customer migration initiatives, including customer‑to‑account relationships and authority migration.
* High‑level stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across multiple business units and senior program leadership.
* Solid understanding of data migration, validation, reconciliation, and data governance practices.
* Advanced capability in requirements elicitation, process modelling (AS‑IS / TO‑BE), gap analysis, and risk identification.
* Experience working in agile and waterfall hybrid environments, with strong knowledge of core banking products (customers, accounts, transactions, deposits, loans, payments, treasury).


**Why join us?**
 We’re obsessed with becoming our customers \#1 banking partner for life and we’re looking for people who are passionate about helping us achieve that goal. In return we’re committed to making Westpac the best place to work in the country. Here are just a few of the ways we’re already doing that:
   

  

* Special offers on banking products and discounts from top brands, including generous employee only mortgage rates.
* Flexible work arrangements to help you achieve a greater work life balance, and a variety of leave options including Culture, Lifestyle and Wellbeing leave.
* Tailored learning and development opportunities to help your grow your career within the bank.
* Lots of opportunities to give back to the Community by getting involved in our many volunteering initiatives.


**Create your future today**
 To get started, simply click on the APPLY button. \| \#UNITEProgram
   

  

 We’re all about creating a supportive and inclusive community. We welcome everyone no matter your age, gender, background, or abilities. We also provide additional support to welcome our veterans, Indigenous Australians and neurodiverse community.
   

  

 If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, you can find more information and contact details on our FAQs and how to contact us page , under the ‘Diversity, sustainability and flexibility’ section.

last_kept_snapshot.fit_source_text:
At Cotality, we are driven by a single mission—to make the property industry faster, smarter, and more people\-centric. Cotality is the trusted source for property intelligence, with unmatched precision, depth, breadth, and insights across the entire ecosystem. Our talented team of 5,000 employees globally uses our network, scale, connectivity and technology to drive the largest asset class in the world. Join us as we work toward our vision of fueling a thriving global property ecosystem and a more resilient society.
   

  

 Cotality is committed to cultivating a diverse and inclusive work culture that inspires innovation and bold thinking; it's a place where you can collaborate, feel valued, develop skills and directly impact the real estate economy. We know our people are our greatest asset. At Cotality, you can be yourself, lift people up and make an impact. By putting clients first and continuously innovating, we're working together to set the pace for unlocking new possibilities that better serve the property industry.
   

  

**Job Description**
 At Cotality, we are leaders in property data and real estate technology across Australia and New Zealand. We are seeking a Senior Technical Business Analyst to bridge the gap between complex stakeholder needs and high\-performance technical execution.
   

  

 Contribute to the design of system architectures and maintain coherent documentation for all data processes, and become the technical Subject Matter Expert of the systems your team manages.
   

  

 What You Will Be Doing
   

  

* Technical Implementation: Move beyond high\-level requirements to define the specific processes for data ingestion, transformation, and publication.
* Requirement Transformation \& Storytelling: Translate business needs into detailed technical user stories that provide developers with a clear, actionable roadmap.
* Data Interrogation: Use advanced methodologies to independently query and understand data assets, ensuring they are fit\-for\-purpose and reconciled accurately.
* Documentation \& Ownership: Design system architectures and maintain coherent documentation for all data processes, taking full ownership of the systems your team manages.
* Agile Collaboration: Work effectively within a scrum environment to deliver high\-quality solutions on time and within budget.


**Job Qualifications**
 What You Will Bring
   

  

**Essential**
* Advanced SQL Mastery: This is your primary tool; you must be able to independently interrogate complex data assets and script with precision.
* Analytic Curiosity: A proactive drive to perform root\-cause analysis and troubleshoot technical issues within data pipelines.
* Clear Technical Communication: The ability to provide concise technical messaging and engage with both internal and external stakeholders effectively.
* Experience \& Education: A minimum of 3 years of commercial experience in complex data environments, supported by tertiary qualifications in Information Science, Business, or equivalent industry experience.


**Preferred**
* Platform \& Development Literacy: Direct experience with BigQuery (or similar large\-scale environments) and a strong understanding of codebases and end\-to\-end technical development.
* Domain Knowledge: Previous exposure to property and attributes data assets is highly desirable.
* Modern Tech Exposure: Familiarity with APIs, event\-based pipelines, and cloud concepts (specifically GCP and serverless architecture).


**Why Join Cotality?**

We are oOh!media (pronounced “oh!” media).
 



 oOh!media is the \#1 Out of Home company in Australia and New Zealand.
 



 We exist to make public spaces better and brands unmissable, proudly leading the market with innovation, creativity, data and results. Our network plays an important role in the communities they are located, creating engaging environments that inform, entertain and inspire, while connecting brands with audiences at scale.
 



 We are oOh!media, and we are unmissable.
 



 Join us:
 



 We’re a team driven by creativity, innovation, and a sense of community. We show up every day ready to be bold, brave, and push the boundaries of Out of Home advertising. You’ll work alongside a group of talented individuals across Australia and New Zealand, all of whom are dedicated to raising the bar. If you’re ready to realise your potential and make an impact, join us.
 



**About the Opportunity** 



* 6 Month Fixed\-Term Contract
* Based in North Sydney



 We’re seeking an experienced HRIS Business Analyst to play a pivotal role in delivering our organisation\-wide HRIS transformation, with Workday now confirmed as our core platform.
 



 This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who thrives in complex transformation environments, enjoys partnering across functions, and brings deep expertise in HRIS implementations and process optimisation.
 



 Based in our vibrant North Sydney office, this 6 month fixed\-term contract will see you work closely with the HRIS Project Manager, HR, IT, Finance and external vendors to support the successful implementation of Workday.
 



 You’ll play a critical role in gathering and translating business needs into clear, actionable requirements, conducting gap analysis, and optimising end\-to\-end HR and payroll processes. This role is central to ensuring our new Workday platform is fit for purpose, compliant, and ready for adoption across the business.
 



**What You’ll Do** 



* Lead requirements gathering and documentation for Workday HCM, Payroll, and Time \& Attendance
* Conduct gap analysis and recommend process improvements across HR and payroll
* Support the replatforming of Time \& Attendance and other HRIS components
* Facilitate workshops to define future\-state workflows, user stories and integration needs
* Translate business requirements into functional specifications aligned to Workday best practice
* Partner with vendors and internal teams to support configuration validation and UAT
* Ensure solutions meet regulatory, security and data privacy requirements
* Support change management activity to drive system adoption and capability uplift



**What You’ll Bring** 



* 5\+ years’ experience as a Business Analyst delivering HRIS implementations or transformations
* Strong understanding of HR processes, payroll and system integrations
* Hands\-on experience with Workday (or comparable platforms such as SAP SuccessFactors or Oracle HCM)
* Proven ability to translate business needs into functional requirements and user stories
* Excellent analytical, communication and stakeholder engagement skills
* Experience working across Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies
* Business Analysis certification (CBAP or CCBA) highly regarded
* Experience applying Lean, Six Sigma or DMAIC methodologies an advantage


-
